title: Tenma Tsukasa — Card Story

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, where shall I enjoy my most elegant luncheon? Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ooh, I behold a breezy place illuminated by sunbeams filtered through the foliage. It is as if it's a natural spotlight made to shine on me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Perfect. The perfect place for my most elegant luncheon. I'm impressed by myself for finding this amazing place!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, a handkerchief to prevent my uniform from getting dirty...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph, how very gentlemanly of me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And now it is time to enjoy my elegant luncheon...
Hm? What is this little black dot in the air...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can't really see because it's too small—GAAAAAAH!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: S-S-S-Spider?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Stay away! Stay away from me! I found this place first! There are so many other trees here you can climb on! Get away from me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ugh! It's suspended in midair completely motionless... No wait, if it moves, it may fall on my handkerchief just underneath!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: D-Drats... What should I do?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, that place under the tree looks like a nice place for a nap. Huh, someone's already there?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, wait, wait, wait! Don't come any lower!
That's my handkerchief right there!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, it's just him. What a nuisance.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, I have some time. Lemme go wind him up a little.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Tsukasa! What are you doing over there?
And why're you all hunched up like that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hunched up?! How can you say that, when I'm so valiantly trying to confront this unscrupulous spider preventing me from enjoying my luncheon?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Spider? You're afraid of spiders?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: N-Not at all! I'm just trying to prevent this infernal bug from contaminating my precious handkerchief...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Handkerchief?
Where's the spider, anyway?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right there! Look, it's just over there!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't see anything.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're not looking hard enough! Look again!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, there it is.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: See? Look at how it's swaying around like it owns the place!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's just a small little dot you can hardly see, there's no need to be so bothered by—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course I'm bothered! A small spider is still a spider!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Sigh... I was gonna just tease him a little, but it's kinda anticlimactic when he's already shrieking like that.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You just want it to move somewhere else, right?
Caught it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
There, I put it in the bush over there.
It's gone now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-You saved me...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, I'll be off now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, wait! Allow me to share some of my luncheon with you as a token of appreciation for saving me from that terror.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Luncheon? Oh, you talking about your lunchbox?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Luncheon, you plebeian!
Anyway, go ahead and take any side dish that catches your fancy.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, if you insist...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa, what's with this unnecessarily fancy-looking lunch? There's melon...and even a small slice of cake...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll take this cheesecake, then.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ugh, I was going to have that as dessert after the meal... But, it's fine. I did say it was a token of appreciation.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait! You just touched a spider's web.
Wipe your hand with this first.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A wet wipe? You're surprisingly prim and proper, huh.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's common sense to wash your hands and rinse your mouth before meals!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good, I see you've wiped your hands. You may eat now!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks for the cake!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Savor it slowly, understand?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Just say it once!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nom... 'Kay, see you later then!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Do not speak with food in your mouth!
Have you no sense of decorum?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, I can finally enjoy my elegant luncheon in peace!
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, look at this!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sliding into my classroom at the exact same moment the lunch bell goes off...this must be something serious.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehehe, look at this!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's not very different from what you just said.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Just look! Here, this video!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is...a video of an overseas show?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, this is quite...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Interesting, right? The pre-show announcement was merely a guise, for the show had already started by then!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Some actors dressed up as spectators were waiting in the audience. The show starts off by blurring the line between real life and the performance!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The way they move to the stage from the audience is quite smooth. This opening sequence is very well thought-out.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Amazing, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It is. And I find that I-came-up-with-this expression on your face to be quite amazing as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Anyway, this show should be a useful reference.
I must see it in its entirety.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, yes, I know!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, here's the main thing I wanted to talk about.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I want to use this opening sequence for our first show as well!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Go on...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're limited by that shabby stage, but I'm sure we can pull off something similar with a little bit of ingenuity!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. It's just that the show in the video and the show we're trying to do are in different genres and flavors.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll have to adapt it in a way that fits with our style.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! And be sure to do it in a way that makes me, the star of the show, as cool as is humanly possible!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll keep your request in mind and think hard about how to incorporate that into the stage production.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm counting on you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A stage is a stage, no matter how small or dilapidated!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The future musical star, Tsukasa Tenma is about to take his first step towards conquering the world!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll need to prepare some promotional flyers too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. I'll have to check with Emu about what sort of arrangements are in place for that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, even if she doesn't know, those mascots hanging around her should have some idea, at least.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm looking forward to it already.
It would be really nice if we could make this show a success.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: With I myself as the showman, scriptwriter, and lead actor, there's no way the show wouldn't be a big hit!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You've added a lot of interesting effects too, remember?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Our first show will be filled to capacity!
We'll receive a standing ovation after the final curtain for sure!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe... Your confidence is quite something.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? What's wrong? You don't sound very enthused...
Have you no confidence in your own stage direction?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh dear? Is that what you think of me?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nah, you'd be the last person on earth to feel that way...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm glad you know me so well, Tsukasa♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (There are a few things I'm concerned about, though...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, even if you do lose your confidence, fret not!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your stage direction is innovative but classic! Absolutely befitting of a great show led by a superstar! And since the star himself says so, you can be sure it's true!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's certainly an honor.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That was a very productive conversation indeed.
Now I can enjoy my midday meal with good cheer.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hehehe...my elegant luncheon awaits.
Thanks for your time!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No problem. See you after school, Tsukasa.
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, well. I got here first today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Heh. First on the scene like a true star!
No matter it's just a regular rehearsal day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I might as well prepare for the rehearsal... Hmm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our normally slightly grimy, run-down stage is covered in sand?! The strong wind yesterday must have blown it here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Tsk! It seems today we have to start with some cleaning.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yahohoy!
Hel-lo! Tsukasa, hi☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You turned up really early! You must be excited for the rehearsal! In which case, let's jump right to it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not so fast, Emu! Let me get a word in, okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We need to attend to our stage first and get it clean before we can begin the rehearsal.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Awww! Our dear little stage needs some TLC, huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You can put it that way. Get changed into something you don't mind getting dirty, and let's get cleaning.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Roger♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This comes off... And this goes on...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? What's she doing there behind the stage?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What the...!?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wshhhooo!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
A hazmat suit and gas mask?!
What do you think we'll be doing, Emu, defusing explosives?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Pshhhh! Shwaaaaah!
(Hm? It's kinda difficult to move in this!)

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Miss, it's dangerous to run around in this!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How are you going to get any cleaning done?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And what's up with the strange noises?
If you're pretending to be an alien, this is the wrong costume.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Shooo, shwoooo?!
(Did somebody mention ALIENS?!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Shoof! Shoof?!
(Where did you see aliens?!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This noise is really getting to me! Let's see what I can do about it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Shoooof! Shaaaah!
(Get changed into something normal!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Shaaaagohgoh!
(We need to clean the stage!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Shaaahgoh! Gohgoh♪
(Aye, I'll clean the stage!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why do I have to deal with this...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh, at least I can say with pride that I ingeniously broke through Emu's mystery language barrier.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right, let's get started. First, we need some water, and then we'll scrub the dirt off with brushes...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Got it! Big splaaash!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, don't get me splashed!
Watch it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Bua ha ha ha! I have superhuman reflexes!
You didn't get one drop on me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But now...
It's payback time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh, I, er... I was just kidding! Haha, I'm just going to pour some water over the floorboards well away from Emu. Haha...ha.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That was close... No telling what the park mascots might do to me if they perceive me as a threat to Emu...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, Emu. I'm going to start on this end.
You go from the other, okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm! Tsukasa, listen, listen!
I got an idea for a fast and fun way to clean the stage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Do you now? What do you propose?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll just demonstrate my method! First, you soak one of the towels like this and put it here, and then... Hiyaaaaaaaaah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, hold on...stop!
You're not thinking of jumping onto it, right?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All aboard the cleaning cloth! Woooo☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Watch out, Emu! You're going to crash into me! Nooooo!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yikes! Mission failed! I'm so sorry, Tsukasa!
It's really hard to steer a high-speed cleaning cloth!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I promise you the second try will be a success!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What second try?
No, Emu, don't!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here I go♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, mascot!
Move your big fluffy body and stop her!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ha-hoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, no, don't come this way! Aaargh!
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, guys.
Time to decide the theme of our next show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is very important, so I need you all to think carefully about it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And why are you chairing this meeting?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because I'm the leader of this troupe!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A self-proclaimed leader...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Guys! GUYS! GUYS!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What is it, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It has to be... Space!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu, don't just suddenly set our derailed conversation back on track. And why does it have to be that, anyway?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A brilliant suggestion. In its immeasurable vastness, space is full of mysteries, making it a fascinating setting for a play.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Space is actually pretty neat!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's take our audience on a space tour. We shall travel along the Milky Way, to the far reaches of our galaxy never seen before by another human!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The universe awaits!
Let's fearlessly jump headfirst into a black hole in search of new dimensions!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That would be a spectacle truly out of this world!
Wouldn't you like to host it on our humble stage?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You guys are getting carried away.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A spectacle out of this world... I like the sound of it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why does it always go like this?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, lay out your plan for this play.
I'm a down-to-earth guy, but I might be persuaded to your space show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Plan? That makes me think of flan!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Can't you stay focused for a minute... Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No, I've got to stay calm and not let her throw us off the topic we were discussing.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Heh. Let's handle it like a leader!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You know what, Emu, you're right. Plan, flan, it's almost the same word when you think about it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know, right♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Success! I'm becoming quite skilled at dealing with Emu.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Ugh... Tsukasa's got that creepy grin on...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As the director, perhaps I should explain the plan for this play.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Space, of course, means zero gravity.
I'd like that to be clearly portrayed on stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Zero gravity? Yes, of course. Good point.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We could try it out right away.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, mind if I hoist you up?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Where did you get this rope from?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Nevermind the details.
Are you willing to cooperate?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For the sake of this spectacle that's out of this world?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ugh... Is this a test I have to pass to achieve stardom?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, fine then! Do what you want!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
First, put this belt over your torso.
Now let me tie this tight...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu, could you pass the other end of the rope through the pulley on the ceiling? Then I'd like the mascots to help pull Tsukasa up.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sure!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's all quite simple, isn't it?
It seems we're ready.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mascots, would you mind?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: One, two, three... Pull!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa! I'm in the air!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Now, Tsukasa, you need to find your balance.
Try to make it look as if you were effortlessly drifting in space.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Urgh... It's hard work when you're ACTUALLY FIGHTING AGAINST GRAVITY! Got to...straighten...UPPP!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, that's sooo cool!
It really looks like he's floating!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... This would work well enough if the play was set on a spaceship.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah... But wouldn't it be better if it looked more floaty?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My mascot friends! You know what to do!

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Roger, Miss Emu!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, what are you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
H-Hey, don't swing the rope so much!
I'm going to lose my balance... Aaargh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nooo, I'm going to crash!
I'm crashing dooown!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, that's so great!
It's like you're really tumbling through space, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, what else does our space setting need?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How about dark matter?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Um... Guys...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe, are you sure you want to give me the perfect excuse to devise a contraption creating dark matter?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Guys!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What is dark matter? Is it related to grey matter, but darker?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, Emu. Dark matter is the name for the mysterious particles filling space...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Guys! Can you stop the astrophysics lecture and GET ME DOWN?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What the... Mascots, what are you doing?
Why are you tying the rope to that pillar?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Somebody, anybody, get me dooown!
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Are we all here?
Very good!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now that we have a full cast and a completed script, we can finally start practicing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Whatever you say.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, can I have a minute before we begin?
It's about that stage effect we were discussing yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Lightning is supposed to strike the ground behind the prince during the opening scene, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've actually upgraded the device that will generate the lightning. Can we test it out before practice?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Up...graded? Why do I have such a bad feeling about this...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're gonna have even stronger lightning?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! I wanna see things go kaboom! And sizzle sizzle! Like that!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Rest in peace.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey! That's not funny at all!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, so you don't want that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You were the one who wanted to try using real lightning in the performance because it's never been seen before, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Only you would be bold enough to bring up wanting to try doing something no one's ever done before, Tsukasa. And that's why you're so wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: W-Well, you should expect nothing less from a future star!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I know I can count on you!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Oh brother...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, we'll check on that stage effect while practicing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sir, yes, sir!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Now, onto the next scene.
In this part, Emu makes her appearance by bursting through the stage set.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here I come♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Bang crash boom! Nyeh heh heh!
I'm the demon lord's dragonkeeper!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My dragon will pancake you, foolish prince!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Very good! Excellent entry!
And then comes the part where the prince almost gets eaten by the dragon.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: What are we going to do about the dragon?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Are we using papier-mâché? Or a video projector?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Unless we have an extraordinary video on hand, there won't be much of an impact at all! I vote for something more lifelike, whether it's papier-mâché or whatever else!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I have something to say!
I want a real dragon!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Dragons don't exist...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. If they do, I'd certainly love to work with one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A real dragon, huh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That reminds me of all those strange creatures moving around in that SEKAI place.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I could've sworn I saw a flying train somewhere, too. I wouldn't be surprised at all if there were real dragons somewhere in that world.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If we could have access to a real dragon, we'd have the most incredible show in the world that no one's ever...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, that means I'll become real dragon food!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Aww, so no real dragons?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm playing the part of a guy who almost gets eaten by it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Besides, if a real dragon appears on stage, there's a very high chance it may overshadow me, the lead actor!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(No, wait. Hold it right there, Tsukasa Tenma.
What are you so afraid of, future star?!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I won't be outdone by anything in this world...
No, not even an actual, real-life dragon! Because I'm ME!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes... I can do this. Bring it on in spades and then some!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ha ha ha ha!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: He just burst out laughing like that. What's wrong with him?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wouldn't know.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But he looks so happy about it!
Let me try it out too♪ Ha ha ha ha!
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Our performance was a great success.
Everyone had a huge smile on their face, whether it was the audience or us!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(And that's what I'd been looking for.
In order to keep making shows that will put a smile on everyone's face...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know!
Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui! Are you here?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
School's over.
Let's go to Phoenix Wonderland together!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh my. And you came here specially to pick me up?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I sure did! Let's go pick up the others while we're at it.
Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Ah?!
Wh-What do you want...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We're here to pick you up!
Let's go to Phoenix Wonderland together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: P-Pick me... You didn't have to show up at my class... You stand out too much and that bothers me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What did you say?! After I went through the trouble of coming all the way here to get you?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I didn't ask you to do that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There, there. Squabbling with him here is just going to attract even more attention to yourself.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's...true.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehe, it is the destiny of a star to attract attention wherever he goes...but enough about that. Come on, let's go already!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What's gotten into him?
Why is he so fired up?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Who knows?
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We're heading to Emu's school right now.
I told her to wait for us at the school gate.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So basically, you want us to all to go to Phoenix Wonderland together?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What put this idea into your head, anyway?
Suddenly having to act chummy with everyone is really creeping me out...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph... It's because a star has to treasure his troupe!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've come to the realization that the best way to make the audience smile is to ensure that the troupe members are smiling themselves too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thanks to you guys, I finally understand what's truly important!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now all that's left is for us to strengthen our ties!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehehe... Acknowledging mistakes and learning from them is what sets a true star apart from the others. I cower in awe of my own boundless talent!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, he's really changed.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How I wish that was true for his inflated ego too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's what makes him so entertaining, so let him keep it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What're you mumbling about to each other? Let's go already!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Ugh...
I can't find anyone...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Young man over there, what seems to be the problem? Are you looking for something?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey... He just went up to talk to a complete stranger....

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I was playing hide-and-seek with my friends, but I can't seem to find anyone at all.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see the problem now. Very well, leave this to me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll put on a show that's so amazing, your friends can't help but come out from their hiding places to watch me!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Here I go! Don't take your eyes off me!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Putting on a show for a boy playing hide-and-seek so as to draw his friends out from hiding? What nonsense is that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. But you have to hand it to him for having the guts to suddenly start dancing on the streets like that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But that boy's gawking at him.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Wow! You're so good at dancing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I know I am, young man!
Come on and dance along with me!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Hey, what's that guy doing over there?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Where? Oh, that looks fun!
I wanna join in too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My, my. He's drawn quite a large crowd in very little time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No way...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
Behold the power of my sheer popularity!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yaaay! Let's dance, let's dance♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
E-Emu?! What are you doing here?
I thought I told you to wait for us at your school gate?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I couldn't wait any longer and so here I am!
Anyway, let's dance, Tsukasa♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Argh! Stop pulling my arm!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are you really sure he's changed?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, whatever the case, everyone seems to be having fun, so why not let him do what he wants?
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph, coming early to practice by myself even though we've only just wrapped up the Halloween show—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I truly am the paragon of stardom, if I do say so myself!
Besides...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The cool and refreshing morning air is pleasant to breathe. It'll certainly help me to focus on my practice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Did that bush just move?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hahaha! I see right through you!
Emu or someone else is hiding in there, in order to scare me, am I right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll have you know that you can't use the same trick on me twice! Accept your defeat and show yourself!
Uaaah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gyaaah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What's Rui's zombie robot doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Robot A
rows.Line: Oooh... Oooh...

rows.Speaker: Zombie Robot B
rows.Line: Oooh... Oooh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, there's another one there...and over there too?! Just hang on for a minute here! Why are there so many zombie robots gathered here?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Unless they've all gone out of control again?!
But that's just not possible!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, you're just full of energy from morning, aren't you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui?! What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I added a greeting function to the zombie robots, so I'm doing a test drive.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: G-Greeting function? You mean, like shaking hands with the visitors and taking photos together?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. In recent years, at the end of Halloween season, this theme park holds a Zombie Greeting event where zombies are made to head out to greet park visitors.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course, other than zombies, actors in monster costumes and stage mascots will be taking part as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mr. Mascot suggested that we take part in this event as well, so that more people can know about Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We're supposed to be going out to greet the visitors today, along with the other zombie cast members.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's why you were asked to come too, as a welcoming crew.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. But getting zombies to greet visitors isn't exactly—

rows.Speaker: Zombie Robot
rows.Line: Augh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Hm... They do look somewhat lovable after you get used to seeing them, I guess?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's just such a shame that the zombies can only play a part during Halloween season, though...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Maybe, but there's always next year, right?
We can always let them do their thing again next year and—

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Unfortunately, we may have to dispose of them after their time is up this year.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! I didn't know about that! Why?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My plan was to keep them in the Wonder Stage storeroom and use them again for next year's show...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But the storeroom is just too dusty for that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Besides, the place isn't ideal for keeping robot machinery since the temperature and humidity there fluctuates by a lot over the course of an entire year.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And it's not like I can store so many robots in my house, so...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You have a good reason, though...

rows.Speaker: Zombie Robot
rows.Line: Augh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (They may be robots, but they're still fellow performers who helped to make the show a success. Scrapping them like that would leave a bad taste in my mouth...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I haven't given up yet, either.
I'll be spending a bit more time to look for ways to store them properly.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh... Okay.
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph, today was a day of productive practicing, as it always is when I'm around. Which means the next show is bound to be a smashing success as well!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Noises from the bush again...
It has to be one of the zombie robots doing its greeting routine, right?

rows.Speaker: Zombie Robot
rows.Line: Uh... Ah...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I knew it. You're not catching me off guard this time!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Human?
rows.Line: Ugh... Agh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha, you guys really love to flock together, don't you? However, that's not going to be enough to surprise me—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait...you, you're not a robot?

rows.Speaker: Zombie Human?
rows.Line: Flesh... Let me eat...your flesh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gyaaah! I-It's a real zombie!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Human?
rows.Line: Heh...hahaha! Hey, you're a cast member here too, right? No need to act so surprised. I'm a colleague!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: C-Colleague?

rows.Speaker: Zombie Cast
rows.Line: Huh? Don't you know about the Zombie Greeting event?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, right! Rui did mention something like that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: With such a realistic performance and convincing makeup, can you blame me for thinking you were an actual zombie?

rows.Speaker: Zombie Cast
rows.Line:
Oh, this isn't makeup, actually. It's a mask!
Makeup takes too much time to put on.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! A mask with such uncanny details?!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Cast
rows.Line:
Yeah, this mask is really well-made.
That's why it's been very popular among the visitors here in recent years!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In recent years? Does that mean this same mask has been in use for a few years already?

rows.Speaker: Zombie Cast
rows.Line: Of course. It would be a waste of resources to dispose of something so well-made only after using it once, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That means there's a storeroom somewhere that's capable of keeping intricately designed props in good condition!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This is it! We've found what we need!)
The next day
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Before we start our practice session today,
I have an important announcement to make.

rows.Speaker: Zombie Robot
rows.Line: Augh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We were facing the possibility of having to dispose of these zombie robots because we didn't have the right facilities to store them until next year.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Eh?! N-No way...
We have to throw our zombie robots away?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let me finish! I just said, we were facing this problem. In other words...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You've found an appropriate place to store them?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. There's a storeroom where elaborate masks and costumes used in the yearly Halloween greeting events are stored.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The temperature and humidity in that room is kept at a certain level that should be appropriate for storing machinery too. That's what the mascot said, at least!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Really, now... Thanks for this, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph, you should expect nothing less from the showman of Wonderlands×Showtime himself!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And he lets it get to his head right away.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But that means we don't have to toss the zombie robots away anymore, right?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. They can join us again next year.

rows.Speaker: Zombie Robot
rows.Line: Oooh... Oooh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm? Is it just me, or do they look kinda happy?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Maybe they're trying to thank Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ha ha ha! Even robots understand the awesomeness that is me!
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's begin our practice session for today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Tsukasa's raring to go as usual! I'm right behind you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Feels like they're still riding on the Halloween train at full speed, even though the show's already over.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
The show was a great success, after all.
I can understand why they're still filled with such enthusiasm.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (As long as they don't end up running around in circles...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, let's continue from where we left off yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The scene where the witch pushes the prince to the edge of the stage, but then a fairy saves him in the nick of time?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's the one. Let's start!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ho ho ho! Your attempts to flee from my magical troops have been such a waste of effort. Don't you agree, dear prince?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ugh! Looks like that's all the time I can stall for...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Come on, why aren't you fighting back?
Is this really how you want it to end? Your pathetic life, that is!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I won't let you get your way!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (In this scene, the prince stands up against the witch in the face of death! I should use big and sharp moves to show that the prince is galvanizing himself for action!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah! Tsukasa, don't move back!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Uh oh! I'm too near to the edge of the stage!)

rows.Speaker: Emu & Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ouch!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Owww, my backside!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa, are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I...I'm fine, but my backside isn't...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Aaargh!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tsukasa? Are you listening?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Yeah, I'm listening.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, I can't believe I actually lost my footing! Though, I suppose it is only to be expected from a performance as bold and inspiring as mine, huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ha ha ha ha ha!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, good. I think this is proof that he's really fine!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now I'm more worried about his head than his body.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, some injuries only start hurting a while after the fact. You shouldn't push yourself too hard today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's true. I'll take precautions and hold back from making any big movements from now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, apologies for the interruption.
Let's get back to practice.
Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sigh... I really goofed up...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah! Tsukasa, don't move back!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Aaargh! What sort of star makes his troupe worry like that?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What if Rui starts thinking about toning down the stage effects again because of this?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa! Stop stomping around, you're so loud!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Saki. Sorry about—ow!
Ughhh!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa! Are you okay, Tsukasa?
You stubbed your little toe against the bed pretty hard just now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I-I'm fine...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um, anyway... Don't start stomping around all of a sudden, okay? We can hear you really loudly downstairs.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I'll be careful...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ugh, I even made Saki mad at me.
I'm so useless...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know. I can jump and roll around as much as I want on the bed, since the mattress should absorb the momentum.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm? Jump and roll around... Absorb...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's it! It's as simple as that!
A few days later

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Very good, everything is in place!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, what are these?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
New practice mats!
The ones we already have are either too small or too old.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When piled up, these new mats will break the fall of anyone dropping from a height, like a trap room, or—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wowee! They're so soft and fluffy♪
We should be absolutely fine even after jumping off the rooftop of the stage now☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Absolutely not!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
These mats only prevent injuries from falls.
They don't magically make you completely immune to them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So continue to stay vigilant during future practice sessions as always, understand?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not a bad idea, coming from you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What do you mean, coming from me?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well, anyway.
I am, after all, the showman of Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It is my responsibility to create an environment where the director can feel comfortable trying anything he wants!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What do you think, Rui?
Now you can go all out, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent! Then let's start today's practice now!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene, & Rui
rows.Line: Got it!
Two months before the School Festival
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Festival Committee Member
rows.Line: Alright, we need to decide what sort of thing our class will be doing for the School Festival.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Huh, I don't know...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: I can't really think of anything...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmph! Oh, for the love of...!
How can you have zero ideas?
It's the School Festival!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Or are you all waiting to hear suggestions from the world's greatest star-to-be?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that case...! I will not leave you high and dry! Here's my idea, and it is guaranteed to get you all fired up!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's do...! A play!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: (Yeah. Of course he'd say that...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You've all gone quiet? I guess that's no surprise.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: After all, I'm a famous Phoenix Wonderland actor who stars in the most exquisite productions alongside other notable actors on a less than befitting stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How anxious you must be, wondering whether amateurs such as yourselves have what it takes to perform in a play written and directed by none other than me!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: No, it's more like plays are kind of embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah. Making costumes and props would be a major pain too...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But be assured that with my guidance, you will perform well enough! Here, read my script!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A & B
rows.Line: (He's not listening to us at all!!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
This is the play I propose for this occasion.
It's a tragedy based on Romeo and Juliet.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The title is...
Romeo: Battle Royale!!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yikes, like a B-movie...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: He's not gonna let us go home until we read it, is he...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, the script is quite long, so I won't ask you to read all of it now. So I'll summarize it for you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's the story of a bloody battle between nine Romeos who all fall in love with the same woman.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Will true love shine through in this mortal combat? The Romeos are tormented by rage, yearning and doubt, but who will Juliet choose?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The finale, where the true Romeo prevails, will make the audience shed waterfalls of tears...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Pffft...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Pffft... Bwahaha! Are you for real?
You actually wrote this line? Pfffhahaha!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Oh, man! My sides...! Tenma, you're a genius!
If we're gonna do something like this, I'm in.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Huh? Why are they laughing? It's a tragedy, not a comedy.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Ah, of course! My masterful script is so brilliant, they're exhilarated at the thought of performing this play!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Anyways, the boys seemed to like it.
Now, how about the girls...?)

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line:
Hahaha. What is it?!
So Juliet's the only sensible character?

rows.Speaker: Classmate D
rows.Line:
Hehe! It like, goes beyond dumb...
But the Romeos might be kinda cute.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (As I thought, they're fans already!)

rows.Speaker: Festival Committee Member
rows.Line: Well, this seems like the only proposal we have so far... Is everyone okay with Tenma's suggestion?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Great!
One week later
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, that's it for today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene, & Rui
rows.Line: Good job, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Neneee! I'm going over the last scene one more time. Wanna help me out?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure. There's something I wanted to work on too...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Phew... Now then, what's left for the other show...? Ah, right!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Each of the nine Romeos requires a different costume and weapon. We'll also need a backdrop for the space battle...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We just finished rehearsing and you're already back to working on your play for the School Festival?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yeah. Most of them haven't done any plays since elementary school, so I've got my work cut out!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
If I'm producing a play with my class,
I need to make sure everyone enjoys it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That's a good attitude. I'm looking forward to seeing how your play shapes up.
A few weeks later

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line:
Tenma! Here's how we're doing with the costumes.
I think they'll be ready in time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent! It's not unusual for costumes to fall behind schedule, but our class is doing a fantastic job!

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: Right? Just wait. You're all gonna look awesome up there...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm counting on you!
Now, next is...

rows.Speaker: Festival Committee Member
rows.Line: Sorry, Tenma. Do you mind looking over the forms that we need to submit to the committee?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Sure, right away!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: It's weird to see him like this. I thought he was just an attention-seeking troublemaker.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah. You know what they say, It's a fine line between genius and madness.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, I can hear you!
I know you envy my talents,
but you could be nicer about it!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Okay, okay. We got it...!
But getting ready is pretty fun too...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah. I thought it was gonna be a drag...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What are you talking about? It's always fun to work on School Festival events.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah? Why?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Isn't it obvious?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because you get to be part of an amazing team...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How can it not be fun to work towards a single goal as a team?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Haha... You come up with good one-lines every once in a while...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh, expect nothing less from someone like me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Listen up, everyone!
We are making history here!
This going to be the theatrical performance!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Yeah!
A few days after the School Festival
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
There you are!
Hey, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa? What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I came to give you what you requested. Here!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh... It's a DVD of Romeo: Battle Royale!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Is that the thing we saw during the School Festival?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. It's the glorious play starring Tsukasa. I heard he was having it recorded, so I asked if I could have a copy.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, um... Great?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Do you want one too, Akito?
I can get you one tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nah, don't worry about me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No need to be shy!
I saw you sitting in the first row with Toya.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You noticed...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! I always scan the audience to see their reactions!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Such professionalism.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Heh, you know me.
On another note...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Having you in the audience was a real throwback to the past. Didn't you used to come see my shows when we were kids too?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. It brought back memories for me as well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Kids...? I heard you two have been friends for ages, but have you been doing theater for that long, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have indeed! You have to start young to become the world's greatest star! My sister and Toya used to watch my performances, and even help me practice!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I didn't do anything, I would just sit there and enjoy your shows. They were always very uplifting.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You were always so gloomy back then too...
You and classical music just didn't seem to mix...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But it's a star's job to cheer up their audience!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's why also I used to do improvised performances for Toya all the time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you did so many too. When you couldn't make do with a cast of just one, you used plushies to fill the other roles.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, like Saki's rabbit plushie!
That one's still in good shape.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's living the life in SEKAI, starring in shows alongside Miku and others.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, you seem much happier these days.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Do I? If so, that's thanks to Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Me? What did I do?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You know, Akito. You must've noticed that I became much more positive since we started singing together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Really? In that case, I owe you thanks, Akito! Toya's like a little brother to me, and he's my #2 fan after Saki!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: Hm? Hey, Tsukasa...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're Rui's friend who sat in the front row at my play with Toya and Akito!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What was your name again? Akiyama?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup, that's me♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I still vividly remember you bursting into tears laughing during the show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It wasn't really meant to make people laugh, but it's always rewarding to see the audience having a good time!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What, you mean it? I thought I might've been pretty obnoxious, but I couldn't help myself...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You should never be ashamed of reacting so naturally. They're what makes a play complete.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Care to explain?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A theatrical performance involves two groups of people: the actors on the stage and the audience watching them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The actors assume their roles and create a world for the audience to behold and be drawn into!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The audience's reactions, such as laughter, tears or anger, help them become a part of the play too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's only when everyone gathered becomes invested in the spectacle that it can reach its true potential.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So my reaction complemented your show?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Precisely! And what makes theater so exciting is that the world created by the performers and the audience is different every time. No two shows are alike!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I can see that...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (In our case, we can check everyone's comments after the fact, but it's all said and done.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (The audience and the artists creating something together... That never occurred to me...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I totally get it. Watching the audience's reactions and getting them involved is even more important at gigs.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Heh. Hehehehe. I can feel it! Akito and Akiyama's eyes are glowing with admiration!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh, easy now. Those eyes scream that you're hoping to get my autograph!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, what?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: An autograph?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Dude, I don't want your autograph...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, I'm good too...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm? Too shy to ask maybe?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, my official autograph is still a work in progress. Once I perfect it, I'll gladly sign something for you!

rows.Speaker: Akito & Mizuki
rows.Line: (Dude, I don't need it!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As a special treat, I'll even add a serial number to your autographs!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That way they'll be truly unique, and even more valuable! Hahahahaha!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Phew... I'm glad we caught the Lion Dance Robot and the pandemonium's over.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That means we can get back to pounding more mochi! Let's go Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay, Emu☆
You too, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right, so... I'll go fetch some water. I won't be long.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Where do you get all this energy from? You already made all that mochi, and ran around with the Lion Dance Robot...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It seems like we have nothing to do now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It'd be nice just to relax, but I'd feel guilty doing that. I'll see if anyone else needs help... What's going on over there?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
This reattaches here and...
Hmm. I'll need another line for this too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh dear, this part has to be exchanged too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wow, that's sooo cool!
This is what Lion Dance Robot's insides look like?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Are you interested in robots, Len?
Would you like to help me with the repairs?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sure, if that's okay! What do you need me to do?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: First, can you open the bottom compartment of my tool box? That's where I keep an assortment of small parts...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Looks like Rui has all the help he needs.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yeah. Len seems really excited too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, it looks like I can just put my feet up and enjoy a few moments of peace and quiet... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: What? You're giving up?

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: Yeah, I have to...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Aww, poor little guys...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, you're Saki's old plushie!
Long time no see!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Tsukasa!
Tsukasa, I missed you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's nice to see you again, but it looks to me like you're having some problems?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You see, they really wanted to try mochi pounding.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It would've been a great experience, but everything's too heavy for them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: True. The huge mallets weigh quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: We really wanted to celebrate the New Year with you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You know what? You can take part without doing any heavy lifting! How about you create a rhythm for us?

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: How do we do that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Simple. Just as one of the others lifts up the mallet, you shout, Yoi-sho!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That's a great idea!
It'll liven up the atmosphere too!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Yeah! I wanna try!

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright! Hey, Emu! Miku!
Can you come over here for a minute?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Let's pound some more mochi!
Are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Plushies, are you ready too?
We need you to keep the rhythm!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Ready!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Everyone's getting involved all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Isn't it nice, though? It's a New Year's celebration after all. It should be lively!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehehe!
Let's see if you can keep up with Emu and me!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, Emu! Let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Aye, aye, captain!
Nene, you ready?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Here goes! Yoi-sho!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yoi-sho! Come on, plushies!
I want to hear you!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Alright! Yoi-sho!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yoi-sho!

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: Yoi-sho!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Keep it up! Yoi-sho!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yoi-sho!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is it just me or are they going faster and faster?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ah, so you noticed! You're about to witness some serious mochi pounding!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's pick up the pace, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You got it! Let's give this mochi a good pounding! Yoi-sho!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yoi-sho!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh? Plushies! Don't fall behind!
Yoi-sho!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Yoi-sho!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
D-Did you guys have fun...?

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tanuki Plushie
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That was great.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa! Rui! Here's some of the mochi!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Finally, we get to eat!
I'm famished!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks for your help, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Time to dig in☆

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yay!
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, it's time to do the cleaning that we talked about before and couldn't do because of New Year's!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But... It looks like we're missing Rui?
It's not like him to be late...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He said he made a super-efficient cleaning robot, but he said he'd be late because getting it over here was more difficult than he expected.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well, that's Rui for you.
Shall we start without him?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Scrub-a-dub-dub!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm... It's definitely cleaner than before...
But it still looks kind of dull...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, I can't get it nice and shiny either.
Nene, how's it going for you?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
The auditorium's all clean now.
Right, Robo-Nene?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Beep. Affirmative.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. Robo-Nene's speed made picking up trash from between the seats take no time at all...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, how about this? We can have Robo-Nene polish the floor of the stage for us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, how?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Easy. We put a soapy rag over a stubbornly dirty spot, and have Robo-Nene stand on it and spin!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Instructions received. Beginning operation.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's it! Now spin! The friction alone should rub the grime right off the floor!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! The spots she pirouetted over are squeaky clean!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, all according to plan!
That floor will glow once she's done!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It seems to be working, but at this rate...
Can she really finish by the end of the day?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Um... The stage is pretty big and Robo-Nene's feet are tiny... This might not be as efficient as I hoped...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's going to be okay, guys! We just have to join in and clean the floor the same way!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, I don't think that's wise...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Watch me! And now I'll spiiin!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh. It's actually going all right.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Spiiiin...! Spinny-spiiiin...!
Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, she's spinning this way!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're on a collision course...! Aaargh!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I knew it'd end like this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ugh... I'm so dizzy...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oww... You can't compete with Robo-Nene when it comes to spinning, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, that didn't work... And the floor's still far from clean. What do we do now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe... That sounds like quite the pickle.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Better late than never, Rui! Wait, why did you bring Lion Dance Robot? I thought you were bringing a cleaning robot...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, but we'll be using Lion Dance Robot to clean.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, just how exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Just a moment.
Time to switch it on!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: WRRRR... CHOMP...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What the...? I-It's spraying water out of its mouth?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! That's amazing! The water jet's making everything sparkle!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: While I was performing maintenance on it, I decided to add a power washer.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! Why?! Can it still even be used for its original purpose now?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It looks more like a monster with a laser beam in its mouth.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A monster, you say? Well, in that case...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Muahahaha! Feel the wrath of Lionzilla!
Stubborn stains are no match for us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She gave it a name...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, let's just leave Emu with it and clean some other areas in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, Ms. Supervillain! You and Lionzilla conquer the stage while we go off to find other enemies!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Muahahaha! Leave it to us!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She's enjoying laughing like that a little too much...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I have a feeling we have another interesting year ahead of us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Interesting or chaotic?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We all know what being around Emu entails. Resistance is futile...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Time to get our turf clean and tidy!
Let's make everything shine!
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Next is the super fun, exciting and psychedelic area known as Dreamland☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa...! I used to LOVE this place as a kid!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. It's been one of your favorites since you were little. We'd always go to the Trampoline Dome, but you kept begging us to go back in for seconds or even thirds.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Don't bring up old stories like that, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ha ha ha! Forgive me, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (At first, the girls kept their distance from Saki when she started going to school again...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But it looks like they've made up and are having a great time together again.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so proud of Saki.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Ugh... He's doing that thing again...
Talking to himself and grinning like an idiot...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sure he's just glad to see that his sister and her friends are enjoying the park.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! And there's lots and lots more fun to come☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So this is the fun sort of haunted house that you and Tsukasa were talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! It's really fun, I promise♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Hm? Saki's going in with Honami...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Look after my sister, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I will. She'll be safe with me!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You sure? You get scared so easily too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-I'll be all right. Tsukasa said this attraction is for people of all ages, from little children to the elderly.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's hurry up and get in line!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh? Saki, wait!
You shouldn't be running around here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your sister and her friends seem like they're having a great time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But I am a little concerned about Saki.
You said she wasn't in very good health?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Her doctor said she's fine now.
Well, as long as she doesn't overexert herself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes... But I still worry about her sometimes too...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It still doesn't seem like she knows her limits all that well...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The other day, she spiked a fever during band practice and nearly collapsed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I caused you some trouble because of that too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That was when you said you wouldn't turn up for our rehearsal, wasn't it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. But it turned out to just be a cold and she recovered after a good night's rest.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
However, Saki doesn't want anyone else to worry about her.
Not even her own family.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So she tries to keep quiet about feeling unwell from anyone else...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But you know, when she was on the committee for her school's Sports Festival, she took part in both organizing the event and the competitions!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So I guess she's gotten better at monitoring her health and keeping her activities within reason.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
She still does occasionally forget herself...
But the girls are there to look out for her.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, having good friends is very important.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yeah. Unlike when we were kids, I can't always be by Saki's side nowadays.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's reassuring for me to know she's got friends who do that in my stead.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, it's just remarkable how caring you can be when it comes to your sister...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Are you saying I don't normally come off as a caring person...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, nothing like that.
I'm just saying that she's very lucky to have you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, of course I am...

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Is the next pair ready to go in?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes, we are♪
Let's go, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki and Honami's turn came around...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I can't wait! I can't wait!
When's it gonna be our turn?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't really care much for haunted houses...

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line:
Eeek! A skeleton!
Get away! Get away!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line: Noooo! Don't come this way...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Are they really going to be okay?
They're screaming so loud, I can hear them out here...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That must be because they're having sooo much fun! This haunted house is one of my favorites, so I'm super glad!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How can you say that when they're SCREAMING?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
This is a family-oriented attraction...
What could've made them so scared...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Don't tell me...
Maybe the real thing's in there too?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Real thing...? Like a REAL ghost?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, I really doubt that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That blasted ghost!
How dare you attack my sister and her friend!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Looks like I must exorcise it myself!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ts-Tsukasa, where are you...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, no fair! I wanna do some ghost-busting too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Well, well.
I did say she's lucky to have him,
but maybe I should take that back...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Did you see how cool that person was, Tsukasa?! They're all sparkly!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I haven't seen Saki smile like this in forever!)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And it's not just Saki... That main performer's singing and dancing is putting a huge smile on mom and dad's faces too!)

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: This is so much fun! I never want it to end... If only we could watch this every day!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know! If we can't go to the show, then...
Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Costume, script... Perfect, that should be everything!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have to give this performance all I've got, for the sake of the throngs of my loyal fans eagerly awaiting my appearance on stage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I even had a dream last night that really took me back...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That day, I realized my true calling is to become a star...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I started putting on improvised plays for Saki, trying to make my own renditions of musicals...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Hold on... Come to think of it, it was only the other day that I had Saki see me on a real stage for the first time.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I made Saki and her friends smile...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. It looks like I've come one step closer to the stars Saki and I saw when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But my goal is to become the world's greatest star!
Heh heh heh!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, that's a big grin.
What's up...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, Saki. I realized that I'm making good progress towards reaching ultimate stardom.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, that's cool! So, are you ready to head out to work?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? I am, but why do you ask...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Teehee! I was about to leave for my band practice too, so I thought we could walk together part of the way!
Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You've got a show today too?
Wow, you're so busy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is nothing. When we were just getting started as Wonderlands×Showtime, we were putting on five shows each day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Compared to then, this is much easier.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And you were out and about all day yesterday.
Don't overdo it, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm totally fine! If anything...
Having a great day out energized me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I promised Shiho that I'd make up spending the entire day on fun by practicing extra hard!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, as long as you keep it within reason.
Just make sure you take care of yourself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You got it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you're always doing so much for me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Do you remember that musical we saw?
You know, when we were little?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course. How could I ever forget?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Well, I kind of did forget until Miku, KAITO and that bunny plushie reminded me of it...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I told you I wanted to see shows like that every day, but I wasn't well enough to go out back then.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So what you did was create your own shows and perform them in front of me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What made you think of that now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um... I just thought about it recently and it made me wonder...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It was around that time when you started talking about becoming a star... Was it all for me?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. You hit the nail on its head...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You were so frail, and all I wanted was to find a way to make you happy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Musicals were the answer.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But that is just the beginning of my legend...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now my goal is to become the world's biggest star and delight the masses with my shows!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The actors from that musical we saw back then...
They captivated you, Dad, Mom... All of us!
And were just absolutely incredible!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, it's my turn to shine! I will entertain everyone that comes to watch each and every time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And of course, Saki, you'll always get to be there too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Just you wait, Saki! I... Nay, my troupe and I will bring you the best in theatrical entertainment!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our shows will spark smiles all around not just Phoenix Wonderland, but the entire world... No, the entire universe!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha! So you literally want UNIVERSAL acclaim?
Your ambitions are out of this world!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But you and your friends might just be able to do it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! There are no limits for Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ha ha ha ha ha!
Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Honestly, who do they think they are?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I never intended to butt into another family's business...! But those two were just...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa, welcome home!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, I'm home...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa, Tsukasa? Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, uhh... No, something unpleasant actually did come up...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's rare to see you this angry.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Here, try some of these chips♪
You'll feel better in no time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait... Those are your favorite!
Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Of course!
Come, sit with me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Sob*... I... I don't deserve to have such a wonderful little sister! My eyes might be starting to well up... Thank you very much, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, quit exaggerating.
So what made you so mad?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Wait... If she learns about what's going on with Emu, I'll end up making her worry too...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I witnessed these two men were berating their little sister and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It sounded like there was a specific reason behind what they did, but to go as far as they did...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ugh... Remembering it all is making my blood boil again...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They really must've been mean to her...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, they were! One of them made an insult right at her face...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The other just let it all happen and didn't feel compelled at all to stop it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! That poor girl...! She doesn't deserve to be treated like that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
