rows.Line: Right?! I don't care what their reason was! No big brother should ever act so disgracefully!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Luckily, we were there to step in. Rui even gave them a few good comebacks and really shut them up!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! Way to go, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. I thought he did magnificently as well. Unfortunately, it sounds like they'll be back sooner rather than later.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The girl's gone quiet and doesn't want to talk about it either...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We want to help her but don't know what to do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see... You really had a rough day, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here! Have some more snacks♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? What's wrong?
You seem happy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe. I was just thinking that I'm glad I have you as my big brother!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Of course you are! There is no one else like me in this world... No, this universe!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, that's not what I'm talking about!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I only speak the truth.
But what is it then?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You always put my needs first before everything else, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So that I'll be happy or won't ever be sad or...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I do...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And you're always careful about hygiene, like washing your hands and stuff, so that I don't catch a nasty bug or something...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Or when a classmate looks like they're coming down with something, you make sure that I can see them without catching what they have...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Plus, you always have a scarf and ear muffs ready to make sure I stay warm.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So what? That's all stuff any big brother should be doing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, you're wrong. As far as I know, you're the only one that dotes on their little sister this much.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? I am?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You are! There's absolutely no one else that takes better care of their little sister than you, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Maybe the only one in the entire universe!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You mean just that much to me too!
You're the best big brother out there!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which is also why I'm sure you'll be able to help that girl who's being picked on by her big brothers too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, I'm not sure. I know you will!
I believe in you, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Heh... Hehehe!
Hah hah hah hah hah!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! I am the winged horse that soars through the skies! The world will know the name, Tsukasa Tenma! Nay! Tsukasa the Pegasus!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I am the greatest big brother of all, and destined to be the greatest star ever! Anything is possible for me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! You can do it!
Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Just you wait, Saki! I will succeed!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I still don't know what Emu is actually dealing with, but I won't just let her suffer like this!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We'll find a way to help her somehow!)
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey. Have you finished cleaning up...? Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Why's Emu sitting all alone in the corner over there...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What if...? Is she letting something eat away at her again without telling us anything?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu, what's wrong? What aren't you telling us?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If there's something on your mind, wouldn't it be better if the four of us dealt with it together?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's okay! You can tell me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks! In that case... Let's figure out what kind of butterfly this caterpillar will turn into!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? A ca-ca-caterpillar?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! See! It has this cute pattern on its side...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Eeeek...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, you fool! Don't come any closer!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That sharp look in her eyes...! Is what I just said bothering her that much?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No, jokes don't work on her. She could come at me at any moment. I should just try to let her down nice and easy...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, hahaha. Emu, you jest. Would you mind not coming any closer to me with that?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Tsukasa, are you okay? What happened all the sudden? Did you eat something weird?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Guh?! I said don't come any closer...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! Today was so much fun, wasn't it♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, really...? I guess you feel much better now so... Hahaha...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We'll clean up the rest while you take a break, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then let's race to see who can clean up the most! Yahohoy♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Sigh*... Being Emu's plaything is tougher than any practice or rehearsal.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sometimes it feels harder than putting all of Rui's ideas into practice...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: You...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Bwah?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He's always with Emu... What does he want with me?!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Wait! Maybe it's because I called Emu a name during that little squabble...!)

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: I never thought this sort of day would come...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Thank you for supporting Ms. Emu...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Ms. Emu is rather stubborn...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: She wishes to see everyone smile... She wishes to protect those smiles and is more determined than anyone else in that matter...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: And she was most afraid of doing something to rob someone of their precious smile...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. It does seem that way...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: As much as we'd like to be more sympathetic to her ideas, we are unfortunately in no position to do so.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: By doing so, we would no longer be able to physically be by her side...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: But you were able to cross that line... You were able to overcome that hurdle...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Thanks to your efforts, it seems like Ms. Emu will open up more now...

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Which is also why you are not to take any half-measures regarding this matter.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Half-measures? Who is that directed towards? There's no way any of us won't do everything we can.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How can we make others smile if we can't make one of our own friends smile first?

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: Good. Don't ever forget that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, a star never breaks any promises. Stand witness to what we are about to achieve!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa, I'm back!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You seemed to be chatting up a storm with Mr. Mascot. Anything interesting?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, it was nothing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He essentially told me to look out for our stubborn little princess here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Stubborn? Princess? Who's that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Who else could it be other than you?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! We have a mountain that's too high and a valley that's too low to deal with!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are you sure that's actually how that goes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Forget the details!
I'm doing it. That's that!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe♪ I'm not really sure what you're talking about, but... Yay☆
Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Just one week left until the Doll Festival...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Saki's in good health as well, so she should finally be able to enjoy it the way she deserves.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Her being in the hospital made it so she really couldn't enjoy it properly, but we can make up for all of that this year!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which is why my little surprise is going to play a vital role in this celebration.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehehe. She won't know what to do with herself when she finds out what I'm getting her!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But first, I need to find out what kind to get and where...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa? You're still awake?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-Yes! Yes, I am...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're up late as well...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, yeah... I'm just...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was always in the hospital around this time of year, so my mind's been sort of wandering in that direction...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then I saw that the light was still on in your room, so I came to take a peek...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I know you're not alone anymore, but I couldn't help myself...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: You have to go home soon, don't you, Tsukasa...?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're right, I do...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: It'll be dark by the time you get home...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It'll be dark and I'll be all alone.)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: If you ever start feeling lonely, Saki, just try thinking about all the plays and books we talked about!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: That way, you'll feel better knowing that we can play tomorrow and fall right asleep!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
Okay...!
You're really coming tomorrow too, right?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course! I'll come back tomorrow and we can compete to see who finds that man in the striped shirt the fastest!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I really like those books, so you won't beat me that easily!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Saki's always seemed like she was happy and full of energy, but I knew she didn't like having to spend nights at the hospital all by herself...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I thought everything would be okay now that she's finally back home with us but...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki, would you like me to make us some cocoa?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks, Tsukasa...
But I'm okay...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I feel better after just talking to you a little.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm not scared of being all alone at night anymore.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know that you, mom and dad are right here with me now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, I can chat with Ichi and the girls until I doze off too now♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki, you know that's not good for you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I know, but it's so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, I can finally go to bed after each day knowing that I had fun and I'm enjoying life!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I fall asleep each night so excited about what I'm gonna do tomorrow too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki, you still remember that...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I do. It's just like you said, Tsukasa. Think about what was fun that day and what you'll be doing the next.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sleeping is a part of that fun for me too♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. But you need to be careful not to oversleep too. You don't want your perfect attendance to be blemished, do you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's true.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So off to bed with you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay. Don't stay up too late either, Tsukasa.
Good night...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good night, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's make this year's Doll Festival the best ever!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, it will be!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I haven't been here since the Doll Festival ended...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What Luka said really made me think. Thanks to her, I was able to make up with Saki and give her the Doll Festival party she truly deserved.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (As a star, I must show her my gratitude!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't see her. Maybe I should look by the stage next...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, there she is!
Hey, Luka...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh?!
Did she just collapse?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
L-Luka!
What happened?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Mhm... Huh?
Oh... Hello, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What happened to you?!
Are you alright?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright? Why do you ask?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because you just collapsed!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Wait, I did...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! Don't you remember?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh really?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I just felt so sleepy just now and felt like rolling around on the grass.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...!
You can sleep just about anywhere...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I was wondering who was causing such a commotion, but it was you two...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, KAITO!
Thank goodness you're here...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I thought I saw Luka collapse just now and tried calling out to her...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But she was actually just sleep and wanted to lie down somewhere, no?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, exactly. I was worried there for a second...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I appreciate your concern for her.
Also, what brings you here today?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I apologize for not reporting in sooner, but I came here to tell Luka that I managed to make up with Saki.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She decided to start using both the old and new dolls together from now on.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Aww, that's nice.
And how did the party go...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent! Saki, her friends, myself and even my own friends were all able to celebrate together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: After I opened with a customary toast, we all chowed down on her favorite snacks and potato chips!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Go on...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We played cards and even had a nail biter of a game of Old Maid!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And it's all thanks to you that everything went so well, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You were a lifesaver... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, is she...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. She fell asleep while standing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: H-How...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, at least I was able to tell her before she did. I'd rather not wake her, so I'll be going now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Come back anytime, okay?
Miku and Len even said they miss you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I will. See you later.

rows.Speaker: Luka's Voice
rows.Line: That's nice... So many smiles... Good for you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, thank you very much!
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This show is all about making everyone remember just what kind of park Phoenix Wonderland is.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By including every troupe and all the staff, we'll be able to put on a performance unlike any other.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, when do you plan on putting on this show...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I received a nice tip regarding that. It seems that Emu's brothers and their prospective partner will be inspecting the park at the beginning of next month on the last day of the Show Contest.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd like this show to open then.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So there's a real possibility of the Show Contest being cancelled...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Gasp*! You're right! And we came out on top for this round! We did it, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
R-Really?!
Are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We did it!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We're still behind them in overall score, but victory is within our reach. Everything hinges on the final round of shows.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're right on the coattails of the Phoenix Stage in terms of points for the Show Contest too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our Halloween and Christmas shows have clearly shown that we've been getting better and better each time...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! This means we're more than capable of outdoing the Phoenix Stage...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is what I'd like to stand up and say...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This commercial was supposed to be my chance to finally show the world just how talented I am and how much I shine in the spotlight...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, nevermind that! We're doing this for Emu and all those smiling faces that truly love Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Saki included. This park helped create so many wonderful memories for us...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Emu's right. Phoenix Wonderland needs to stay that way.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, Saki.
Yes, what is it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm about to fix up some ice cream for myself. Do you want some too?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, excellent! That would be lovely!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay! Oh, also...
Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: When you left the house this morning, you seemed really excited and shouted that Project Something Something was about to start...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But just now, you were clutching your head like something was really bothering you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, do you mean Project Wonder? That is all set and ready to go!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can't wait for everything to get underway! Hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's only making me worry more...
There's something going on, isn't there?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Hmm... If I'm not careful here, she'll start feeling even more concerned...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I assure you, it's nothing...
Something unexpected came up is all.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Are you in trouble or something?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's that... Project Wonder is a top secret mission that I'm on and not exactly privy to telling you much more than this...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Think of it as having two treasure chests...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Treasure chests?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Imagine that there are two treasure chests sitting right in front of you. You also happen to know that both contain unimaginable spoils.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In my current situation, I know exactly which chest I should choose...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I should choose it but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The other one contains something that I've been seeking for such a long time and would not know what to do without it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But fear not.
I dealt with this predicament and decided which to choose just now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I won't be looking back as I open the chest that I should be opening!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. That's great!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, about that ice cream I mentioned. Our choices are chocolate chip and vanilla. Which do you want, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, let me think... Which are you getting, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whichever one you don't get!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? But you should have the first pick, no?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No! I'd rather have the one you don't want, Tsukasa♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyways, you better hurry or they'll both start melting...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay. Chocolate chip it is!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, why don't we just share them both?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? But...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why not have them both together instead of separately?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Our choice was clear from the start...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This treasure chest is bound to contain a way that'll help accomplish our immediate goals and make our dreams come true.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No, we will find a way!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, we're gonna need some bowls! I'll go get some!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Appreciate it, Saki!
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! Project Wonder went off without a hitch, and once Emu gets here, let's start talking about what sorts of shows we'll be doing moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, including what we'll be doing as ambassadors as well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it sounds like Wonderlands×Showtime has gotten pretty famous now too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We may have the Show Contest to thank for that since we sat at #1 or #2 through its duration.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right. At the same time, things don't really feel all that different.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, everyone! Thanks for waiting...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There you are, Emu. Don't worry, we just got here as well...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! W-Where are you going, Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What are you guys doing all the way over here?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're the one that flew past us...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. There must be a reason you hurried over here like that. Would you like to tell us?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I was just talking to my brothers about us becoming ambassadors♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Great! They did mention something about us performing at venues outside this park...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Does that mean it's actually happening?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, not yet!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gah... Then what is it?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Uh... They said that it's really important and wanted to sit down with us to talk about it...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So they want to set up a meeting.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, this is quite a big step we'll be taking for Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As they say, Rome wasn't built in a day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot! They also said that because it's us, people are expecting to see more super amazing stuff like the show we just did♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is that so? Your brothers have finally realized that the sky's the limit for us?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. This world will finally be able to bear witness to my greatness.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ignoring what he just said, what kinds of shows are we gonna be putting on exactly?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I have to think that we'll be performing in places with much bigger crowds...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... Somewhere away from this park where lots and lots of people hang out...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know! It's the Scramble Crossing!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's literally right there...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are you sure your brothers don't want us to go somewhere, you know, a little further away...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, that could actually work.
It's somewhere people of all ages gather, including tourists!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're kidding, right?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I see. There's also hardly ever a time when that station isn't busy, so performing around there may not be a bad idea.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We may even be given the opportunity to participate in various events throughout the country.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're for this, Rui?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We're free to speculate all we want, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We could even adjust the themes of each of our shows to match the local cultures of the places we visit. Wouldn't that be something?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...! Like, um...!
If we go somewhere that snows a lot, we could have a whole show about snowmen♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that would be brilliant!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, fine... Do whatever you like...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And if it's somewhere by the sea, we could do a show that takes place underwater!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that too...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, how on earth would we do that?!

rows.Speaker: Rui & Emu
rows.Line: Aww...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why are you giving me that look?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because it would've been fun to do a show underwater...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I know...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Anyways!
Wherever it is we do end up going, what we do won't change!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll be bringing joy to everyone with our shows...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehehe. Yes, I agree.
Well said, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I appreciate your ideas, but an underwater show is going a little too far...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But this is when you're supposed to say, Leave it to me!
You're supposed to take on these sorts of challenges, Tsukasa...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But you're saying no to this...!
Why...? Why, Tsukasa...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Please, Rui, don't cry...!
Tsukasa, you big meanie! Stop bullying Rui!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, okay. You won't fool me with this sort of farce. Right, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa, you horrible, horrible person...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You too?! Don't you all realize just how hard it's going to be to do an entire show underwater?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We'll be fine. You can handle all of the tough parts.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't dump it all on me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Regardless, until we get more details about what we'll be doing, we still have to put on shows here as we always have.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup♪ Oh, I know!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Until we do know more, what if we do a show about us becoming Phoenix Wonderland's ambassadors?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. Now that we have some name recognition, it could help create even more buzz for us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. That's actually a pretty good idea, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Nene liked my idea♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, then we'll run with that idea for our next show!
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, it's about to get dark!
Let's call it a day!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪ Great work, everyone☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, nice work today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now to clean everything up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. Let's start with the big props...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, uh... Before we do, can I say something?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is your tummy rumbling?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, Emu, that's you.
It's that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There's something I'd like to ask you guys to do...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ask us?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
This is rare...
No matter. Ask away!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Have you guys heard about the VIRTUAL SINGER Fan Festival event that's happening soon...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. And it's held each year to celebrate and show appreciation for VIRTUAL SINGERS...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, now that you mention it, I do vaguely recall. But what is it that you'd like to ask of us?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, my friends and I are gonna be performing and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-You and your friends...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, and... Well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: One of them's having a little trouble with their dance sequence, I was wondering if we could invite them here and help them out a little...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ne... Ne...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nene's going to bring her friends here?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
K-Keep it down, will you?!
You don't need to yell...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I can't help it...!
You, Nene Kusanagi, bringing friends over?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All you do at school is play games on your phone all alone...! Not only that, you don't really like talking to strangers...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But... But you have real friends!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Can I slap him now...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. There, there.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, Nene, what are your friends like?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Yes, of course...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll need to hear all about them so that we can put on a welcoming party for them!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, that really won't be necessary.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway... You guys already know Hoshino. She's actually the one who told me about the Fan Festival.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, Ichika! She's liked Miku for as long as I can remember, and I even remember her saying that she wanted to perform in this event one day.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Then there's Azusawa.
She's the one Emu calls “Hammie”.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, our #1 fan.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh wow! That means we get to have practice with Ichika and Kohane! Yay☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, there's also one more.
She's an idol from a group called MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: MORE MORE JUMP!...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, she also goes to Miya Girls.
I'm sure you already know her, Emu. Her name's Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, you mean Minori?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. She's actually who I was originally talking about. I was hoping that we could help her out a little.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This might sort of fall squarely on your shoulders, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I don't mind.
But about her group's name. I could've sword I'd heard it before... MORE MORE...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When we went to the highlands to train, right? Airi Momoi and Shizuku Hinomori are also a part of that group...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, I knew it!
It's Airi Momoi's group!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You know about them, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki's a huge fan!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm actually more surprised by the fact that Rui seems to know who they are. Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I don't know actually them personally or anything. There's a couple of degrees of separation between us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: One of them being Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, of course!
Akiyama does seem to know quite a few people.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mizuki? Akiyama...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, you haven't met them yet, have you, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mizuki and I went to the same junior high school, and is currently a first year at Kamiyama.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mizuki's even the one who designed my and Nene and Robo-Nene's costumes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa! Your friend made those!
That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, hold on!
This is news to me!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Same.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, pardon my indiscretion.
I wasn't sure if it was okay for me to tell anyone this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nonsense! If what you say is true, your friend has been a key part of Wonderlands×Showtime's success from the very beginning!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'd like to thank your friend for what they've done for us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: M-Me too...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It seems a little late to...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because you didn't tell us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanna join too since you're all going to say thank you♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You don't go to our school, so you'll just have to wait!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Aww...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's a little late for that too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haha.
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, finally!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! You're here!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Welcome, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And still, Luka can sleep through all this racket...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: To her, it may sound like some sort of lullaby.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Nene! Nene!
How'd the Fan Festival go? Was it fun?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You practiced a lot with your friends, right? Tell us how everything went!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, okay. Will you all just calm down?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We'll be rehearsing on stage today, so mind telling us after we make our way over?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, sure.
Let's go, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, okay.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You guys saw Nene sing too, right, Emu, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! We even got to see everyone else perform so we've got lots to talk about!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wonderful! We'd love to hear all about it♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Luka, wake up!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We'll have to do our best not to disappoint.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They always get so worked up each time we visit here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Never a dull moment. Anyway, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, let's... Hm? Come to think of it, I haven't seen any sign of Miku. Especially since she's usually the one charging into all of our conversations.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, she's a little busy right now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Mind if we chat for a minute once we get to the stage?

rows.Speaker: Mikudayo Mascot
rows.Line: Mikudayo☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Aaahhhhh!!
Huh? Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's been so long that I'd completely forgotten. That was quite an entrance.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sorry, I didn't mean to startle you like that. I'm sure you've already guessed...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, Miku's the one inside.

rows.Speaker: Mikudayo Mascot
rows.Line: That's right. Mikudayo♪

rows.Speaker: Mikudayo Mascot
rows.Line: Operation: Miku's Big Surprise was all ready to go, but I couldn't move all of a sudden...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Mikudayo's leg got wedged in and stuck while off stage, and I couldn't get her out myself.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I was going to ask MEIKO but...
I was afraid that she'd get a little carried away...

rows.Speaker: Mikudayo Mascot
rows.Line: Then, Mikudayo would've been in real danger. Maybe in many pieces too.

rows.Speaker: Mikudayo Mascot
rows.Line: But you saved me last time, Tsukasa♪ I feel much better now that you're here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: O-Okay...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, you need a hand, yes?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, here we go... One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Mikudayo Mascot
rows.Line:
Oh, there! I'm free!
Thanks, KAITO, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Mikudayo Mascot
rows.Line: I'm free☆ I'm finally free☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There she goes...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe she wants to show herself off to Emu and the others.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you for your help, Tsukasa. And thank you for always looking after Miku like this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, it's the least I can do considering everything you've all done for us. I should be the one thanking you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, thank you, for all the help you've given us.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It seems only fitting since the VIRTUAL SINGER Fan Festival was held just recently.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. There's no need to be so formal. We're all friends here, aren't we?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We just enjoy seeing the way you and your troupe have grown, and we feel so much joy when you make real progress.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, I see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Y-Yes? Why are you looking at me like that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Just the other day, MEIKO was talking about how you're turning into the plushies' father of sorts, and I finally understood what she meant by that just now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha... I'd really rather be their “big brother” instead of their “father”...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Regardless, your “siblings” already seem like quite a handful...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Not necessarily.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They do run me ragged sometimes, but it always ends up being fun in the end.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You know what I mean by that, don't you, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The joy you feel whenever any of your siblings smiles and laughs.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I do!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When someone I care about feels happy, I can't help but feel happy myself.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Smiles are really incredible, aren't they?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And shows serve as a source of those smiles!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, they certainly do.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's keep making as many shows as we can.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and make as many people as we can smile from ear to ear!
Airport

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Oh, that was quick.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What was quick?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I just let Saki know that we're in the United States and she already sent back a reply.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <Whoa! All the signs and stuff are in English! And it's still light out over there! I can't believe you're actually in America!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <You had me worried for a second when you came running home to grab a change of clothes, but I'm glad you guys made it!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And I'll let her know by saying...
<We should be just fine now.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, what did Saki say when you told her about us going to visit the United States?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What did she say? She naturally gave us her blessing and said, “Go learn as much as you can!”
A few days earlier
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! As in the United States of America...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I've already mentioned this to Mom, but we'll be going there to visit Riley Dream Park.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course, to see what their shows are like.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, I'm so jealous...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're talking about THE Riley Dream Park, right? The huge theme park that's always on TV and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know you're gonna be busy learning about how they do things over there, but do you think you could get something for me?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Absolutely! We're supposed to have time to go around the park, so finding a few souvenirs shouldn't be an issue!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! Thanks, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, Saki, I'll only be gone a few days, so try not to feel too lonely.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And be sure to do whatever Mom says, alright? Don't forget to brush your teeth, try not to stay up too late and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm in high school now, Tsukasa!
I'm not a little kid anymore!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Honestly, I could be saying the same for you. Be careful while you're over there, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're gonna be jet lagged on top of having to deal with a language barrier.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah hah!
Those are non-issues for a future star such as myself!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still, you keep saying “future star”, but that future could be just around the corner...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, you guys were chosen to become ambassadors for Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I still remember when you went off to that interview to become a cast member like it was yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Audition, not interview!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha! Yeah, that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But you guys really are amazing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Your troupe was doing tons of shows every day while I was still just thinking that it'd be fun to be in a band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sure, we've decided to try and go pro together, and even started doing shows at a live house... But we still don't really know how to draw a crowd.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Chalk it up to growing pains.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We didn't start off on the right foot either. Our first show was a disaster and had to work very hard just to get back to square one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We were scrambling just to do five shows in one day while trying to make as many people as we could smile.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You guys went through that too...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Does that mean our band's gonna be able to do what you guys can do if we work hard enough?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You girls have been working diligently every day and even have a set goal in mind! To become professional musicians!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm sure your efforts will be rewarded.
Or rather... It's up to all of you to make it happen!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's up to us...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right!
It's our dream after all!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Exactly! So listen up, Saki.
“You have to make your own luck, and working hard will help you do that.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Those are the words of a star that I admire and I've taken that to heart!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You yourself will have to make your own luck and create your own opportunities because fate is not so kind or generous!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. Fate might be pushing it a bit too far.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But thanks, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I promise to keep doing my best, so go learn as much as you can, okay?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I will!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Saki's right. I should see, experience and learn as much as possible while I'm here!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And as her brother, as well as someone who's also chasing after a dream, I'll need to set a good example for her!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I knew something was up when he just suddenly clammed up. Look at that dumb grin on his face...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Maybe Saki sent him a funny reply?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Who knows? Also, we seem to be trailing Emu's brothers by quite a bit now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What?! W-Wait for us!
I'm not about to get lost just after arriving!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
C-Come back, Tsukasa!
We're gonna get left behind!
A few days after returning
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone, let's begin exchanging information regarding what we all learned from our trip to Riley Dream Park!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You all made sure to write everything down, right?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I missed this... We were only gone for a few days, but this idiotic banter really makes it feel like we've come home.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We definitely had plenty to discuss while we were in the U.S., but there really is nothing quite like being back at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nene, Rui! Focus!
Do you have your lists ready?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah. Also, we're just bouncing ideas off each other, not having a focused discussion.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I get that you're excited about getting back on stage but we need to get back to practicing, so can we get this over with?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right.
Alright, let's begin!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, me! Pick me! When I saw how big and sparkly the main entrance was, I yelled, “Wowee♪”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, I see!
What did she mean by that, Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You could try a little harder...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The main entrance was indeed spectacular and does a very good job of getting all the visitors excited about the park. I was impressed by it as well.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, what he said♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You expected me to figure all that out?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, I felt the same thing. That park had a way of overwhelming visitors with its majesty.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too. My favorite part was when all these buildings and objects I'd seen in the movies came into view after passing through the gate. I really felt like a kid again.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not only that, each area had a wonderful design to it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course, the castle from “The Little Kingdom” was magnificent, but I was absolutely staggered by how realistic the “Jungle Music” area felt.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We even got to hear how they consulted with actual botanists, constructed those imitation trees and even researched how jungles smell.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! It totally felt like we were in a real jungle!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, the shows we saw were the biggest surprise for me. They were all way too good.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Every time from start to finish, I was on the edge of my seat waiting to see what happens next.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, how each cast member portrayed their respective characters and the quality of their action sequences blew me away.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
In particular, that one wire stunt...
They somehow made it seem as if they weren't using any wires or contraptions at all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But they must also know some clever tricks to be able to pull that off...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And above all else, the sheer acting ability of each cast member was beyond astonishing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They all stayed in character even while putting on those wire harnesses during that one scene. It was as if they'd somehow become a part of their characters' costumes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. Normally, you'd put them on while off the stage, but they made it a part of their act.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If I were to do that scene right now, I doubt I'd be able to maintain my composure the way they did.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I can't even begin to imagine how much they had to practice to achieve such acting ability...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The king and prince especially... Their struggle seemed so real... They felt... Alive...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...? Hello...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You seemed deep in thought just now.
Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, sorry.
I was just going over that one show we saw in my head.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know how you feel. The scenes that completely blew me away immediately pop back into my head every time I start thinking about that show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Because it really was a super amazing show!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed. We should thank Mr. Riley for giving us the chance to see it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we definitely should!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I believe that's everything in terms of what impressed us the most during our trip!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I've got everything written down too☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it might take a while until we're able to use some of these ideas in our shows.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To be fair, our stage, as well as this park, aren't exactly on the same scale.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But we can use what we learned to make up for that!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. I'm sure we'll be drawing upon what we experienced quite a bit moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup♪ My heart's going vroom-vroom already☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As is mine!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Since we're setting out to put on shows that can make everybody smile, we'll need to put a polish on our existing ones first!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Yeah!
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, that should be enough practice for today...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We seem to be coming along nicely.
At this pace, we'll be ready just in time for our next regular showing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. All we really need to do at this point is work on how we present ourselves and polish up the climax.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, me next!
I wanna keep practicing our song☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's going to be the most crucial part of our show. Why not?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we work on that this weekend?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, aren't they doing maintenance on the stage this weekend? I thought we couldn't practice because of that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You are correct. As such, we'll have to practice over in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We need the stage to work out the finer details in terms of how we present ourselves as we rehearse, but we can practice our song without a stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I'm sure some of us have already made plans for then since this was originally scheduled as a break, so this practice won't be mandatory.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Woohoo! Practice in SEKAI♪
I'm totally going☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I think I'll go too.
Honestly, I'll probably just end up playing games all day if I don't.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How about you, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
My apologies.
I'm scheduled to work as an extra for a show this weekend, so I won't be able to join you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
That's too bad.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
An extra for a show?
Like that time you were in a flash mob for a wedding?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! We ran into some trouble, which led to me asking Toya and Rui for their help...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But things are going to be different this time! I plan on using this opportunity to grow and shine as an actor!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, where will you be performing following our little wedding stunt?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll be in a surprise show at the Chocolate Factory. As its name suggests, it's a place where chocolate is made.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Th-The Chocolate Factory?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it opened just recently too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: On top of having a museum, the visitors will apparently have a chance to make their own chocolate-based sweets in this massive kitchen area.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I've heard about other places like that... But what kind of show are you gonna be doing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It is after all a surprise.
The visitors won't know what's coming, and we won't have any idea as to how they're going to react to it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It'll be a wonderful challenge!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A star such as myself needs to be able to keep a show going regardless of the situation...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't know what this place will have in store for me, but I'll just have to deal with whatever comes my way!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. Real experience is certainly a good way to learn how to flexibly handle any issue.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Break a leg, Tsukasa☆
Also, watch out for sudden tummy aches.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I plan to not eat too much or too little the night before in order to prevent that from happening.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be fair, what happened that other time wasn't really your fault.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. But if something like that does happen again, you're always free to give us a call.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I appreciate it.
However...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's another matter that I've been meaning to discuss with you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
See you! Get home safe!
Don't forget to look both ways before crossing any streets!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So what is it that you'd like to discuss...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Rui, it's almost White Day.
Do you already know what you're getting Emu and the others?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, so that's what this is about.
I'm building some mini robots for them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They'll even be able to pop out chocolates when someone says, “I'd like some chocolate.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: R-Robots with voice recognition...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I'm not much of a cook, so I plan to just buy some chocolates while letting my other skills speak for themselves.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I take it you're still undecided?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Correct...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, Nene, Rui!
Happy Valentine's Day!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Is this?!
A chocolate cake?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I had a feeling that you were up to something, Emu, but I wasn't expecting anything like this... I mean, you made this cake, right...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
This is incredible!
Look at all the plushies that are lined up together!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, they appear to be macarons.
It must've taken quite a bit of effort to create such a masterpiece of a cake.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Baking that cake must've taken a monumental effort.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm worried that I won't be able to match that at all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I don't blame you. Fortunately, you still have some time to come up with a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Speaking of which, I saw KAITO and Len also working on something. You may want to ask them as well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see.
I'll do that the next chance I get...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Rui's already come up with an idea for a return gift based on his own skills...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Which means I should do the same!)
A few days after White Day
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, what to do about lunch today...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm still undecided.
Oh, is that...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, if it isn't Toya and Akito... Akiyama's with them today too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're right. When's the last time we saw them? White Day?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I haven't had a chance to ask how White Day went for them...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we ask them to join us for lunch...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Toya, Akito, Akiyama!
Are you about to have lunch?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, are you two about to have lunch as well?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We are. Why don't we all have lunch together?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Really?
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that sounds great! This should be fun♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Fun...?
Don't you mean obnoxious?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Oh, Tsukasa.
I heard that your show at the Chocolate Factory went very well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, did Akito and Akiyama tell you already?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, they did. I wish I was there to see your performance.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. As I.
It was incredible to hear how the three of you ended up having to cheer up Tsukasa's fellow cast member.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, exactly. Being able to cheer them up while keeping the show going is no small feat, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I wouldn't have been able to do that on my own.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Akiyama! Akito!
That show wouldn't have gone so well without you two. Thank you both very much!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: First the wedding flash mob, and now this... Seriously, what are the odds...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But you did a magnificent job!
You were so good with the little ones too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, you were like their bright and cheerful big brother♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, there's something I'd like to ask you two.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Were you able to give everyone the chocolates you made that day?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? I mean, yeah...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi and Azusawa seemed to really enjoy what you made.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. And yours was for everyone in your music group, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Signed, sealed and delivered♪
They loved the fact that I made everything myself.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank goodness.
Especially after the trouble you had to go through to make them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As for me, I put on a special White Day show for my sister and the other members of our troupe.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That was a superb spectacle!
I honestly didn't see that coming.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, what?! You gotta tell us more!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahahaha! Did that get your attention? Then, allow me to show you some pictures of what happened!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The chocolatey White Day gift I made for Saki and the others looked like... This!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's a chocolate Pegasus!
It's so lifelike! I mean, look at its wings! This is way too good!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: After wrapping our show at the Chocolate Factory, I had some of the staff there help me put this together.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is definitely something only you could come up with, Tsukasa. I'm sure Saki didn't know what to do with herself when she saw this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! They were hesitant to eat it because it was so cute that they took countless pictures before they did!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it's very you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But if I'm gonna be honest, I'd be asking a lot of questions if someone ever gave me anything like this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I can see why.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's only natural for a star such as myself to bedazzle an audience in such a manner!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez, what's the view like from up there?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha!
Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I really struggled to get a grasp of my character for our show as ambassadors this time around.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However! I was able to expand my acting range and take a big step towards becoming a star! Well done, me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line:
Um, Tsukasa.
Are you free right now? There's something I want you to do for me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Saki?
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. So you also don't have practice today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm still gonna work on some stuff on my own later though♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But before I do that, I wanna try playing the piano with you since it's been so long♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, piano four hands! How long has it been?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's my point! Seeing you practice for your show really made me want to play!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, can we try “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” together♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? This bench feels so small.
It looked so much bigger when we were little.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's proof that we've both grown up since then.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's been so long since we last played “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” together, but it's like we still know what to do.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (She used to have so much trouble playing when she was little, but now, she's far better than I am.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (To be fair, she's been practicing every day with her band. I'm so proud of you, Saki.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Man, that was so much fun!
Thanks for playing with me, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The pleasure was all mine.
Don't hesitate to ask if you ever feel like playing together again!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa, do you remember the day I was discharged from the hospital? You know, right before I was supposed to start back up at school?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Yes, I still remember.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I couldn't go pick you up with Mom and Dad because I had school that day, so I was forced to anxiously await your return.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But I became so antsy that...
That's right. I ended up playing the piano to pass the time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! You even put on a show for me!
That really weird improv one!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What do you mean “weird”?
I put everything I had into that show, you know?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But you wore this really tight and glossy jacket, remember? It looked so weird and you even put on a mustache, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it looked good on you for some reason! And the way you sang with a deep voice sounded really nice too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was literally just discharged from the hospital and you had me laugh so hard that my sides started hurting.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right. You and Mom were rolling on the floor laughing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! Just thinking about it makes me giggle.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You playing the piano and putting on a show for me that time really put my mind at ease.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Put you at ease?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah. I could finally say, “I'm home.”
That actually almost made me cry.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That includes right now too.
Hearing you on the piano or practicing lines makes it feel like I'm really home♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Not only that, whenever I'm having trouble writing or practicing a song, I open my door just a crack to listen to your voice as you practice, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My voice?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Because hearing your voice always makes me feel a lot better!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, remember how Thorpe always looked up to the stars whenever he felt stuck?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. This is just my guess... But Thorpe has his stars, while I have you, Tsukasa♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... In that case...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Tenma, written as “soaring Pegasus”!
Tsukasa, meaning to govern!
I am Tsukasa Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The one destined to become a world-famous star whose light never wanes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If you ever feel lost, I shall be there with my brilliance to show you the way!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Hahaha...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa, you know that makes you sound more like the sun instead of a star, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Yes, point taken, but it works either way since they're essentially one and the same!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And you still just gloss over the details...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But in any case. Thanks, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're very welcome!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh! Yay! It's Tsukasa and the others☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Welcome, everyone.
Here to work on your show again?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, we're here to report on our ambassadorial show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We know we caused you and the others quite a bit of trouble this time around, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, precisely.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All because I couldn't properly get into character. Not only did it affect the way we practice, but I also had to ask you over and over again for help.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As a result, I made you and Rui worry about me... Luckily, my struggles are what allowed me to understand Thorpe better and fill his shoes during our show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, KAITO, Miku, thank you both very much! Our show wouldn't have gone so well without either of you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We already knew that♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, how?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Were you there to see our show?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup♪ We were sooo curious that we couldn't help but go have a look!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It was also a chance for us to see Tsukasa etch a new facet for himself as an actor.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You did a wonderful job as Thorpe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I did?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. You took a hard look at your character, refused to compromise or give up, and put on a magnificent performance in the end.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wow! That means a lot coming from you, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I wouldn't have been able to examine Thorpe in such a manner on my own.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, you suggested that I find something in common with him. I probably would never have understood Thorpe the way I do now if it weren't for that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, thank you for giving me such wonderful advice!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I just did what any good director's supposed to do.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And you did everything you could as an actor. That's really all that happened.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You say that, but I know you were worried about him...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? I could say the same for you, Nene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? I... I was just...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I wasn't worried about him personally.
I was worried about whether or not we could actually do our show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, Nene, you were worried about me too?! That means I need to apologize to you as well!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Again, I was worried about our show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I understand!
Thank you, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. But we all believed that you'd figure everything out, Tsukasa♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, you're our super twinkly star in the sky☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha! I know exactly what you're trying to say! After all, I'm a future star!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ding ding ding ding ding! That's right!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, that's what you meant?
I thought you were talking about how he's always being launched sky high.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That also seems correct, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I thought it was that too♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Quit trying to turn me into a star in space! And don't make it sound like I'm a human cannonball! That only happens from time to time!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're all in perfect sync with one another. You've come such a long way as a troupe.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we have. It's always a pleasure seeing how these slapstick routines play out after someone gets the ball rolling with a funny quip or remark.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, is that supposed to be a compliment?! Honestly, is slapstick all that you're after?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Of course, it's a compliment.
As a troupe, it's important for us to be on the same page.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Especially since no one person can put on a truly great show on their own.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I believe your willingness to take challenges head on is going to have a positive effect on our shows moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, since I took a big step forward in terms of being a future star!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, we'll be going back to putting on shows as usual until our next assignment as ambassadors comes in, so let's keep polishing what we can in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm in too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Break a leg, everyone!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That concludes our debrief for today's show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland will be undergoing some scheduled maintenance tomorrow, so the Wonder Stage will also be closed. Please take this opportunity to rest and recharge!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line:
Okay♪
Okay.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What is it, Rui...?
Why are you snickering while looking my way?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, is that what you saw?
In that case, you were just imagining things.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your smile is only making me more concerned... But we'll leave it at that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By the way, Tsukasa, your birthday is fast approaching, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's right☆ Promise to visit on the day of, okay?! We can all celebrate together♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, thank you, KAITO, Miku!
Yes, I promise to visit. It'd be great to do a show as well!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For now, see you later!
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa, welcome home!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Perfect timing too.
Here. This is addressed to you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What's this? A small package...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll be practicing in my room♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course. Thank you, Saki.
Now, who sent me this package...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It's from... “The fan of a future star”?!
Ah, I must open this at once!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Let's see what's inside... Hm?
Just a sealed white letter?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If it's fan mail... No, this seems too anachronistic. It's straight out of a historical movie or something.

rows.Speaker: Sealed White Letter
rows.Line: “Letter of Challenge”...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I-It's actually one of these...?!

rows.Speaker: Sealed White Letter
rows.Line:
“Letter of Challenge...
To the so-called 'future star' who unwittingly opened this little package...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! Ah, this is supposed to be some sort of mind game or psychological trap?!

rows.Speaker: Sealed White Letter
rows.Line: “Calling yourself a 'future star' is all well and good, but it is high time you showed me your true capabilities.”

rows.Speaker: Sealed White Letter
rows.Line: “Thus, I have prepared three trials for you. As for what they entail... Hehehe. You'll just have to wait and find out.”

rows.Speaker: Sealed White Letter
rows.Line: “Of course, whether or not you accept this challenge is entirely up to you. After all, not partaking in a game you know you will lose is a valid stratagem.”

rows.Speaker: Sealed White Letter
rows.Line: “However, if you wish to accept, stand before the Phenny statue in Phoenix Wonderland tomorrow at noon.”

rows.Speaker: Sealed White Letter
rows.Line: “Feel grateful that I chose a familiar location that will allow you to spread your wings and put your full potential on display.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr! I have no idea who this person is, but I can already hear them cackling like a hyena!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So be it! As a future star, I shall show them just who they're dealing with here!
The next day

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh! Rui! Rui!
Saki says that Tsukasa just left their house!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you, Emu.
Alright, all according to plan so far.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Operation Big Birthday Surprise is go!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I still can't believe your brothers agreed to let us do this. Lucky for us, we get to hog the park since it's closed today.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. They said it's a special treat because we've been going so well as ambassadors♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We really need to thank all of you as well for helping us. This wonderful surprise wouldn't have been possible without your support.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I was hoping to give back somehow since you always put on such fun shows and even celebrated my own birthday!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I owe Tsukasa quite a lot as well, so I'm glad you asked me to help with this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Totally!
Let's give him a big celebration together, Li'l Bro♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? I don't really owe him anything and I didn't ask to be a part of this. If anything, I was dragged in.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You say that, but you seemed pretty excited when we were setting up all the trials.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We appreciate you joining us today as well. I really wasn't expecting you to agree to this.
Oh? I'm just interested in putting our self-proclaimed “future star” to the test is all.
It's important to see if he's worthy of representing Phoenix Wonderland as an ambassador moving forward.
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That letter said to stand in front of the Phenny statue... Which should be this one...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? I spy a suspicious-looking digital timer and tablet. Does this mean I'm supposed to look at the tablet...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's see... “Trial 1. Perfectly memorize the dance routine in the video within five minutes.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?! The video's already playing?!
Wait, the timer's counting down too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. But I have nothing to worry about. I'm more than used to dealing with Rui, Emu, Miku and the others' antics at this point.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This dance routine's nothing like the musical numbers I'm more familiar with learning.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I see... The dancers in the video aren't letting their centers drift at all. Not only that, their footwork's outstanding!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But they're wearing their hats in such a way that I can't see their faces. Still, why does it feel like I've seen them before somewhere...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, no! The first trial's underway! I need to focus on memorizing the dance routine!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
One, two, three, four...!
One, two... Done!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah hah!
How's that?! In less than five minutes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? That sound...
It certainly gives me the impression that I passed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, the tablet's showing a map now!
I see. My next stop is just in front of the Trampoline Dome.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah hah!
I shall elegantly achieve perfection with the next trial as well!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess that dance was too easy...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, it definitely wasn't.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
