rows.Line: The video itself was like a minute and a half, so that's two play-throughs tops given the time limit.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: True. To be fair, I practiced dancing it with Akito, but I couldn't learn it in five minutes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Plus, it involves some tricky steps and really quick turns.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. But Tsukasa looked so cool when he got it down.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
He even seemed to enjoy it towards the end.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Grr...
I should've picked a tougher one.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha! You're just like Ena!
She hates losing so much♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, our big surprise is still rolling, so let's hurry and get the next spot set up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. We'll need to make sure he has fun all the way through until the end.
Phoenix Wonderland
Outside the Fluffy☆Trampoline Dome

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, there it is! The second trial!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... This time, there's a box for drawings or raffles, a video camera and a handwritten set of instructions. I'll start by reading it.

rows.Speaker: Handwritten Instructions
rows.Line:
“Trial 2: Improv!
Draw three topics from the box and face the camera when you're ready to perform!”

rows.Speaker: Handwritten Instructions
rows.Line: “Warning! You're not allowed to redraw your topics, so choose carefully! Anyway, good luck♪”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, an improvised show.
This is definitely my strong suit, but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The way these instructions are written...
It feels so different from the original letter, and I've seen this handwriting before somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(No, this can't be Saki.
There's no reason for her to write such a letter or cooperate with the sender.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
For now, I'll draw my topics!
Three, was it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's see... “Space”, “Band” and “Plushies”...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. The second trial's going to be a cakewalk for me. Does it not realize how many improv plays I've put on for Saki?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright... Action!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yesss!
Sounds like I passed!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But where am I supposed to go next?
The instructions I read just now didn't make any mention of that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, there's more on the back...

rows.Speaker: Reverse of the Handwritten Instructions
rows.Line: “If you hear the signal that you've passed, go to the location of the final trial. The Wonder Stage♪”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The Wonder Stage?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's essentially giving me a home-field advantage. Bring it on!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa's play was so good☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it was. Not only did he incorporate each topic rather nicely, but he even came up with a fun story.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A space alien who sets its sights on Earth after invading countless other worlds but must take possession of a plushie to adapt to the environment.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, it discovers the beauty of music after learning that the owner of the plushie used to play in a band.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The finale was also pretty good considering he made it up on the spot.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To think that the space alien tells its friends all about music and decides to set out on a journey to spread what he learned far and wide instead of invading.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Tsukasa certainly has a talent for telling these kinds of stories.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Oh, did the camera get everything?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it's all recorded.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank goodness! We really should show Saki and the others this since they couldn't make it today♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. We owe them that much for coming up with all these topics for us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, why don't we start making our way over to the location for the final trial?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's nothing here. Where is everyone...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I was under the impression that the sender of that letter would be waiting for me here...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, I've come this far!
Quit hiding and show yourself!
Let us get this final trial of yours underway!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Or are you too scared to face me?
Don't tell me you've run off already.
Who said anything about running?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: It's been quite a while since we last spoke like this, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Y-You're...!
Sakurako Seiryuin?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Indeed. None other than the prima donna of the number one show stage in Phoenix Wonderland... Sakurako Seiryuin!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: And it is I who sent you that letter of challenge!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Thank you for the dull reaction.
Anyway, it's time to start the final trial.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Which simply involves... Acting!
Why don't you show me some of the performances you did as an ambassador that were touted as being so wonderfully elegant?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I know all of “A Pianist Named Thorpe,” so choose whichever scene suits your fancy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You say that... But I can't really do much without a piano...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Not to worry.
Bring it up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! A piano?! From the trapdoor?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I had it brought over from the Phoenix Stage, so you're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Talk about being prepared!
Well played, Sakurako Seiryuin...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, just sit back and watch!
Behold, the new heights I've reached as an actor...!

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “They're finally gone. I can practice in peace now... But there might not be any point now since the contest is tomorrow.”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
I only have half a day left...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “The stars... They're so beautiful...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“And it's the day of the contest.
Thanks to them, I was hardly able to practice at all...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“The seats are... Oh, it's a full house.
I'm getting dizzy just thinking about having to play in front of all of them.”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “No, I just want to...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “I just want to keep playing.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How's that, Sakurako Seiryuin?!
Enjoy my rendition of Thorpe?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Hey, Sakurako Seiryuin, you there?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Ugh! Will you be quiet?!
I was trying to immerse myself in the music!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: S-Sorry!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, why am I the one who's apologizing?! Also, did I pass this trial?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
You really have to ask...?
You passed! Happy?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: But I see that you're capable of more than just obnoxiously loud acting now...
I agree. Our troupe leader has come quite a long way, no?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?! What are you all doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Apologies for pulling one over on you like this, Tsukasa. We were actually all behind that letter you received.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. It's a little early, but we wanted to celebrate your birthday by having a big surprise.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! This is a birthday surprise?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get your confusion...
Having the birthday boy undergo a bunch of trials still sorta doesn't make much sense to me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? It's because things are much more fun and thrilling this way.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... I'd expect no less from you, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You would've likely seen right through a more rudimentary plan. Also, you seemed to have fun during our little trials.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I most certainly did!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. As a reward for overcoming all of these trials, we'd like you to join us for a special party.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A special party?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ready, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An & Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yes!
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Tsukasa☆

rows.Speaker: Rui, Nene & Sakurako
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa

rows.Line: Let's see... What can we use as blankets or covers...? Aha...!

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, Rui!
I found something that's perfect!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's odd...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui? Hello?

rows.Line: What's he doing with his face stuck in the bushes?

rows.Line:

Ah, Tsukasa, perfect.

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey A
rows.Line: Ook! Ook ook!

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey B
rows.Line: Ook! Oook!

rows.Line: Ook... Ook?

rows.Line:
I'm seeing three baby monkeys...
What about them?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Just keep watching.
Those monkeys all seem to have a very different personality from one another.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: First, the one swinging around that branch seems fairly assertive. That other one is happily going along with its antics while the third is timidly hunched over.

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey A
rows.Line: Ook! Ook!

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey B
rows.Line: Ook! Oook♪

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey C
rows.Line: O-Ook... Ook...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'm starting to see their individual personalities...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Interesting. And then, you can...

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey A
rows.Line: Ook! Ook ook!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Hey, you guys, guess what?!>

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey A
rows.Line: Ook! Oook!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <The big folk that walked into our territory earlier... They're called “humans”!>

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey B
rows.Line: Ook! Oook!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Yes, grandfather's told me stories about them!>

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey C
rows.Line: Ook... Ook?

rows.Line: <Those monkeys looked so strange. Which forest do you think they came from?>

rows.Speaker: Baby Monkey A
rows.Line: Ook! Ook ook!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
<Not a forest!
They came from beyond the salty water!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe... Something along those lines?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You caught me off guard when you suddenly started doing voices for them, but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Believing that humans are monkeys who came from another forest and the way they described seawater... It was very interesting...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wasn't it? It was a fun way to get in some acting practice, but it was also a nice way to work on getting in character by learning how others think and see the world.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, Tsukasa, if you were in those monkeys' shoes, how would you describe the cruiser we arrived here on?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well... A big box...? No...
The concept of a box may be foreign to them...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Metal? White? Triangle? No...
Those concepts may also be beyond their grasp.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm... This is harder than I thought.
How would you describe our cruiser, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, they might see it as a large fish with a tough exterior or a strangely hard stone that can somehow float on the water...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see. A giant fish seems plausible.
But I'm less sure about it being a rock.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That was predicated on those monkeys being able to discern that our cruiser isn't a living creature.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And like you said, Tsukasa, “metal” may be a foreign concept to them. That's why I thought it'd be better to call it something other than “metal”.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's identifiable by how hard it is, so I simply guessed that they'd end up calling it some sort of rock or stone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's cool to the touch as well, so they may even expand upon that by calling it a type of cool stone.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, now I understand! That explains your stone idea!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, is there more to that conversation you just voiced?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: More? Not exactly, but I did come up with some ideas as to how their conversation would've continued.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They'll feel compelled to go down by the water, see that we're trying to fix our vessel and set sail by stealing it somehow.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And they'll go on a big adventure! That's wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Unfortunately, we'd be stranded here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
And we've been chatting up a storm.
We should probably start working on getting our living space set up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Right... That does take priority...
Still, why don't we keep talking while we work?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can see it now! A fantastic adventure about humans getting lost in a forest full of monkeys where they learn to work together despite not being able to communicate through speech!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that does sound fantastic.
Let's discuss that further!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, first, the part about not being able to communicate seems like the most interesting part, since there could be instances where some wires get crossed...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay!!

rows.Line: We haven't been able to talk to KAITO or the others since last night, so it'd be nice to tell them that help has arrived...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But not being able to tell KAITO and the others that we're okay...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I don't care what happens.
Rui, let's give it a shot!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay...
Robo-Nene.

rows.Line:
Understood!
Commencing charge sequence.
Please connect this cord to your phone.

rows.Line: Okay! Like this...?

rows.Line:
Hey, it's charging!
Does this mean it's working?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent! Hang in there, phone!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: <Oh, is our connection back?!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO's Voice
rows.Line:
<I think so!
Hello! Tsukasa! Everyone!>

rows.Line:
<I'm here too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The hologram feature must be malfunctioning.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It did take a swim in the ocean after all. Tsukasa, it may be wise to say what you need to and turn off your phone.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
MEIKO, KAITO, Miku!
Please tell the others that we're all safe!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A helicopter just came to rescue us too! So, we should be able to get off this island and go do our show!

rows.Speaker: KAITO's Voice
rows.Line: <Your show?! It's really happening?!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that seems to be the case.
We've come this far, so we're going to give it everything we have!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, we likely won't be able to visit you until we get our phones fixed.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: <That's okay! We'll be waiting for you all to return to us happy and healthy♪>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We absolutely really, really promise to visit when we can, so please wait for us until then!

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: <Okay! See you then☆>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad we got a chance to tell them that we're okay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So am I! Let's make sure our ambassadorial performance goes well so that we have good news to report the next time we see them!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes.

rows.Line: “Hmph... You're a machine. Speak when you are spoken to.”

rows.Line: Alright, everyone, nice work today!

rows.Line: Nice work!

rows.Line: (That last scene didn't go the way I'd hoped.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm definitely still having trouble gauging just how much human expression I'm supposed to be using...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Understood. Please excuse my insolence.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm... No, that isn't right either...
I'm giving a quick response like I should, but I need to hold back my emotions less.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Nice work today.
About the last scene we just did...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Understood. Please excuse my insolence.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, now I'm emoting a bit too much.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, this is the scene where he decides to speak to Sergeant Willis after seeing her at odds with herself. I doubt he's going to be completely devoid of emotions...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup! I agree!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Same. I know it's not easy, but I think you should be a little more expressive.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I had a feeling...
But you're right. Let's try to... Wait, Emu?! Nene?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. You finally noticed!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How long have you two been here?
Also, were you listening to everything I said just now?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hold on. You really didn't think anyone else would hear...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. For a conversation that you thought you were having with yourself, it was very audible.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! Rui?! Asahi?! You're also here?!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I know how you feel. I also had trouble getting a good grasp of that part.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You too, Asahi?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yes. It's so difficult to gauge how much of which emotions to use...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Which in turn changes the image of how I envision Bartlett speaking and behaving in the later scenes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You did seem to deliberately act more robotically there towards the end.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: He's being reprogrammed by the military, so it seemed appropriate to show how his humanity is being chipped away.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: However, despite slowly losing his humanity, something seems to linger and persist within Bartlett.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That something is what I believe caused Bartlett to say what he does to Sergeant Willis.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Something lingering inside him...
How that scene is portrayed may vary greatly depending on what that actually is...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It's just my interpretation, but I hope that helps.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, very!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll take that into account while thinking more about this scene. And I'll return tomorrow ready to give a better performance!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That's great! I'm looking forward to seeing what you come up with!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
I promise to find an answer that I feel is satisfactory!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hey, don't forget to tell me too.
I'm the one who has to do that scene with you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I won't! Don't worry!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Strange... I wasn't able to give my best performance today, but I feel fantastic.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This is completely different from what I went through when trying to play Thorpe. Maybe it's because I'm not as lost as I was that time.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's as if each of my experiences is guiding me and telling me what to do...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'll be going now!
See you all tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: See you tomorrow, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
He really is interesting...
And such a conscientious actor.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, he is.

Stationery Store

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Let's see... Aha!
Here it is!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're getting... A notepad?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yes, it's nice to have one that fits in my pocket.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Not only that, the paper stays clean even when I get all sweaty after moving around a lot. It's very useful.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can see why. I too carry around a notepad sometimes during practice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But it usually ends up a crumpled mess afterwards...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
You too, Tsukasa?!
Then, I really recommend that you get this!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh, but you should take it out when doing a performance that involves being submerged in water. I remember ruining one that I'd just bought after forgetting I had it in my pocket.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Submerged in water?
I'm interested in what this show of yours was about...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll try using this notepad!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Awesome! It'll be great to see someone else using it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, I saw you using your notepad a few times during practice today. Can I ask what you like to write in it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to know as well!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: During practice, I usually just write acting notes in it.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: But for shows like this where I work with new people, I like to also jot down some things about them.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I mean, if you want to put on a good show, you need to know what your fellow actors' personalities and acting styles are like!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I agree!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But you said, “During practice”...
Do you use it outside of practice as well?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yes, I try to write down anything that catches my attention or piques my interest while living life each day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: While living life each day...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yes. Acting involves deliberately speaking and behaving in specific ways based on the roles we're assigned to play, right?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
But normal people don't act.
They do certain things subconsciously.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Tucking their hair behind their ear, touching their arms, moving their eyes up and down...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Those simple acts become the basis of people's personalities.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That's why I've made it a habit to try and see all the little things that they do.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: But I have to be careful not to stare too much since doing that probably makes me look pretty weird!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Even outside of practices, Asahi does whatever he can to improve his acting skills...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Which explains why he's able to put on such incredibly realistic performances.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We always seem to learn so much from these conversations.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! A new discovery each time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I also take notes to make sure I don't forget about what I learn during practices, but I've been writing considerably more after we started practicing with you and the cast members of ArcLand, Asahi.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It's nice to hear that we've been helping.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You have! Still, I feel like we've been doing all the taking... If only we could give back somehow...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: But you already have.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
A lead with a wonderful aura and incredible acting range.
An actor with a vivid imagination and the ability to easily perform all these acrobatic stunts...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
A songstress with peerless singing skills and the ability to handle delicate stories and characters with ease.
And of course, a director who can conjure up unexpected stunts and effects for any genre!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Because you're all so interesting, practicing each day with you has been an absolute pleasure!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Hm? You don't seem to believe me.
But you can tell I'm right based on how my fellow cast members have been behaving. They all look like they've been having a lot of fun, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, they have.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: How we're doing it doesn't matter. The fact is that we've been influencing each other in a positive manner over this past month.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: So, I'm looking forward to performing with all of you again tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, the feeling is mutual!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. I almost forgot that we're here to buy confetti. I didn't mean to let my own shopping get in the way.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not a problem! The store just happens to be right over there.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, shall we?

rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Welcome home, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Saki, you're home.
How did things go afterwards?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We took a bunch of pics to celebrate, practiced a little and went home after that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. Sounds like you had a fun New Year's.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. You guys definitely had way more fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, I knew that you'd be performing, but I really wasn't expecting to run into you the way we did.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, you guys ran off saying that you had to get to your next location. Where'd you guys go after doing that show at the beach?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A mountain! After that, we went to a ski resort and the mall!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It ended up being a wonderful experience since we ran into so many familiar faces along the way. We also learned quite a bit as we did each show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa! That's a ton of traveling...!
You must be exhausted!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And starving since you had to move around so much.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right...
I had a few bites here and there along the way...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. But you could use a real meal.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That'd be nice.
Unfortunately, I'll just have to wait since we won't be having dinner for some time...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You worked really hard today, Tsukasa, so you should have something to eat if you're that hungry!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mom! Tsukasa's hungry!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Oh, the New Year's food won't be ready for a while... Would you like some mochi in the meantime?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that'd be great!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mom, I want some too!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Sure, dear. How many would you both like?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How many? I'd like...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, stop!
Tsukasa, lemme guess how many you want!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Then, I'll guess how many you'd like to have.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, on three♪
One, two...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Saki
rows.Line:
One!
Three!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
One! You got it!
Nice guess, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. We do still have dinner to think about.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You also guessed how many I wanted correctly. I suppose I should expect no less from my little sister.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
I also had a feeling that you didn't want to be too full.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: In that case, I have another question for you two. How would you like to have them?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sweet soybean powder, right, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! And you want it with...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehehe. Can you read my mind, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmmm... Hm!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I got it!
Two wrapped in seaweed and one with sweet soybean powder!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that's correct!
Well done, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heehee! I know everything there is to know about you, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Then, would you like to try reading my mind?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Saki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know! You need us to set the table!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No! She needs us to get the seaweed and soybean powder ready!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
You're both correct.
I know you're tired, but I'd really appreciate it if you did those things.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Saki, I'll set up the table.
You head to the kitchen!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Roger dodger!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone.
This seems like a good place to take a break.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? A break? Already?
I can still keep going...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I kinda need a break.
We've been practicing for like three hours now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What? Is that true?!
In that case, we should rest for a bit.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, and hydrate.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, let's all take a break☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Nene, here's some water!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You don't sound like you need a break... But thanks.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, Tsukasa, you're so focused today.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...! You got this look in your eye!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I thought the same thing!
Your eyes are all zingy! And you're going zoom-zoom-zoom when you move!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Zingy? Zoom-zoom-zoom?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... I believe they're trying to say that you're moving like you mean it and that you look very serious while doing it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! That's it, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Correctomundo♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Again, how does he always know...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No idea...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But I agree with them.
You look like you're more motivated than usual, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh...
Is it that obvious?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The truth is, after we finished doing our little tour, I've been wanting to grow more as an actor!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our escapade allowed us to perform in all sorts of different places with a wide variety of people.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Remember how each show went a bit differently depending on who ended up helping us?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! When Honami and her friends sang for us at the beach, we changed our dance routine a little☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. And MORE MORE JUMP! did an amazing job of interacting with the audience when we performed on top of that mountain.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly! The same goes for when Shiraishi and her partner helped us, as well as Yoisaki!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We gained and learned much because we performed alongside different people compared to normal in places we don't usually go.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I felt the same thing when we performed with Asahi and his troupe the other day. So, I believe new encounters can lead to new discoveries!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And there are plenty of people out there that we have yet to meet!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, that means...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The more new people you meet, the more new things you stand to learn or gain, which may lead to further growth, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What do you all say?! How exciting would it be to make such discoveries?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm getting excited just at the thought of that☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too! Me too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I understand how you feel, Tsukasa, but accomplishing that really won't be easy...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. But it's something we'd expect you to say.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I agree.
The power of positivity makes dreams come true.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha! That is exactly my point!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let us take what we learned from the shows we just did and propel ourselves forward this year!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Bear witness as I, Tsukasa Tenma, future star... No, wait...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Bear witness as I, Tsukasa Tenma, future superstar, accomplish feats of true greatness!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Miku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Now that he's feeling better, I'll be looking forward to what the future has in store for us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, he seems like he's back to normal.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe.
Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The workshop finally begins tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll need to thank Emu and the others again for allowing me to attend.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree with what you're saying, Tsukasa. This is a wonderful opportunity that you should take full advantage of. Please, don't mind us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, he's right!
Especially since you're gonna be a star in the future!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So, I'll be rooting for you!
Go Tsukasa! We believe in you☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
They even cheered for me.
So, I'll need to learn as much as I can!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I should also contact Asahi since he's the one who told me about it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: First, I have to thank him and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, he responded.
Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “The director has a rather unique personality, but you should be fine since you're used to working with Rui. Break a leg.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? A unique personality...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This director's supposed to be very famous in the showbiz world, and I hear his name come up quite a lot. But I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, there's no reason for me to hesitate! Like Asahi says, I'm already used to working with an eccentric director!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll be ready for whatever or whoever is thrown at me!
The day of the workshop
Workshop Venue

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, this must be it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I was afraid that I'd arrived too early, but there's already quite a few people here.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, that person's from the Kinmokusei Theatre Company...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(No, it's not just them...
Everyone here seems to be an established TV, film or stage actor.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And I get to learn alongside them today...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (There was no way I would've found this workshop if Asahi hadn't told me about it.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I must make the most of this opportunity!)

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line: Hey, who's the guy that just walked in...?

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line: No idea. But he looks familiar...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Those two are looking right at me!
I should take this opportunity to greet them!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's a pleasure to meet you! My name is Tsukasa Tenma! I perform for one of the stages at Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland...?

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line: Wait, I remember now...! You guys did a show with Genbu, right?! And came up with the night show everyone online was talking about!

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line: Really?! I saw that on social media too. My jaw hit the floor when I actually went to see it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
Th-Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line: Haha. Relax, we're all here to attend the same workshop, so you're surrounded by friends. Also, I'm guessing we're close to the same age.

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line: Yeah. Who belongs where, seniority and all that don't really matter since we're not here to work.

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line: What he said. So, Tenma, it's nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That's right... Them, me... We're all actors here to attend the same workshop.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We're not just here to learn more about acting. We're here to push each other to become better!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, thank you! I'm looking forward to working with you!
Ah, is everyone already here...?

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Let's do a quick head count... Yes, everyone appears to be present, and eager to start learning.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: So, we'll begin slightly ahead of schedule. I am the director who will be leading this workshop...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I've seen him do interviews on TV and for newspapers before, but he seems like a kind and mild-mannered fellow...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm not sensing anything out of the ordinary like Asahi said...)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: We'll only be together for a short time, but I look forward to working with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & the Actors
rows.Line: Thank you for having us!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Why don't you all start by introducing yourselves?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Ah, self introductions! My forte!
This is my chance to show everyone how...)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: You will all take turns playing the same character and reciting the same lines from this script.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh?
The same character? A script?

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Hehe. You are all actors after all.
Please show us all who “you” are through this role.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: We'll see how many of your names I remember by the end of all this...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (In other words, if we don't meet his expectations, he's not going to bother remembering who we are!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (N-Now I see... There is more to him than meets the eye.)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
You all have a script now, yes?
We'll begin once you've had a chance to ask questions.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No, I have to stay focused...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(This script... It's just one page...?
The character's name is... Taro Sato, who works as a salesman and is introducing himself...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (How are we supposed to distinguish ourselves with such a simple set of lines...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This isn't going to be easy. However...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's also very intriguing! I've never had to introduce myself in such a way before!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Alright, I'm going to do my absolute best to make sure he learns my name!)
Workshop Venue

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: We only have a few days left together, so I hope you all make the most of our remaining time by learning as much as possible.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & the Actors
rows.Line: We will!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Now, let's put the sword-fighting exercises you did earlier into practice by using them in a scene.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “*Roar*”

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line:
“Ah, you've some skill...
I remember when you were just a pipsqueak.”

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line:
“Unfortunately...
It's no use...!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Urgh...! Grr...!”

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line: “What happened? You seemed so confident a second ago.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“...!
I cannot lose... Not to the likes of you!”

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Mr. Pegasus...
You misunderstand what your character is feeling.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Yes, it's natural for one to raise their voice during a scene such as this...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: But “you” already know that victory will not be achievable at this rate. You must not forget that grief and despair linger in the back of your mind.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Please, allow me to try that again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sorry to bother you during your break!

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line: No problem, Pegasus. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, um... Would you mind practicing with me for a bit? I'd like to work on what the director just said.

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line:
Hey, that sounds fun!
Lemme join too, Pegasus!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, excellent! Thank you very much! But...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Do you all need to call me by that name...?

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line:
Huh? I think it's cute.
Pegasus seems like a great nickname.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't feel happy about that at all!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How did this happen...?
I didn't even do my usual “Tenma, written as 'soaring pegasus'” bit! Why am I being called “Pegasus” by everyone now?!

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line: Don't ask me. Also, you have your own catchphrase? You're just a gift that keeps on giving, huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is this some sort of penalty for not being able to immediately produce results? Is that why I wasn't called by my actual name sooner...?

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line: Yes, it did take a while for you to be called by your name, but I think he's taken a real liking to you now...

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree.
I mean, he totally cracked up when you introduced yourself.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Once more, you will all be introducing yourselves by playing the same role and reciting the same lines. Please present to me what you are capable of as actors.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Any questions...?
Ah, you there.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you! How many versions of “me” am I allowed to present?!

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line:
Uh, Tenma...?
You're not suddenly believing that you have superpowers or something, right...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What are you talking about?!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Hehe. In other words, you'd like for me to see a few different renditions of “yourself”, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh! Yes, that's what I meant!

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line: How were we supposed to know?

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line: Tenma, we just met, so I'm not sure if I should say this, but have people ever told you that you're pretty weird?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's not...!
Well, yes...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Unfortunately, the director of my troupe and I have been given the honor of being called the Weirdo Wombo Combo.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Hehehe... Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm starting to understand why Genbu told you about this workshop.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Now, about your introduction...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: You are all actors, so I'm sure it wasn't easy deciding how you wish to portray yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: However, since you were all so eager to get here, we were able to start early, so who don't you all do two renditions?“

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line: Man, you definitely left an impression back there.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But my acting was a mess...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm struggling to get an insight into your character's background and self based on your portrayal.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
It tells me nothing about who you are.
Anyway, next...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He's right. My acting felt thin that time. It had no depth to it.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (When I perform as a member of Wonderlands×Showtime, I get to do shows based on well-written scripts...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Which is why I've had no trouble bringing the characters I play and their stories to life!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It took me quite some time to figure that out and find a solution, but I somehow managed in the end!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Because I was chosen to play the lead as Peter Pan!)

rows.Speaker: Actor A
rows.Line: Look, Pegasus is making weird faces again.

rows.Speaker: Actor B
rows.Line:
Hey, Pegasus.
Earth to Pegasus!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?! Pardon me. I was deep in thought.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start practicing our parts!

rows.Speaker: Actors A & B
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!
Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Another day, another failed attempt at grasping my character during practice...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But I'm beginning to understand how hard it is to get by on just water. So, I just need to keep doing what I can to understand Rio better.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm already home.
Time flies when you mull things over, I suppose.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I can't let Saki see the downcast expression that's on my face right now...)
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm back!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(...!
This smell...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Welcome home, Tsukasa♪
Guess what? We're having curry for dinner tonight!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I knew it...! But...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! Did you forget that I'd be eating out today...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
You said you guys would all go out for food after practice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, how was practice?
Do you think you're gonna get to play the boy for “The Happy Phoenix”?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Oh... I shouldn't deceive her too much...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I-I'm still not sure...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because I'm competing against all these great actors from the park's number one stage! And on top of that, it's a fairly tricky role!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. You say that, but your face is telling me that you feel pretty good about this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
R-Really?
Hah hah hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No! I revealed too much of the truth...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I believe in you, Tsukasa!
I'm sure you'll do just fine♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you, Saki! I appreciate it!
The next day
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (My stomach won't stop grumbling...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(But Rio also experienced this pain.
I can't let myself forget that...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Excuse me...
Is Tsukasa here right now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Ah, Toya.
I'm right here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Toya...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, it's nothing that important...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But the actor you told me about will be performing on stage soon, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Are you talking about Mr. Amami's show...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As much as I want to go see him, I need to keep practicing for my audition...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Toya...?
You've been staring at my face this entire time...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Toya...
Is there something else that you'd like to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We've known each other for how long? Please, don't hesitate.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The thing is, just yesterday, I messaged Saki to see if she would take one of my claw machine prize plushies...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That was when she mentioned you were acting a bit different.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. That's why you're here right now. To make sure I'm doing okay...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm sorry...
I know I'm being very nosy, but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, it's okay.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (All this lying and deception is definitely starting to confuse everyone, including myself...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I apologize, Toya.
I've actually been practicing for a role in this very big show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I'm struggling to get a grasp of my character. Saki may've felt something was off because I had so much on my mind when I discussed this with her.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right, she also mentioned that you've been practicing for a big show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll be sure to tell her that there's no need to worry. And thank you for showing so much concern.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I understand. It sounds like a tough role, but you also put on an incredible performance as Thorpe that other time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I'm sure you'll do just fine.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I believe in you, Tsukasa!
I'm sure you'll do just fine♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I promise to do my best and not disappoint any of you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course. Now, if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right, I should send Saki a message.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (They believe in me...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (They're all giving me their support.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I still have a few days left until the audition. They've placed their faith in me, so I need to figure out how to play Rio!)
Diner

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Do you all have your drinks, everyone?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then I'll do the honors, but before that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Allow me to say just how much I appreciate all of you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This audition... It was a tough ordeal, to say the least...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I felt so lost and stumbled multiple times along the way. I wasn't sure the current me would be up to the challenge, and I nearly gave up at certain points...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And yet, you were all willing to believe in me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You all supported me when I decided to survive on nothing but water for three days and nights. I couldn't have done that by myself.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, we get how you feel.
So, let's...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I greatly appreciate what you all did for me! No, I can't thank you enough!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Especially since the star I admire, Mr. Amami, also played Rio...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hold up, Tsukasa!
We've had our arms up this whole time, and mine's starting to get really tired...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We know that there's quite a lot that you wish to talk about. But for now, why don't you get our party started for us?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Yes, I suppose.
Then...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Here's to me being selected to play Rio...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu, Rui & Nene
rows.Line:
Cheers!
Cheers☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ahh...! I feel a wonderful fizz filling up my stomach!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
Tsukasa, are you back to eating normally?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, since I wanted to go into today's audition with a full stomach. So, this morning...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! Your tummy just gave a huge growl!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You have every right to feel hungry after putting on such a magnificent performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You just asked for a drink so you could lead the cheer, but wouldn't it have been better to order some food too...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You may be right, but... That's odd. Until just now, I didn't really feel hungry at all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's understandable that these things would slip your mind considering how focused you were on preparing for the audition.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But you're finally able to relax now that it's over.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that may be it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But my battle is just beginning!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I need to keep practicing so that our show becomes an unforgettable one—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Grr. Silence, stomach!
Can't you see that I was on a roll?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: For now, let's get some food.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Tsukasa, you gotta eat lots and lots today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Excuse me! Can we have one of everything on this page?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, slow down!
Yes, I'm hungry, but I can't eat all that!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yeah, Emu.
That's the page for Salisbury steaks. We should choose some stuff from the other pages.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's not what I meant!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. For now, why don't we each order something for ourselves?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What? Don't you guys want to share some fries? Oh, fried chicken too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, the page for sides. Yes, let's order some.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That's all fried and greasy...
Can't we get something a little healthier?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Unfortunately, this place doesn't seem to serve anything of that sort.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, quit covering up the salads!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... Pasta sounds good, but so does a Salisbury steak...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nene! Nene!
Let's get both and split them☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, good idea.
Let's do that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know what I'm getting! Steak and curry!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: To split with Rui?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, for myself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. You must be famished.
Anyway, I'm also ready to order.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excuse me! We're ready to order!
One week before Tsukasa's birthday
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa! The bath's ready. Do you want to get in fi—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ahaha, you really want to go first that badly? Okay then, just let me know when you're out♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Will do...
No, wait. That's not why I'm here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is for you, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aw, the envelope is decorated with a bunch of bunnies!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see... “To my dearest beloved sister, Saki Tenma”... “You are invited to attend the Tsukasa Tenma Birthday Festival”?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? You're not hosting your own birthday party, are you?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I am indeed! But it is more than just a mere birthday celebration...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This party will be dedicated to those who have continued to support me!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ooh! But, why this all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not long ago, I was researching shows when I happened upon an article about an actor's birthday event.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The actor said, “Birthdays shouldn't serve to celebrate the day you were born, but rather to thank others for the life you have led,” and I couldn't agree more.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see! And so you decided to do the same!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly! I've fine-tuned the festival program to ensure that all guests have the experience of a lifetime!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! I can't wait to see what you've got in store for us!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, so does that mean you've finished preparing for it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, I've got my hands full right now trying to make all the invites as soon as possible.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My birthday is only a week away. I have to hand these out before everyone's schedules fill up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In that case, I'll help you make them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? I must say, I'm grateful for the offer, but you do realize that you're one of my special guests, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Pretty pleeease? Making them looks fun, and at this rate, I'll be the only one there to enjoy your amazing party that you worked so hard to put together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Come ooon...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Fine, okay. I'll give in and accept your gracious offer!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, who else are you making the invites for? Is there anything else I can help with? Tell me, tell me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, now, calm down, Saki. Let's start with the guest list...

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line: Saki, have you and Tsukasa decided who's going to take a bath first?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right, we almost forgot about that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's pick up where we left off once we're both done. We're going to put on the best party ever, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's go, go, go!
Tsukasa's birthday

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Boy, I'm really looking forward to Tsukasa's birthday party♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, although I didn't expect him to suddenly thrust an invitation into my hands...and such a cute one at that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: From what I heard, Saki also had a hand in the preparations, too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If I recall, Tsukasa's house is just around this corner... Ah, there it is.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... Wait, do you guys see that sign in front of the house?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I see it! It says... “This way to the Tsukasa Tenma Birthday Festival”♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, a sign that colorful stands right out. We definitely know that we're in the right place.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Did he have to make it that flamboyant?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe☆
I'm already super hyped, so let's hurry up and go inside!
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Emu, Nene, Rui! Welcome to the Tsukasa Tenma Birthday Festival!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Please wait here for a moment♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Tsukasa! Everyone's here already!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I expected you would all be invited too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we received Saki and Tsukasa's handmade invitations.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They had quite the design...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: At first, I didn't know that Saki had helped, and I was surprised that Tsukasa had decorated them like that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, you're saying that you were amazed Tsukasa decorated them so beautifully?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, of course not...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We were so surprised because it was so unexpected.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, I don't see Aoyagi. Has he still not arrived?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: About that... Toya tried to keep today free for this, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: He said that the date of an event he was signed up for got moved forward to today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see... That's a shame. He sounded like he was really looking forward to it when I spoke to him in class.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, but he stopped by this morning! He even gave Tsukasa a gift from the rest of his team!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Plus, I promised to take a good video of Tsukasa shining at the party so he can watch it later♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hurray! That's bound to put a smile on Toya's face.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? The lights went out...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seems that the festival is about to begin.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Everyone! Thank you for coming!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Where's his voice coming from?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Look, at the top of the stairs!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ladies and gentlemen! The Tsukasa Tenma Birthday Festival is about to commence!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This event is dedicated to all of you, who have shown me nothing but love and support!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There will even be a special show, so please enjoy every moment until the very end!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! We get to see a special show!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even I don't know what the show's about. I can't wait to find out♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And with that, let the Tsukasa Tenma Birthday Festival begin!
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And now, put your hands together for my special show, “The Great Journey of Tsukasa Tenma”!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Go Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Years ago on May 17th, a newborn cried for the first time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Waaah! Waaah!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Oh, what a powerful and majestic cry! There's no doubt our child has a grand future ahead of him!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “You're right. He needs a name that screams 'ruler of the world'. Let's call him “Tsukasa”!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And thus begins the legacy of an aspiring star!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Legacy”? But he's still alive...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In any case, I'm surprised to learn that his catchphrase is based on the actual origin of his name.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Huh? But Mom said that she didn't think about that meaning of his name at the time... Oh well.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Wow! Seeing the lead actor singing and dancing is enough to make everyone smile!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Someday...someday, I too...will become a star like him!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “A star who can make everyone smile, especially my little sister.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki told me about that. What a wonderful source of motivation.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And now, we arrive at Tsukasa Tenma's audition at Phoenix Wonderland! At this time, Tsukasa's younger sister Saki resumed her schooling!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Despite his concerns for her wellbeing, she was up on her feet in no time, forming a band with old friends and bubbling with lust for her new life!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “It's all thanks to Saki's vigor and her friends who are there to support her.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Even now, seeing her smiling with her friends fills me with warmth.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I could wish for nothing more than to see their everlasting joy.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And so, as he continued to chase his dreams, Tsukasa Tenma made some fantastic friends.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In spite of his own arrogance, misunderstandings and difficulties they faced, they turned out to be irreplaceable parts of his life.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “The path to stardom is long and seems endless, with nothing but dead end after dead end.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “But each time I've found myself at breaking point, they've always been there for me, their hands outstretched and their belief in me unwavering.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I need to prove them right in that belief. Therefore, I vow to become a star so bright that I'm known in every corner of the galaxy!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thus, a fire ignited within Tsukasa Tenma. He leaped forward, ready to embrace his unknown future. The end!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa, that was amazing! I got a bit teary-eyed at one point!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too! Let's keep making fun shows together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now then, it's time to indulge ourselves in a hearty meal! I'd also like to hear your thoughts on the show!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Om nom... Mmmh! This gratin is stuffed with lots of meat and macaroni! It's so tasty!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This perilla pasta is also really good, although the perilla leaves aren't cut properly...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh no, really? I was so careful when I was slicing them...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, you even helped cook the food too, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well actually, me and Tsukasa made it together, with our mom there to show us how.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, you and Tsukasa together?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I could think of no better way to welcome my guests! We're confident that every dish will be to your liking!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What's more, we even made a cake for dessert from scratch!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You did? That's impressive!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It is, but isn't it a bit strange to make your own birthday cake?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That's Tsukasa for you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki, thank you for all your help.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This event wouldn't have gone as smoothly as it did if it wasn't for your help making the food and invites, so thank you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, glad I could be of help!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: After all, you're the one always helping me, so I just wanted you to have a fun birthday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Once again...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: S-Saki...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gaaah! I must be... THE HAPPIEST OLDER BROTHER IN THE ENTIRE UNIVERSE!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An & Akito
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry for stopping by so early in the morning. Saki sent me a video of your Birthday Festival performance, and I watched it with Akito and the others.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: When Toya mentioned it was a show about your life, I couldn't really picture how it would pan out, but I was really impressed by your delivery!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! It sounded like the biography of a great historical figure!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I wouldn't go that far... But, we learned a lot about why you turned out the way you are.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tsukasa, I intend to share my thoughts on the show in greater detail when we are at school. I hope you had a delightful birthday.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday Tsukasa♪ Ah... I could've gone to your party if it wasn't for work...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, but Toya mentioned he'll show me a video of the show you performed, so I'll let you know how I found it later♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope you had a lovely birthday, Tsukasa. Shii sounded all excited telling me about your wonderful party. She mentioned the delicious food and the show, too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey... That's because you kept pestering me to tell you more.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, it really was fun though, wasn't it? It was a great show, and we had delicious food to boot!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. It reminded me of the good old days. Saki, Tsukasa and everyone would gather 'round the table to eat together...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right! Hehehe, I'm glad I got to help out! Here's to another year, Tsukasa♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Although it was your birthday, we were the ones made to feel celebrated.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I have to say, you delivered quite the show despite your busy rehearsal schedule. It made me wonder just how you managed to fit this in.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, although really, that show is still going on☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's right. Perhaps, when Tsukasa attains stardom someday, it will mean the show has ended.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If possible, I want to see that moment with my own eyes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too, and I won't fall behind him either.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oooh! Nene's all fired up! In that case, I'll give it my all, too♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, for now, we have plenty of shows on our plate. Here's to another year, Mr. Troupe Leader.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you everyone for celebrating my birthday today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your messages of support resonate within me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I promise to continue to race down the path to stardom!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I hope you continue to look out for me. Thank you all for a magnificent day!
Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I wasn't able to give Nene any good advice...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...is about all I got.
Did I sound weird or off in any way...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I wish I could do something for her since she helped me with becoming Rio...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Nene's always had confidence in her singing, so I doubt she foresaw any of this happening...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(It seemed like quite a shock to her...
But she may be moving in the right direction since she went over to speak to the director about what he told her.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Which means all we can do is believe in what she does...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Knowing that you have friends supporting you can make a huge difference. It definitely did when I was learning to play Thorpe and Rio.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But this is different from learning to play a character. She has to break some old habits, which isn't going to be easy...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I hope she figures out what she needs to do...)
A few days later
Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line:
Morning, Kusanagi!
Let's do our best again today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Nene's just putting on a face...
Saki does the same thing whenever she tells me that “everything's fine” when it really isn't...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (She even has bags under her eyes...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I have a feeling that she's still stuck...
Hmm... If only there were some way we could help her...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Tenma, would you mind if we had a quick chat about the scene we'll be working on today?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sakurako Seiryuin!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
Of course! You might know what to do!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I see. I didn't realize you were all so worried about Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We are. We couldn't even figure out what these habits of hers are when we discussed it as a troupe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She's unaware of any such habits, which means the onus was on us to know what they are...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I understand what you're trying to say, but you may not have the experience necessary to spot these habits of hers...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What...?!
Does that mean you know what she needs to fix, Seiryuin?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yes, I think so...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent! Then, would you mind talking to Nene for us?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: That I won't do.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wha—?! Why...?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
You really have to ask?
It's the other way around. She has to come and ask me.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
I prefer not to toot my own horn...
But when it comes to singing, I'm more knowledgeable and technically skilled than Kusanagi. She's well aware of this fact.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: However, she's currently trying to solve this problem under her own power.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I didn't mean to demean you or Nene in any way. Please forget what I just said.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I shall.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: But keep in mind that I am simply keeping my distance for now.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: When the time comes, whether or not she wishes to hear it, I am going to tell her to hard truth.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. We don't have much time left until our show opens, so we can't wait for her to find an answer on her own...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I need to thank you for believing in Nene and giving her time to figure this out.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Believe in her? I simply wish to focus on practicing my own role.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Also, where does this all leave you...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yes, you're doing a wonderful job of expressing your emotions... But you still have quite a few things to work on, including your character's more nuanced mannerisms, the timing for your lines and such, no...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oof...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yet your mind is preoccupied with the business of others. Do you not see a problem with that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You're absolutely right, Sakurako Seiryuin.
I have no rebuttal...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (As much as I want to help Nene, I need to keep working on my own character...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sakurako Seiryuin! Let's discuss that scene we'll be doing today!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
That's what I like to hear.
First, about the opening portion...
Phoenix Stage - Green Room

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Does everyone have a drink ready?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm ready!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Ready whenever!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, here's to a successful 30th Anniversary Show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Sakurako
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Kamishiro, Otori, you guys did such an amazing job! But I guess this is it for Team Birdie...

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line:
Haha! Team Birdie?!
That's the first time I'm hearing this name.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Each of our practices was a great learning experience. It was an honor to be able to perform on stage with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Likewise! So, let's make the most of this after-party and really have a blast!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I wanna chat lots and lots with you guys!

rows.Speaker: Nishie
rows.Line: Nice job out there, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, Nishie...!
Um, you too.

rows.Speaker: Nishie
rows.Line:
I really loved your Cowardly Canary!
You just kept getting better and better as time went on too. It gave me a huge boost of motivation.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-No, um...!
You did a really amazing job as the witch, Nishie.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
So, if you don't mind...
Can you tell me how you practice for shows?

rows.Speaker: Nishie
rows.Line:
Of course!
I was actually about to ask you the same thing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone seems to be enjoying themselves.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: We've succeeded as a team countless times before, but this feeling never gets old.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Anyway, there are some people I'd like to talk to. You should do the same and enjoy yourself.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I will.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Now, I can talk to Rui and the others whenever, so I should start by congratulating everyone from the Phoenix Stage...)
Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line:
You did such an amazing job as Rio!
It stung pretty bad when I didn't get the part, but we were all totally blown away by your performance!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Yeah, I felt really conflicted the entire time. A part of me was sad that I didn't get the part, while another part of me was really glad that you were chosen for it.

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: But we're not letting you hog all the glory next time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, challenge accepted!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Still, Tenma, you're growing at such an astonishing pace. How did you practice playing your character?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I tried putting myself in Rio's shoes by simulating what his situation was like in real life.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For example, well...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rio ran around for three days and nights on nothing but water. I wanted to know what that was like, so I ended up skipping several meals...

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: I see. That explains why you were able to put on such a believable performance...

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: We'll come up with those kinds of ideas from time to time, but to actually go through with them... I guess that's what sets you apart from the rest of us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Actually, I struggled to come up with any other ideas regarding this role...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I probably shouldn't tell them that I actually didn't eat for three days straight.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What else was there...? Oh, Rio chased the phoenix around, so I practiced by chasing after Robo-Phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Robo-Phoenix?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's the robot I made.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wah?! R-Rui...? How long have you been there...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
