rows.Line: I heard you talking when I was pouring myself a drink.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, would you all like to see it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we have this corner to ourselves, so we shouldn't be too much of a bother.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Alright, allow me to introduce...
Robo-Phoenix!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Whoa! It's way bigger than I thought!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: I heard that you can make your own robots and drones, Kamishiro, but this is so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: So, how did you practice with this thing exactly? You can give us a taste since we have this corner to ourselves, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Robo-Phoenix, activate!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Hey, it's flying...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, I had to catch her by doing something like...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This...!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line:
Hey, she dodged you!
I didn't realize she could move so fast!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr... This is likely going to be our final game of cat and mouse, so I will catch you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, Tsukasa, I programmed her to become more elusive each time I thought you were getting too close.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! You never said anything about that!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, that was deliberate.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, she was set to super grandmaster mode the last time you did this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That name makes it sound impossible to catch her!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But enough talk... Now's my chance!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Close! That was a nice fake!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: You can do it, Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene, look!
Tsukasa's chasing after Robo-Phoenix!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You've gotta be kidding me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There! No! Got you...!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line:
Oh, now! No, a little to the right!
Actually, let's try catching her together!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line:
Okay! I'll go this way!
Tenma, you attack her straight on!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
Got it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Roar*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! Robo-Phoenix is trapped and doesn't know what to do!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I have you noooow!!!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Yeah! Nice one, Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, it was a team effort!

rows.Speaker: Nishie
rows.Line: Hehe. Your troupe leader's so full of energy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Full of energy? More like full of hot air...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We've had a chance to really get to know the cast of the Phoenix Stage...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We've become used to practicing and performing at the Phoenix Stage as well. But that ends today.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I really appreciate you all agreeing to do a joint performance with us! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was an incredible experience and we learned so much. I... We even grew quite a bit as actors...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We look forward to working with you again in the future! I hope you'll have us back sometime!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you very much☆
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to performing with you all again and seeing how you've grown.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Likewise!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The road to stardom is a long one.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But I'll make it as long as I don't give up.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'll keep moving forward, even if it means just taking baby steps! I will become a true star someday...!)
School trip - Day one
Kyoto

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, the traditional crafts workshop should be around here somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Fujiwara
rows.Line: This map says there should be a big sign just up ahead. Want me to run ahead to look?

rows.Speaker: Yamaguchi
rows.Line: No, stop! We don't want to cause the locals any trouble! This city's a place of taste and elegance. Some kid from who knows where running around is the opposite of those things.

rows.Speaker: Yamaguchi
rows.Line: Also, there should be others who chose this workshop. If worst comes to worst and we get lost, we can just try getting ahold of one of them...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I agree with you about the running bit...
But you really never plan ahead, do you?

rows.Speaker: Tanaka
rows.Line: I know, right? You're the same during matches. That's why the coach and the captain are always giving you an earful.

rows.Speaker: Yamaguchi
rows.Line: Wh-What does club have to do with this?! Guys, we're on our school trip! Let's talk about our teacups! Have you guys already decided how you're gonna make yours?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I have!
I even sketched a design for mine!

rows.Speaker: Yamaguchi
rows.Line: A design?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, here...!
It's going to look like a star when seen from above!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why the silence? Has my brilliant design left you all speechless?

rows.Speaker: Yamaguchi
rows.Line: Really? We're speechless for the opposite reason.

rows.Speaker: Fujiwara
rows.Line: Tenma, try reading the description of this activity for us again...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? “This activity involves throwing your own teacup using a wheel.” So...

rows.Speaker: Fujiwara
rows.Line: Yeah, a wheel.

rows.Speaker: Tanaka
rows.Line: How are you gonna turn something that's spinning into a star?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah! I will not be foiled so easily!
See? “Our ceramicist will guide you to creating your desired shape.”

rows.Speaker: Yamaguchi
rows.Line: I think a star is taking that too far...

rows.Speaker: Fujiwara
rows.Line: I feel bad for the ceramicist...

rows.Speaker: Tanaka
rows.Line: Let's just make some normal-looking ones.

rows.Speaker: Fujiwara & Yamaguchi
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Fujiwara's Voice
rows.Line:
Hey, check it out.
Mine turned out pretty well.

rows.Speaker: Tanaka's Voice
rows.Line:
Yeah, it looks really good!
Mine's sorta starting to look like a flower vase...

rows.Speaker: Yamaguchi's Voice
rows.Line:
I think that makes it unique.
I mean, it definitely looks more like a teacup than what Tenma has.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
I heard that...!
Don't take jabs at me while I'm trying to focus... Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
Noooooo!
My teacup! I finally made a neat point, and now I have to start over again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: I must've spun it too fast this time. I should slow it down a bit and be more careful...

rows.Speaker: Tanaka's Voice
rows.Line: Honestly, Tenma, you probably shouldn't be using a wheel at all...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: But that would defeat the purpose of this activity! I refuse to surrender!

rows.Speaker: Ceramicist
rows.Line: We'll take the teacups you all made and prepare them to be fired in our kiln. I hope you're all looking forward to seeing how they turn out.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, thank you for having us today!

rows.Speaker: Fujiwara, Tanaka & Yamaguchi
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
This really was a wonderful experience.
They said it's going to take two weeks until they're finished, yes?

rows.Speaker: Fujiwara
rows.Line: Yeah, because they have to wait for them to dry before they can be fired. After that, they have to mail them out.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, I'll eagerly be awaiting the arrival of the world's one-and-only teacup made by yours truly to see how it turned out!

rows.Speaker: Yamaguchi
rows.Line: None of us were expecting you to actually make a star-shaped teacup. The look on that ceramicist's face when you showed them your sketch...

rows.Speaker: Tanaka
rows.Line: I mean, how are you actually gonna drink out of that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! I have five whole points all to myself!

rows.Speaker: Fujiwara
rows.Line: The nice thing about a round teacup is that you have 360 whole degrees available to you.

rows.Speaker: Yamaguchi
rows.Line: Haha! You know logic doesn't work on Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh? You make fun of someone else's work, but what about your own teacups? Did they turn out the way you wanted? Some of you finished very early...

rows.Speaker: Fujiwara
rows.Line: Because it wasn't actually that hard to do it normally.

rows.Speaker: Tanaka
rows.Line: Anyway, due to someone taking more time than expected to make his teacup, we don't have much time before we need to meet back up with everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Is it already time to head back to the inn?

rows.Speaker: Fujiwara
rows.Line:
No, we still have time for lunch.
Plus, the workshop was within earshot of the inn.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: True. Then, let's grab some lunch and go for a walk around this area as scheduled.

rows.Speaker: Yamaguchi
rows.Line: Yeah! Oh, we should see what snacks are available along the way!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For souvenirs?

rows.Speaker: Yamaguchi
rows.Line: No, for after we head back to the inn.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I see. But try not to eat too much. You wouldn't want to spoil your appetite before dinner.

rows.Speaker: Yamaguchi
rows.Line: Relax, Mom, I won't!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Fujiwara, Tanaka & Yamaguchi
rows.Line:
Hahaha.
Haha!
Inn

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, Tsukasa, I believe it's about time you went to buy us those drinks.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Yeah, and they have to be from a vending machine outside of this inn.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
But it's past curfew.
Won't we get in trouble if the teachers find out?

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line:
He lost fair and square.
Also, these two are used to getting scolded.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Argh! As frustrating as this is, you unfortunately speak the truth...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That means you're not afraid of anything, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How did you arrive at that?! Also, you're enjoying this far too much!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Am I?

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Anyway, Tenma, Kamishiro...
Try not to run into the teachers on lookout, okay?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, we'll be careful.
You all need to be sure you're not caught staying up.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They may come in to see if all the students are actually asleep.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Yikes, that'd be a pain to deal with.

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: I guess we should get our beds ready so we can pretend like we're sleeping.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Yeah, that totally slipped my mind while playing cards.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll message everyone in my room to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, right. You did stuff with your own group today, right, Tenma? What are they like?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You mean Tanaka, Yamaguchi and Fujiwara? I'm sure you've met or seen them before.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, you always seem to be talking to them whenever I go visit your classroom...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Wait, you're friends with them?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Based on your tone, I assume you are as well?

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
N-No way!
I mean, Tanaka and I were in the same class last year...

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: But he's really athletic, a great basketball player, super nice and he has a fun personality... He's everything I'm not...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Yamaguchi and Fujiwara are both in sports clubs and really popular. I see them talking to girls all the time...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So what if they do?
They're just interacting normally as classmates.

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Interacting normally? You hear that, guys...?

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: You've gotta be kidding me.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Anyway, Tsukasa, you should really go get us those drinks now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, right.
What would you all like me to get—

rows.Speaker: Teacher's Voice
rows.Line:
Hey, what are you all still doing up!
Don't you know it's well past curfew?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Th-That sounded like a teacher! Which room was that?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: One or two doors down from what I could tell. They must be doing their patrols now.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Quick! We gotta turn off the lights!

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: Wait, no! We haven't laid out our beds yet...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa! I can't see! It's too dark!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Thank goodness we already put the cards and stuff away! Here, I found the beds!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, we just gotta lay down our own beds and wait for that teacher to leave.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Wait, where does that leave me?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Don't worry. You can hide under the table.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How is that supposed to help?!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Shush! Kamishiro, make your bed!
Tenma, hide! Now...!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I thought I just heard some commotion...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I guess I was just hearing things...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, I think we're safe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Phew...
That was rather thrilling.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line:
Um, Tenma...?
Maybe you should head back to your room. If they find out that you're not there...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, I'm not about to give up after coming this far! Also, I should be fine if I ask my groupmates to make a dummy of me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They're apparently quite adept at pulling a fast one on the teachers in these sorts of situations.

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Oh... Haha. I guess we sort of think alike in that regard...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, we'll be off!
Wish us luck!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Alright, be careful!

rows.Speaker: Teacher's Voice
rows.Line:
Kamishiro! I knew you were still up!
Wait, Tenma, you too?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
You're still here?!
Were you waiting to ambush us?!

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Taniyama
rows.Line: Yikes, caught in the act...

rows.Speaker: Hayashi
rows.Line: I guess this is their comeuppance for everything they get up to.

rows.Speaker: Miyake
rows.Line: Haha...
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How does it look, Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it seems good.
I'll take this script and begin working on how we'll present it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay☆ That means we're done working on the script for the anniversary show♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, and I feel like the ending really suits us now. I like it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But of course! I mean, how much happier can this ending get?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland's anniversary show is scheduled to open two months from now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This will be our final show as members of its cast, so let's give it everything we have!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right. They're probably gonna announce that we're becoming freelancers pretty soon, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. From what I understand, they're going to explain what's going on to the cast first before announcing it to the public.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu's brothers said that they'd take care of it, so we shouldn't have to worry much...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I feel a little bad about placing the burden on them...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me too. Yes, they agreed to us becoming freelancers, but we stand to benefit more from this...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means we should do what we can for them and the park.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... We still have the anniversary show, so we should get a chance to greet all the visitors, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So what about the other cast members...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They're our valued comrades. They helped us protect and save Phoenix Wonderland...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We should at least thank them one last time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that shouldn't be a problem!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Keisuke and Shosuke said that it'd be okay for us to do that after they've had a chance to tell them the news.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, really?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! And there's lots of people I still need to talk to♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent! Then, once they've heard the news, we'll go and thank them one last time!
A few days later
In Front of the Ferris Wheel

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Good mooorning☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're sorry to interrupt your preparations, but do you all have a moment to talk?

rows.Speaker: Cast Member A
rows.Line: Oh, Emu! Wait, you're all here!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member B
rows.Line:
We heard the news!
You're gonna start freelancing and learn how to put on better shows?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, which is why we came by to thank you all one last time.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: In Front of the Phoenix Coaster

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We understand if you're surprised since we know the news was sudden...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But we're gonna go see lots of new things, experience lots of stuff and come back bigger and better than before!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member C
rows.Line:
Hahaha! That's great!
Yeah, you guys definitely should experience as much as you can while you're young.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member D
rows.Line: I agree. It also makes me really happy that the park's operators are willing to give you this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: In Front of the Fish Coaster

rows.Speaker: Cast Member E
rows.Line: Go on! The more famous you all become, the prouder we'll be to have worked with you!

rows.Speaker: Cast Member F
rows.Line: Our beloved fish coaster's still in operation because of all of you.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member F
rows.Line:
So, thank you very much!
We hope all your dreams come true!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Thank you all very much!
Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Nishie
rows.Line: We were all so stunned when they told us that you guys are gonna become freelancers!

rows.Speaker: Omori
rows.Line: But it actually kinda makes sense. We're really happy for all of you!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Things aren't gonna be the same, but we'll be rooting for you guys!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Go learn as much as you can!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you for understanding...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: They understand because it's you we're talking about. They wouldn't do that for just anyone.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: After all, you've managed to pull off a miracle once already.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
By saving Phoenix Wonderland.
By keeping it “the place where everyone smiles”.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
But we were only able to do that because of all your help. It was a massive group effort.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We never would've been able to accomplish such a thing by ourselves...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Of course you wouldn't have.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: But even I was impressed by the way you were able to take action and unite the park's entire cast under one banner.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: With that sort of power, you should be able to make even more people smile than before.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sakurako...!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I'll look you all up from time to time, so do your best out there.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: But before you do, you have to fulfill your duties as cast members by putting on a good anniversary show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We promise to make the most of all your kindness by putting on an absolutely spectacular performance!
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Today, it begins...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Our final show as members of the cast here.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Soon, the anniversary show for Phoenix Wonderland will open.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Like all our other shows, I'm sure we'll be doing our last performance before we know it.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Looking back, it feels like every day has flown by ever since I first met Emu here.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haaaaaaaaaaaaah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Whoa! What on earth was that?
Something just dropped out of the sky!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Welcome to the Wonder Stage, a place filled with lots of smiles☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All together, now! One, two, wonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Say hello to our new stage director!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Apologies for the wait. Here she is.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Emu
rows.Line: She's a robot?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wonderlands×Showtime shall continue operations!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ha ha ha ha ha ha!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The first time I was brought here, all I could see was just a run-down stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But as Emu said, you have the power to take people to different worlds and make the audience smile.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I regret calling you a run-down stage back then.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No matter what anyone says, you mean everything to us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Morning, Tsukasa☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, you're here early.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be fair, we also seem to have arrived much earlier than the time we agreed upon...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, today's the day the anniversary show opens!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Speaking of which, “#AnniversaryShow” and similar hashtags started trending online after the park announced that it'd be happening.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: People also seemed to be talking about us no longer regularly doing shows here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Fortunately, things didn't get too out of hand after that information was announced.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, they seemed to accept it rather well. I believe they were relieved to know that this won't be the end.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A lot even said that they're gonna come see our last show no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane also said she's definitely gonna come see us!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right, Toya also got in touch with me on that. He's apparently going to be here with Akito in tow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It seems likely that Shiraishi will come along to round out their group.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Hoshino said she'll be coming with her bandmates.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I heard that as well.
Saki sounded extremely excited!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...! Hehe. We've gotta make sure they all have lots and lots of fun♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes! I believe everyone who comes to see our show is going to go home smiling.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's go out there and make our last show as members of Phoenix Wonderland's cast one to remember!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
I was thinking that we could greet the audience.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We should take this opportunity to show them our gratitude, so if you don't mind listening for a second...
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...? What did you just say?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Tsukasa. Could you repeat that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Listen carefully, all of you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I...might be held back a year!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: H-Held back...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But, isn't that super, super bad?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes...! It's unprecedentedly bad!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If... If I don't make it into third year...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll be in the same year as you and Nene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The same year...as you...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That means Nene and Tsukasa will be able to put on as many shows as they like, every day☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds so cool! I wanna do a show at school too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It would certainly not be cool!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All of you, think about it reasonably! If that happened, I...would be in the same year as Saki!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Y-You're right...
Tsukasa and...Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Who can answer this question...?
Ms. Tenma! Do you know?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Wait, what was it...?
I... I forgot!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Uh... Um... Uhhh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Oh no! Saki's in a bind!
At a time like this, her big brother must go to her aid!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
Look here, Saki! Your knight in shining armor takes the stage!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What a difficult question! Seven hundred percent difficulty! But the certainty that you can answer it is ten out of ten!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki, I know you know the answer! Come now, think!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait... What?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Oh... Seven hundred... Ten... Is he giving me a clue?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Seven hundred...and ten... The year 710... Oh, now I remember! The relocation of the capital to Nara!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Correct! Well done, Ms. Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's my little sister! I expect nothing less!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I ask you! Give Saki more questions to answer! She can answer even harder ones!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! Keep them coming! I'll answer them all!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Emu, are you okay?
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That...sounds...so fun!
I wanna be your classmate too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?!
Good grief... There's no point trying to keep up with your imagination.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, I need to get into third year, whatever it takes!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But, how are you gonna do that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There are going to be supplementary classes all through next week, and there's a test on the last day that will determine whether I'm held back or not.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So you need to do well on that test to get into third year?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. My fate will be decided next Friday! And so...Rui!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've swallowed my pride to ask something of you. Please, help me study!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, I imagined you would ask. Of course I'll help you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you...! You have my gratitude! I'll be more than well prepared with your help!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. You can count on me. Emu will be disappointed, but I want you to join me in third year.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, oh well!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You can do it, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I can!
I'm going to cross this quagmire without fail!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, you are. Let's do our best.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, it may be wise to have a secret weapon up my sleeve for when the time comes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Something that will drill knowledge into Tsukasa's head, whether he likes it or not... An instantaneous memorization device...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh... Hey, Rui?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ahaha... I hope Tsukasa comes out of this unscathed...
Graduation ceremony
Kamiyama High School - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Well, we came here as soon as homeroom ended, but...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The school gate's swamped with everyone who's graduating.)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
*Bawl*
Congratulations, all of you!

rows.Speaker: Graduating Students
rows.Line:
Hey, don't cry...
If you cry, then we'll cry and...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Did you find him?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No sign of him. Where could the captain be...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is no time for half-measures.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, Akito. Leave it to me!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: CAPTAIN!!! WHERE ARE YOU?!

rows.Speaker: Graduating Student
rows.Line: Wah! Who was that?! My ears...

rows.Speaker: Graduating Student
rows.Line:
Oh, it's that guy!
The loud half of the Weirdo Wombo Combo!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Um, Tsukasa. Could you dial it down a little?
OH!!! IS THAT VOICE...TENMA?!

rows.Speaker: Graduating Student
rows.Line: Whoa! Again?! It's coming from the schoolyard this time!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Him too...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Akito! I hear his voice coming from the schoolyard! Let's go meet him!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Cheer Squad Captain
rows.Line: You came just to see me?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! We wanted to say a proper goodbye, so we decided to drop by.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's right. Tsukasa invited me, and I figured I should come see you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Akito
rows.Line: Congratulations on your graduation!

rows.Speaker: Cheer Squad Captain
rows.Line: Oh! Many thanks to both of you!

rows.Speaker: Cheer Squad Captain
rows.Line: Also... Tenma, I heard that you had supplementary classes. It must've been a rough time, but I'm pleased to know you passed!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-Why do you know about that, Captain?!

rows.Speaker: Cheer Squad Captain
rows.Line: Hah. You are a school celebrity, don't forget. There was talk among us third-years that the Weirdo Wombo Combo might have to disband.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So much about my life is public knowledge... It's not easy being a star...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, no no no!
Now is not the time for that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh captain, my captain. Thank you for all your work during the Sports Festival.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Although we didn't win, we will take the baton from you and be sure to seize victory next year!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's right. Defeat doesn't sit right with me. Well, it depends if we get a chance or not.

rows.Speaker: Cheer Squad Captain
rows.Line: Hah, I see! Well then, I leave it in your capable hands!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Cheer Squad Captain
rows.Line: Thanks to you two, I'm leaving no regrets behind. You have my gratitude for helping make us such a great cheer squad.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Captain...

rows.Speaker: Cheer Squad Captain
rows.Line: As it's my last chance, let me give you both some parting words as your senior.

rows.Speaker: Cheer Squad Captain
rows.Line: I say this particularly to you, Tenma, since next year will be your last at high school. Give everything your all, and make sure you don't leave any unfinished business behind!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We will!
I'll commit your advice to memory!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Congratulations on getting through the last three years.

rows.Speaker: Cheer Squad Captain
rows.Line: Well then. Farewell!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Yes. It's just like he said...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I want to leave this school with as much contentment and pride on my face as he had. And so...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I need to be even more diligent and make next year count.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I can't slack off either.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's both do our best!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's.
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
We've really made the most of our time after school!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We have triumphed over ice cream, beef skewers, kebabs with no vegetables, and even mutton biryani!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think we outdid some of the latest vacuum cleaners out there. Now my stomach is making awful noises.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Though, it was surprisingly fun to spend the afternoon pretending to be competitive eaters. We should do this again.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Agreed!
If only school always got out this early.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: On the other hand, that may get old rather quickly.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You may be right...
Especially considering how much I enjoy being chased around by the teachers.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're the only one who feels that way...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, we do get to be in class together this year!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not only that, but different faces around us... A new environment... Don't they just fill you with excitement?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, they do.
I'm looking forward to seeing what the future has in store for us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've had a chance to eat, it is time to come up with a theme for our next show...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, isn't that...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What do you see?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Rui, look...
This sweater vest. I'm feeling some sort of profound connection to it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This tepid embroidered fish... Isn't this from that clothing brand you like?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it appears to be so.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But this sweater vest... It balances cute and cool so perfectly that I can't help but gravitate towards it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I... I must have it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Then, why don't you try it on?
I'll wait here for you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Really?!
Then, I'll be but a moment!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
Excuse me!!
Would you be able to direct me to the fitting rooms?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. He's as energetic as ever today.
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
This looks stunning on you, sir!
And it fits just right!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I didn't intend to try on a whole outfit centered around this sweater vest, but...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I like it...
I may just have to buy the entire thing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, Tsukasa, you're done changing.
That outfit looks very nice on you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah. Doesn't it?
So nice that I'm seriously considering buying all of it now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I don't see any problem with that if you like it that much. Plus, it is the best time of year to get something new.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Coming across the perfect outfit at the perfect time. Perhaps this is fate...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't have much cash on hand, but I may just have to take the plunge! Like diving from the Kiyomizu Stage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How much would this all be together?!

rows.Speaker: Clerk
rows.Line:
Thank you for shopping with us today!
That'll be 25,800 yen.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: 25-thousand?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I really went for it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you wait, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No problem at all. Watching you pick out a new outfit also gave me a new perspective.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As expected, the start of a new term is the best time to switch things up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. The change in our class marks a fresh start! I'd like to make the most of this opportunity!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We are about to embark upon a new journey as Wonderlands×Showtime.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're about to make the climb towards stardom, taking the world by storm and making our dreams a reality!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's change our outlook and face that challenge head-on!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
Let's go out there and make our dreams come true.
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: P.E. Teacher
rows.Line:
Stop right there, Kamishiro, Tenma!!!
You're not getting away from me today!

rows.Speaker: P.E. Teacher
rows.Line:
Stop hiding and show yourselves!
You think it's okay to set off fireworks at the start of a new term?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr... How did I get dragged into this...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, be quiet.

rows.Speaker: P.E. Teacher
rows.Line: Have any of you first-years seen Kamishiro or Tenma around here at all?! If you have and don't tell me...

rows.Speaker: First-Years
rows.Line:
W-W-W-We haven't seen them!
I mean, we don't really know who either of those people are!

rows.Speaker: P.E. Teacher
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
Just be sure to report any suspicious activity. I will find them today no matter what...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, I think the coast is clear.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You can speak now, Tsukasa. I do request that you keep your voice down, though...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why do I have to keep doing what you say?! Don't forget who got us into this mess!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I thought you approved of this plan.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You even said, “The opening ceremony doubles as a welcoming party for the new students, so I'm sure they'd enjoy it if we threw in some special effects for them!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, I said that...
But I didn't mean for you to shoot off thirty fireworks! That caused a huge panic!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, they were a bit louder than I was expecting.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, both you and that teacher made this mistake, but you can't technically call them fireworks since no fire was involved.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Real ones would've been much too dangerous. That's why I used the mechanism found in party poppers to—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's not what's important right now!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Listen up, Rui.
We're third-years now. It's our final year here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We should be doing what we can to stop being called the Weirdo Wombo Combo and act with more dignity like...

rows.Speaker: First-Years' Voices
rows.Line: My big bro told me about them, but I can't believe the Weirdo Wombo Combo's actually real...

rows.Speaker: First-Years' Voices
rows.Line: And what about that really scary teacher chasing after them? Those ridiculous rumors really ended up being true...

rows.Speaker: First-Years' Voices
rows.Line: If seniors like that are here setting off fireworks during the opening ceremony, this school can't be normal.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The new students seem to be talking about us. Our fame precedes us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(No, not good...!
I need to do something about this...!!)
A few days later
Class 3-C

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, let's start our long homeroom.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: As we discussed before, you'll be making your committee selections today. For now, please raise your hand if you are interested in a position. First...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I've given this a lot of thought since the other day. The whole school's been talking about the Weirdo Wombo Combo...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If this keeps up, it will hinder me on my path to superstardom! I must prevent my name from getting dragged through the mud!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And this is the only way...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Let's start with the hall monitor—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Me!!!
I volunteer myself to become a hall monitor!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Tenma?! As a hall monitor...?!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: But he's one of the people always breaking the rules...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: This isn't the lightning round for a quiz show. I appreciate the enthusiasm, but under what pretense did you raise your hand...?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: If you and Kamishiro are concocting some sort of scheme, then you'll be...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
There!
That is exactly why I'm volunteering!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Until now, a series of grave misunderstandings has led people to lump me in with Rui as one of the Weirdo Wombo Combo!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: No, your track record is clear. Those were not “grave misunderstandings.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Regardless!
I am an honest, hard-working, and honorable high schooler! Plus, I'm a future star!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So I wish to become a hall monitor for the sake of clearing my name!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I swear to keep a watchful eye on Rui from this day on!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Is he serious...?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: But I bet Tenma keeping an eye on Kamishiro would be good news for the teachers.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Yeah, because it's impossible to catch them both...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh dear...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is turning into quite a predicament.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: If you truly intend to follow through on that promise, then I'd be more than happy to make you a hall monitor, Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
Does that mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: However, if I find out that you're in cahoots with Kamishiro, you're immediately out! You'll be spending your days locked in the guidance counselor's office. Are we clear?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you very much!
I, Tsukasa Tenma, vow to do my absolute best as a hall monitor!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Th-This is nuts...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: The newspaper club needs to start preparing a special edition on this...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hear that, Rui?!
You won't have your way with me this year!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For the sake of all the other rule-abiding students, your reign of terror must come to an end!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sounds like we have another fun year ahead.
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, I believe we're all done stretching!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now then...! Ahem!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Let's start our run!
Also known as “Towards Tomorrow! Our Last Run Before The New School Year!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah☆

rows.Speaker: Rui & Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yeah...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? What's wrong, Nene?
You don't sound all that excited.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Are you getting hungry?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, I had a decent breakfast this morning.
That's not what's bugging me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I mean, seriously...
We're what, running into the world of tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, you mean “Towards Tomorrow! Our Last Run Before The New School Year!”? Emu and I came up with that title while waiting for you two to arrive.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Isn't it cool? It's like the subtitle for an anime♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, it certainly sounds like something you see at the end of the first season.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I thought it sounded like the title for the last chapter of a canceled manga series...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In any case, I believe it's another way of saying this is a special day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Precisely!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, let's work up a good sweat in order to get ourselves in perfect shape for the opening ceremony!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm not sure what those things have to do with each other, but if it ends up being a good workout...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent! Then let's start running!

rows.Speaker: Rui, Emu & Nene
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That tree over there's our goal, right☆
I'm gonna finish first♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! Not so fast, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So much energy...
Nene, we're almost there.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... I-I'm okay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Roar*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ohhh no you don't!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Aaarrrggghhh!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I finished...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: First...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Waaaaaaah!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh noooooo!!!
Tsukasa tumbled out of control!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Whoa! I can't believe I did that...!
What happened?! Why did I tumble out of control like that?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Geez, we're the ones who can't believe you...!
Are you sure you didn't get hurt at all?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? No, just a few cuts and scrapes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Fortunately, you fell on the grass...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, from what I could see, you tumbled so violently because your shoe broke apart and gave out underneath you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My shoe broke...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, my right shoe...!
It's gone missing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Isn't that it over there?
It's in two pieces since the sole got completely torn off...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: H-How could this have happened...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We got all muddy while running through those puddles together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You were even there when we stepped in a dog's refuse while chasing the Robo-Phoenix around!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I...!
I've lost another valuable training partner!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Didn't you say basically the same thing when you broke that other shoe during one of our practices...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Stage props are one thing, but you seem to take great care of your belongings as well, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course I do.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Those who don't take good care of their equipment have no hope of finding success.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're not some professional athlete...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
But this is pretty bad. I have no choice but to buy a new pair.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Still, Tsukasa, I'm sure Mr. Shoe had a lot of fun running around with you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I have a feeling that it couldn't have asked for a better ending.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! I'll just have to find another pair of running shoes that will work just as hard as my old one!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Welcome, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay! What brings you all here today?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We were hoping to practice here for a bit.
Also...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What's going on, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, there is something I must tell you all.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, what's that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Today, I'd like to present to you all my new running shoes!!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
New running shoes?
You got a new pair?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! Take a look!!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa, they look really cool! And so shiny!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
I did just put them on before coming over here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They do look really cool. And super fast☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I thought the same thing when he showed us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I get that you wanna show them to everyone, but that's not why you're here, right...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, of course!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm wearing these today because I'd like for you all to step on them for me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! But your shiny shoes are gonna get all dirty!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'm doing this for my own good!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Brand-new shoes can cause the wearer to get injured if they're not broken in properly.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Stepping on his new shoes should help loosen up the material and make it easier for his feet to mold them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I've heard that people who play sports like basketball do that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Put another way, you don't usually do this unless you play some kind of sport.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But this is like a little charm for not getting injured, right?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, I wanna step on Tsukasa's shoes!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too, me too♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me three!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Then, why don't you all start lining up?
Rui, all of you, be sure to join in as well!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Gladly!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll step on them...
Now...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
My turn... Hiyah!
Um, I hope that didn't hurt...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you, Miku, Rin!
You both did a wonderful job!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Woohoo♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, I'm next!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. It's so funny how we're lining up to step on someone's shoes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it's turned into quite the event.

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line:
Huh...?
What are you guys all lined up for?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, this is for...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hear my wish, and don't let Tsukasa get injured. There!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll be done once Rui and the others have had their turn.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. So, a funny thing happened while we were waiting in line.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Look at everyone behind us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Behind you? There should only be you three...

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: See? Doesn't this look like fun?

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks for letting us know!

rows.Speaker: Plushie R
rows.Line: I've never done anything like this before. I hope I do okay.

rows.Speaker: Plushie S
rows.Line: I was worried about that too and asked someone ahead of me in the line. But Emu and the others said it was really easy!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Hey, I heard everyone's stepping on someone's shoes!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: On someone's shoes? Is that supposed to be a new kind of game?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh my...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha! This line's so long! It's like they're waiting to get on a really popular ride or something!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow! They must really love you, Tsukasa☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Stepping on someone's new pair of shoes must feel like quite a new experience to the plushies.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, to think that they'd be this interested...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nonetheless...this feels like a nice discovery!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A nice discovery?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! This may seem rather mundane to us, but to others, it's fun and interesting!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's a new way to make others smile!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I see.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Since you're all about to set out into the world...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It'll be important to remember that even the slightest things can make others smile and laugh.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed!
Diner

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Here's to a wonderhoy performance, everyone!
Ch-Ch-Ch-Cheeers☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Cheers.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't know about the rest of you, but I feel a lot more tired than usual...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me too. Performing with a new group in a different place does seem to require a little extra energy...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, the play was a type of production we weren't used to, which may've also played a role.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it left me mentally fatigued too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And despite it being a tough play to put on, everyone in Shunmeiza didn't break a sweat and paid so much attention to detail.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They were so amazing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I feel even more motivated to improve my acting skills now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ooh, Nene, you're all full of peas!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't you mean full of beans?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. In any case, this definitely ended up being a fruitful experience for us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I agree.
However, that also comes with some setbacks.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ultimately, I wasn't able to fulfill my role as an actor on the day of the show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But the director said he really liked your performance!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, stop...
The truth is that I failed in my duties. I was shown plainly where I am as an actor right now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That being said, I'm not about to let that get me down!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If anything, now that I know what I need to work on, I'm as motivated as ever about the future!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪ You're back to being all fiery like usual!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He might actually be burning hotter than usual.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And we wouldn't have it any other way.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, before we take our next step...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I need to thank all of you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have a feeling that my performance today would've been dismal if I hadn't asked for your help.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because you were all so kind, I was able to play Nakayama the way I did.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So, from the bottom of my heart...
Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You just wanted to thank us...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean... It's not like this is the first time we helped you figure out how to play a character.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Plus, it was your hard work that paid off in the end, not ours.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
She's right.
All we did was provide you with a few ideas as to what Nakayama might be like as a person.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're the one who solved the puzzle, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And brainstorming together was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I really liked the super energetic Nakayama!
I love how he's always smiling and has a booming voice!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me too. I particularly like how he has a habit of driving his three-wheel truck through the front doors of his office. That would make for quite a fun character.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Didn't that one end with him drowning in debt because of his destructive nature...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Despite only having three lines, I thought I was going to lose my voice playing that version of him...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I also liked my gloomy version of Nakayama.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That one involved him mumbling everything he says while hunched over in some dark corner of the office, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because he secretly has the ability to see evil spirits... It ended with him quitting his job, venturing deep into the mountains and sacrificing himself in order to defeat the big boss spirit...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa! He fights evil spirits!
That's so brave of him!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why do all your versions of him involve these outlandish ideas...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, I believe you need to be outlandish at times in order to become used to thinking outside the box.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I suppose...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I couldn't be more grateful about having friends like these who share my burdens.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I can't help but feel blessed...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, while I'm at it...
I should go thank Bakuno one last time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not only did he show me the benefits of coming up with a character's life story, he helped me come up with one for Nakayama after I asked him to so suddenly... His vast imagination ended up being the lifesaver I needed!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
I think we should all thank him the next time we see him.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Thanks to Bakuno, I have a slightly better understanding of what it means to really disappear into a role...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If I can learn to master what I just learned... If I can learn to control it, then I should be able to grow even further as an actor.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I still have a long road ahead of me until I reach stardom, but...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm going to take this experience and use it to propel myself to new heights!
Park Cafe

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow...! I didn't know about this cafe at all! The breeze out on the terrace feels so good!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I agree! They've chosen a wonderful location! The perfect place for a pair of siblings to spend some quality time together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I couldn't be happier about us getting to go out today, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. It's been so long since we last had a nice relaxing time together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Until just recently, you didn't come home until it was really late because of practice... You even kept practicing after you got back.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, because the play was just around the corner.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, but... Try not to push yourself too hard, okay? Mom, Dad and I were really worried!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Just the other day, I heard you shouting, “What kind of person is Nakayama?!” while you were in your room.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! You heard me all the way from the living room...?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But... We knew you were trying super duper hard, so we decided to leave you be after talking things over.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
I'm sorry for causing you all to worry so much...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, don't mind us!
Again, just don't push yourself too hard!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes... I'll be careful. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, how did that play go? You were practicing so much for it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So... I still have a few things left to work on, but the show itself was a success.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It was...?! Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you.
...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm? What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, it's just... Some old memories came back.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I was able to learn how to flesh out my character because of a memory from when we were little.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(That takes me back.
Coming up with all those shows for Saki to make her smile while she was in the hospital...)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: “We made it! We're finally on the monsters' island!”

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Alright, we're going to find that treasure no matter what!”

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, we'll stop here for today!
I hope you're looking forward to seeing what happens next time!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: I am!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks for coming up with another really fun show, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: I'm so glad Bunny was able to make so many friends after starting out as such a crybaby! I can't wait to see what happens next!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, I promise to make the next one even more amazing! So, Saki, stay tuned!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(She was all smiles again today.
Alright, I need to start coming up with the next part right away!)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The next scene is when they finally fight the monsters, so how should I do it...?)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Bunny bravely going up against them face-to-face might be cool. Yeah, I'll go with that...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm...
This still doesn't feel right. But why...?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This scene should be really cool because of how Bunny triumphs over those monsters with his friends after getting strong...)

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: I'm so glad Bunny was able to make so many friends after starting out as such a crybaby!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Right. Bunny isn't just cool.
He started out as a cowardly crybaby... Then...)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Those monsters should terrify him, shouldn't they?)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What if he gets mad and fights the monsters after his friends get hurt by them?)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Nod*
That'd make way more sense for Bunny since he's so kind and loves his friends!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I'll keep going with that in mind!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The story I made for Saki back then starring the bunny plushie ended up helping me a lot this time around.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Everything I've experienced up until now can serve as a source of inspiration... Such is acting, I suppose.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa...? You've gone all quiet...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Ah, sorry...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was just thinking about how much you're always helping me, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I still have a lot to learn as an actor... But this show definitely helped me grow.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Watch, Saki, as I get closer and closer to achieving stardom!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I dunno what you're talking about, but it sounds like something I did ended up helping you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Which makes me really glad!
Keep doing your best, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I will!
Lunch break
Kamiyama High School - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Ah, there is nothing like flowers growing by the side of the road...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“These look like pansies.
Their various colors, forms and aromas are wonderful.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “And what do we have here growing in this flower bed...?”
Huh? Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, hello, everyone!
Having lunch in the courtyard today?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, since it's so nice out. We decided to have lunch in the courtyard while getting some drinks.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What were you doing just now, Tsukasa? It looked like you were talking to the flowers...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, that?
I was just getting into character for my next role!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Your next role? For a show?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, not for a show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As it so happens, Wonderlands×Showtime is going to be in a feature film!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! A film?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's incredible news...!
What's your character going to be like?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, get ready.
I'll be playing...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Young Man A, who squats while admiring flowers!!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Young Man A? Admiring flowers...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That sounds like...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Correct! We're going to be extras!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It may not be glamorous, but we nonetheless get to play people who live in this film's world.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I'm getting into character because I plan on being the most believable flower-admiring man I can be!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. As always, Tsukasa, I'm impressed by your work ethic. No matter the role, you're giving it everything you have.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah hah!
Yes, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Giving it everything you have is fine and all... But to be honest, you looked more suspicious than usual just now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah... I mean, you were smiling while talking to those flowers... Everyone started backing away from you...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still, you're practicing here at school. That's quite the dedication.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
There's a reason why I'm practicing here at school...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: A reason?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes...
The thing is, when I was given this role, I went outside to look for some flowers to practice with...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But every time I tried talking to some, the children in my neighborhood started giving me these strange looks...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, that was an excellent performance!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm glad we saw it since I'd been meaning to go see that play.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm also glad. I didn't know what to do when I heard they'd immediately sold out of tickets. And then our friend from Shunmeiza said they'd give us some...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank goodness it turned out that their friend is a member of the troupe we saw perform today. I suppose it speaks to the importance of networking.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And the story was so good☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I loved how the protagonist didn't know he was a ghost while talking to his friends!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Those around him knew that he'd become a ghost, which led to some comical misunderstandings during their conversations. The audience certainly seemed to have a nice laugh.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I hadn't laughed that hard at a play in such a long time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But the scene when the protagonist departs into the afterlife was kinda sad.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I felt the same way!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The way he told his friends that they'd always been smiling before then, and how he wanted them to still be smiling when they said goodbye... It really made me tear up...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that was a wonderful climax.
The expression the protagonist made as he held back his tears felt so compelling.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What did you think, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Me...? Yes, I also thought the final scene was very good.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Even the minor characters who were in that scene... They also gave excellent performances.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The minor characters?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Remember how I also played a minor role during the play for newcomers? I put in quite a bit of effort for that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I tried learning what I could by watching all the characters like that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But... I felt most drawn in by the protagonist's uncle.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
His uncle...?
Oh, the person off to the side during the funeral and the final scene?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. He didn't have all that many lines since he wasn't close with the protagonist...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But the expressions he made forced me to think about what he was feeling deep down.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Deep down?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. For example, when the protagonist departed into the afterlife...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Until that point, his uncle had been seeing him as a ghost. But then, right as the protagonist was about to disappear, he moved his foot forward ever so slightly.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And just for that split second, the look in the uncle's eyes changed. It almost felt like he was the protagonist's father...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: His father...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That was the moment I realized just how much the protagonist meant to him.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There may've been a time when he really did feel like a son. When he was little, the protagonist might've spent a lot of time playing with his dear uncle.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course, this is just my imagination talking. None of these things were depicted during the show...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
The acting performance put on by that minor character's actor made you think about his backstory.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, because he added so much depth to the story without speaking. And he did so without negatively impacting the rest of the scene...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It seemed like a good example to refer to while I try to work on thinking about the performance as a whole while maintaining my fervent passion for acting.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I didn't realize how educational this was for you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was. And we need to once more thank the person who gave us these tickets!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, in the end, I couldn't help but see how the entire audience was smiling after it was all over.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me too. I suppose it's only natural since it included quite a lot of comedic elements...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And it was clear that the cast wanted to send the audience home smiling, which they succeeded in doing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I felt that too!
It's like they were all doing everything they could to make the audience smile and laugh!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Plus, the way the whole cast was smiling in the end made me really happy♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Me too.
It made me want to do the same...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And we'll need to keep doing our best in order to make that happen!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I want to make people all over the world smile.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That feeling hasn't changed whatsoever.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But I'll need to keep training to accomplish that goal.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We're getting to work with Shunmeiza now, but I want to do more. No matter how hard things get, I need to do everything I can...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'll get closer to my dream one step at a time.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa

rows.Line:
Ah, Rui. Do you have a moment?
I'd appreciate your advice on something.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My advice?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. There's something I've been trying out to achieve one of my personal goals, but it doesn't feel effective.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: One of your goals... Do you mean the task you were given? “Think about the play as a whole while maintaining your fervent passion for acting”?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not that one... That is another important goal for me, but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm talking about the ability to come up with a story for my characters in order to deepen my understanding of them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That needs to be deliberately developed over a long time span.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Your acting has a way of tugging at your audience's heartstrings. You have the potential to become a great actor... That's my belief.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: However, there's the other side of that coin.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: It appears that, unless you have a part that involves dramatic emotional shifts, your acting becomes mediocre.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: In order to remedy my loneliness, I started making up people for me to talk to.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: I first thought it'd be good to talk to characters from stories, so I started with books...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: From Sindbad to Alice, I talked to so many people...and even to some characters who weren't people.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Developing an imagination on par with Bakuno's, and considering the story of a person's life...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As a first step, I've been trying to read novels with a more philosophical leaning than I'm used to...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But my mind hasn't been able to properly process the characters and their vastly differing values and ways of seeing the world.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And the depictions of characters' motivations feel quite nuanced and complex... As I'm reading, I find myself stopping to wonder why a character is acting a certain way.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm... First, understanding someone with differing values from yourself is difficult even in one's real life. I believe that will require a slow and steady approach.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As for the depictions of characters' motivations, I would chalk some of this up to you not being used to the genre, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think you may be finding it hard to process all the extra information that comes with more realistic characters.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah... That's a good point, since I've been thinking about each character's place in the world and their upbringing rather than focusing on what they're feeling in one particular scene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How about attempting an in-depth test run on a story that's a little more simple?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Something simple?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Something with plenty of space between each line and only the minimum level of description required, but with pictures included to make it easy to fill in the blanks with your imagination...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That is to say, a picture book.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I believe I had it put away here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you want to process vast amounts of information, you must first become adept at organizing it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A picture book is not likely to include personalities as complex as a philosophical novel, so it should make for the perfect way to practice your processing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As you just mentioned yourself, this is a long-term endeavor. I'm sure you'll find a method that works for you sooner or later...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So until then, try to tackle this with patience, discipline and attention to detail.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's just as Rui said. Rather than jumping to the advanced levels right off the bat, I must take one calculated step at a time.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And to that end... Ah, here it is!

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's quite nostalgic... The last time must have been when I read it to Saki back then.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The protagonist is a boy in elementary school who has a little sister.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (One of the girls in his grade lives next door, and the three of them were great friends...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But then, the girl suddenly moves away to a neighboring town, leaving the younger sister quite depressed.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (In an attempt to help her feel better, the protagonist tries to draw up a map between their house and the girl's...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I always thought to myself, “Now this is what an older brother should be!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, in the payoff moment when they manage to reach the girl's house, the protagonist is drawn with his back to the reader, and we barely see how he feels...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The only hint is his younger sister's line, “Your face looks all weird!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Back when I read this to Saki, I did wonder to myself about what face he was making...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And now may just be the time to find the answer!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right! First, I'll reread it in its entirety, then...
