rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: At any rate, I need to hurry back and discover the true meaning of this “weird face”...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah! This light!
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Here it is! So this ball must be the source of the glow!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Could this also be responsible for bringing me here?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, I have to be overthinking... I'm sure it's just a prop the plushies forgot to put away.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh well, I suppose I'll go return this first.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! It's flashing again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gah, it's so bright...!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What is this place...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha. Have I drifted off to dreamland yet again?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Owowowowow!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Th-This pain in my cheek... This is no dream!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Actually, these streets are giving me déjà vu... Where have I seen them before?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Come on, hurry up!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
..!
Look out!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Wah...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Phew... You really shouldn't jump out into the street like that. You almost got hit by that bicycle.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This girl seems familiar...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That's it! She reminds me of Megu, the younger sister from “Our Way Home”...!)

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Megu!
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I told you not to go off by yourself, didn't I? And you need to watch where you're going...

rows.Speaker: Megu
rows.Line: But you were taking so long.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Can you blame me? I had to draw up a map of our route so far.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If this girl is Megu, could the boy be...?)

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Um, I apologize for my sister. She keeps getting ahead of me since she wants to hurry to our friend's house.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No need, I'm glad she wasn't hurt.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is that friend's house close by?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Um... It's pretty far... I think. I know the address, but I'm not sure how to get there...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (As I thought... He's Hiro, the protagonist of that picture book.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I haven't the slightest as to how on earth I've been put in this situation...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But if I am inside that book, joining them on their journey may allow me to see Hiro's hidden expression for myself.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You appear to be in a bind.
In that case, I shall accompany you!

rows.Speaker: Hiro
rows.Line: Huh? B-But...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have a little sister as well, you see. I'd like to assist you in what you're doing for yours.

rows.Speaker: Hiro
rows.Line: You have a sister?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. My sister's name is Saki, and she's just as cheerful and energetic as your sister!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let me help you, as a fellow older brother!

rows.Speaker: Hiro
rows.Line: You really don't mind?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not at all!

rows.Speaker: Hiro
rows.Line: Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I said I would help, but if I do too much, it would probably interfere with the story...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (In the story, Hiro is able to reach his friend's new home under his own power...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Then, I shall have faith as I watch over him, and only interfere when necessary!)
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I told myself I'd have faith, but...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (They're both quite exhausted. Megu looks like she could drift off to sleep any moment.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I suppose it's no surprise... We've been making wrong turns and backtracking over and over for about an hour.)

rows.Speaker: Megu
rows.Line: Hiro...

rows.Speaker: Hiro
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Megu
rows.Line: Up...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He's already given her a piggyback ride several times now, but...)

rows.Speaker: Hiro
rows.Line:
...
Okay, sure. Get on, Megu.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Yes... That's just the kind of person you are.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Up to this point, every wrong turn, every development, has gone according to the book.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm sure that if this continues, I'll get to see that “weird face” I've wondered about...)

rows.Speaker: Hiro
rows.Line:
Hup...
H-Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He got her on his back, but it seems he no longer has the strength to stand back up.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If I recall what happened in the book, he forces himself to stand regardless, then falls and hurts himself...)

rows.Speaker: Hiro
rows.Line: One more time...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hiro, I'll carry Megu.

rows.Speaker: Hiro
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Leave this to me. I'm still full of energy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
See, look at this!
I'm so overflowing with energy, my legs just started dancing by themselves!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Haaaaaaaaah!!!

rows.Speaker: Hiro
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Hiro
rows.Line:
Hehe... Hahaha...!
That's supposed to be a dance? You look so silly!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I told you I want to help you, didn't I?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, leave Megu to me, and focus on finding your way.

rows.Speaker: Hiro
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm sure he'll figure it out. He'll realize we're very close to our destination...)

rows.Speaker: Hiro
rows.Line: Um, Fu's new house is on 5th, so...

rows.Speaker: Hiro
rows.Line: Oh, look! That pole has a sign saying this is 5th! And the number after it is the same too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, you're right! Well done, Hiro!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's just a bit further to Fu's house. Can you hang in there?

rows.Speaker: Hiro
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Great, then let's depart!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This was the right choice. I couldn't force him to keep that distressed look on his face any longer.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Even if it means I can't see that “weird face”, I'll have no regrets.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'll stop thinking about all that and just make sure I get them reunited with their dear friend.)
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm glad we made it.

rows.Speaker: Fu
rows.Line:
Megu, Hiro!
You really came to see me?!

rows.Speaker: Megu
rows.Line: Yeah! Hiro worked his hardest to find your house!

rows.Speaker: Megu
rows.Line: Huh? Hiro?

rows.Speaker: Megu
rows.Line:
...?
Your face looks all weird!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I see... There was really no need to look.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You've done well, Hiro.
In this moment, you're the coolest older brother in the world.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So, save those tears for just a little longer.
Your friend and your little sister are looking at you.

rows.Speaker: Hiro
rows.Line:
*Sniffle*
Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good! Now, go forth with pride in your heart!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (A “weird face”, is it...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Perhaps Megu was unfamiliar with that expression precisely because she's his little sister.)
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huuuh? It's Tsukasa☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So were you the one visiting that fragment SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Fragment SEKAI? What is that?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ummm, did you maybe pick up a round ball thingy?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, yes, I did! Though I seem to have lost it at some point...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I knew it! So, that's called a fragment of a feeling♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I bet it got drawn here by your feelings that make up this SEKAI, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A fragment of a feeling...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup☆ When you pick one up, it lets you get in touch with the feeling it came from!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, that means that place just now was another SEKAI formed from a fragment of a feeling...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But it turns back into a plain old fragment when enough time passes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So that's what happened...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh! Wait, was it a scary SEKAI or something?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, not at all.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
In fact, I'm grateful for it!
Because I went there, I was able to find the answer I was hoping for.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?! Hehehe, that's great then♪
Kamiyama High School - Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So, my hall monitor friends!
Let us give next week's dress code checks our utmost effort!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We can right everyone's uniform wrongs and help create a virtuous environment here at Kamiyama High!

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitors
rows.Line:
Agreed!
Let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ahem.
That is all from future star and protector of our school environment, Tsukasa Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I thank you all for joining me during your valuable lunch break.
Please, everyone, go enjoy your lunches.

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitors
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Yes, that was a fine speech, if I do say so myself. It appears everyone is more motivated to uphold the rules now.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Having something to look forward to truly does put you in good shape! Today should be a good day!)

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitor A
rows.Line:
You seem to be in a cheery mood, Tenma.
Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not yet, but it's going to!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You see, today is the day this future star was born! Tsukasa Tenma's birthday!

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitor A
rows.Line: Whoa! It's your birthday?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. And for a while now, my dearest sister has been enthusiastically planning my celebration.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, my heart has been dancing with anticipation all morning.

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitor A
rows.Line: It sounds like she cares for you very much. That should be something to look forward to.

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitor B
rows.Line: And hey, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah! Thank you!
I couldn't be happier to be receiving such warm wishes from my hall monitor colleagues.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I would love to have a lively chat about the occasion, but shouldn't you all be heading off to lunch before the break ends?

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitor A
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
Thanks again, Tenma. We'll be off to lunch!

rows.Speaker: Hall Monitors
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Now then, I should be getting to lunch myself.
The weather's nice today. Perhaps I should go outside to...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh! Perfect, Tenma, you're here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm...? Ah, Shiraishi.
What do you mean by that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Look! Over there, don't you see it?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Over there...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? That ridiculously out-of-place object on the ground...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is that one of Rui's robots?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: S-Sure is weird how it's just sitting there, isn't it? Pretty mysterious...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can't imagine Rui being so neglectful of a tool he uses in shows...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But that's neither here nor there.
I appreciate you letting me know, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: O-Of course...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'll get it off the ground and bring it to...
Hm? It's moving?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
H-Hey! Wait! Where are you going?!
More importantly, don't run in the corridor!
Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Grr... Where did it go?
I saw it on its way to the roof...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

Happy birthday.
Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A-All of you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. So... Can we call this surprise a huge success?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I told you.
There was no chance Tsukasa wouldn't fall for this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nuh-uh, this was all because I brought him right here!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm impressed you can be proud of that awkward acting...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hahaha, sorry, Tsukasa!
This has all been our birthday surprise!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We apologize for startling you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, I never imagined...
To think you all prepared this surprise just for me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ahh, I couldn't be happier to be blessed with such wonderful friends! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
You're always so overdramatic.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: C'mon, let's eat instead of just standing around talking. How's about we have a birthday luncheon?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sounds great! Let's grab our lunches and gather back here!
You too, Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I'll bring it right away!
That said, nobody get any ideas about running in the corridor, understood?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?!
You were planning my surprise that far in advance?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, at Aoyagi's request.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's right. I was asking around a bit... I wondered what sort of gift would befit you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And we figured, if we wanna celebrate, we should put a surprise together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't remember ever agreeing to it, but at some point that was just the way things were going...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is that so...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Toya, don't you think you should hand over his present right about now?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ah, of course.
Thank you all again for helping taste test.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Taste test...? What did you make, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Here. I made these...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wow! These are cupcakes, if my eyes don't deceive me!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I recall you enjoyed them last time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's rather dull of me to make the same thing again, but I couldn't see any other treats coming out well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sure you would've done just fine! And let me just say, these look even better than the ones you made before!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They look quite extravagant, and I can tell you put a lot into them. They all look delicious!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It's thanks to everyone's advice.
I particularly appreciated getting detailed input from Akito with regards to the flavor.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That was nothing. You asked what I thought, so I told you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You mean to say everyone put a lot of thought and care into these cupcakes...
There are plenty to go around, so let's have them together in celebration!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Woohoo! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can't wait to have some of Toya's homemade treats♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, I know.
Would you open your gift from me once we're finished eating?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, so you brought something as well, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I brought a new piece of stage equipment.
I hope you'll like it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: New...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Stage equipment...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait a second. I didn't hear anything about that gift.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It had better not be one of your contraptions that explodes!
An explosion is the last thing I need on my birthday!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? I felt that something extravagant and memorable would be fitting for the occasion...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So it is going to explode!!!

rows.Speaker: An, Toya & Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
Hehe.
Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Tsukasa♪

rows.Speaker: Father & Mother
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, today...
I made you a special dish!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ahh, I could tell you were preparing something, but to think it was food...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Getting to eat my dearest sister's home cooking on my birthday... I... I...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Tsukasa.
Don't start crying before I even bring it out!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I-I apologize.
I couldn't stop the emotions from welling up...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, what is it that you've made?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, well... Ta-daaa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What?! This is...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This aroma that tickles the nose and rouses the appetite...! The way the pork and onions give off this caramel brown glow...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is ginger fried pork, is it not?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup, your favorite!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. She's been getting practice in whenever you weren't around.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: And I've been giving lots of assistance as a taste tester.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wh?!
You ate Saki's ginger fried pork before I could! That isn't fair, Dad!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I think today's is my best yet, so get those hopes up♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, Tsukasa, here you go!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Now then, I'll take a bite...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-How is it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Delicious! Far too delicious!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gaaah! The more I taste, the more tears come out! It would be no exaggeration to call this the world's best ginger fried pork!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Tsukasa. You're always so over-the-top.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. It's great that he's enjoying it.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I think it's about time your mom and I had some of this world-class ginger fried pork too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Go on, eat up!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
Hey, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What is it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, I recorded some birthday messages for you! Wanna watch them, maybe once we're done eating?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, how exciting! Please show me!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Happy birthday, Tsukasa!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho & Honami
rows.Line: <Happy birthday!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <Saki's always telling us about how hard you're working to achieve your dream.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <You've been visiting different troupes and training with them, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <I remember hearing you were part of a film shoot a little bit ago.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <I'm sure you'll face some difficulties, but with how sincere you are, I believe that you can make your dream come true.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: <We'll be cheering you on in the hopes that you'll get closer to that goal this year.>

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: And that was your message from Ichi and the girls!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: I need to thank them later! I couldn't be happier to receive such heartfelt words.

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line:
I know, right?
But... You still haven't seen the special guests!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Special guests?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Tsukasa! Happy wonderhoy birthday!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <W-Wonderhoy...!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <You're just gonna keep leveling up from today on! I can't wait to watch you turn into a shinier and shinier star!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Let's keep bringing lots of energy and do our best☆>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <U-Um... I'm always cheering for you all as your number one fan.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <It's a shame I can't see you perform for a while, but I'm looking forward to the day you return from your training even closer to achieving your dreams. P-Please do your best...!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Oh, birthday messages are such a wonderful idea.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Are you watching, Tsukasa? Happy birthday.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Um, uhh, I hope you have a very happy birthday!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <You helped me with dancing! And gave me a push when I was feeling nervous too!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <You're always so helpful... Thank you so, so much!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Hold on, you two. You can't just say whatever comes to mind. We're making a video message, so we really should have more of a plan or something... Oh well, I guess this is fine.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Happy birthday, Tenma. I had a lot of fun sightseeing with you on the school trip.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Us idols and you the actor, we're all pursuing a dream! Let's give it our all, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And that was the last of the messages... Wait, Tsukasa, are you crying?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sorry! Their messages were full of so much warmth that I feel hot water dripping from my eyes...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hahaha! I'll send you the video later, so watch it as many times as you want!
Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I had a feeling this would be a good day, but I had no idea it would be this great.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And it's all thanks to the people who gave me their birthday wishes. I need to formally express my gratitude...
<Tsukasa, Tsukasa!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?
<Can you talk right now?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Miku, it's you.
I can, but what brings you here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe, so, I want you to come to SEKAI... Can you do that?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To SEKAI?
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everybody! Tsukasa's heeere!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everything's ready over here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Emu? Wait, Rui and Nene too?
What are you all gathered here for?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. When something you're unaware of starts to unfold on your birthday, most people would call that a “surprise.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Miku and the others want to celebrate your birthday. So, we've been helping them out.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: M-My stars...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, today... This special birthday show is our gift to you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We snuck lots of practice in for today, so enjoy to your heart's content!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We've been itching to put on this show for you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, c'mon, sit!
Our exciting show is about to start☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I'll fully indulge in this gesture you've all prepared!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...
This really is a great day!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Tsukasa!!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki's really happy about you liking her ginger fried pork. I can picture you savoring the flavor now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She was still worried it might not turn out on the day of your birthday, so I was glad to hear that it went over well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We did tell her there's no chance you wouldn't like something she made, though.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But I wanted him to really think it was delicious!
Don't worry, Tsukasa, I'll make it for you again another day!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Happy birthday.
I'm happy that you enjoyed our surprise despite how much it startled you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And it was fun all eating lunch together like that! The air has this fun energy to it whenever you're around, like we never run out of stuff to talk about!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, enough energy to earn us some stares from the group that came up later... Well, that sorta thing's not bad once in a while.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So you all surprised Tsukasa for his birthday... That sounds so fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I heard you guys at Miya Girls recorded video messages! Hey, Kohane, what did yours say?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Th-That's a secret. It's embarrassing to say.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Tenma!
It's good to know you liked your birthday messages!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I don't think I had anything good to say since I was so nervous... Sh-Should I ask for a retake?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You did your very best to offer him your thanks, Minori. I'm sure that reached him.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, he and Saki must be close for her to collect video messages for him. That's so nice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
They've been that way ever since they were little.
I hope you'll always be such a kind and cheerful brother for Saki, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Tenma.
Otori was very excited about planning a surprise for that evening, so I'm sure you had a fun day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I wish you a good year ahead as well.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasaaa! Happy birthday...wonderhoy♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's such a shame I didn't get to test out my new special effects before the lunch break ended. I was sure they would be to your liking...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Maybe you didn't get to test it on his birthday, but you're still going to one of these days, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Of course.
This is something very special I devised just to help our troupe leader shine.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Shining sounds fine... I just hope it doesn't involve explosions.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe, I can't wait to see sparkly Tsukasa☆
Let's keep bringing more joy as Wonderlands×Showtime! We'll be counting on you, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone! Thank you for celebrating my birthday with me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This soaring pegasus will shine ever brighter for the blessings he's received!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And with this light you've given me, I promise to make your smiles even more vibrant!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wonderlands×Showtime and Tsukasa Tenma, future star!
Please keep an eye on where we go from here!
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Roar*

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Hey, that's pretty fast!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: But pulling tires isn't just about trying to run as fast as you possibly can. This is about using every muscle you can as well as strengthening them.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
So, focus on your form!
Think about how you're going to propel yourself forward and remember what you do!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Use your body the right way!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...!
This is...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
R-Rough...
M-My legs... I can't move them...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Pulling these tires...
Even just one feels incredibly heavy...!
I'm struggling to move forward...!)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Alright, just six more laps!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Okay!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Good job, everyone. You made it through.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This certainly seems like a good way to put on more muscle...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: However, as I mentioned earlier, all of you became so caught up in pulling the tires that you forgot what this exercise was actually about...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: The goal is not to pull as fast as you can, but to figure out the best way to use your muscles.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: The next time you find yourself doing some heavy lifting like this, don't hesitate to take it slow. Understand how your body is reacting and how to make use of your center of gravity.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: For example, just during this exercise, did you notice how much easier it was for you to produce power when you got down low?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes...
I got that sense partway through.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I didn't realize what I was actually doing at first, but my body just seemed to naturally bend lower and lower...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If exercises like these will help me learn how to control all the muscles in my body, then...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Mr. Kijima!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'd like to do another set with those tires! This time, I'd like to try pulling more!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! Are you sure, Tsukasa?!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Another set?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I want to become a star...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And in order to make that dream come true, I'd like to do absolutely everything I can right now!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: You want to become stronger in order to achieve your goals. I know that feeling all too well.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: That being said, trying to pull more tires than you can handle may lead to you hurting your legs and posture. I really wouldn't recommend doing this...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Still...
If you're that determined to do another set, then I'll allow it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Let's do another set right now!
Start with one lap and try working your way up to three if you're feeling good. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you very much...
I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Alright, start!
You chase after me as I run!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Hnng...!
So heavy! But it is just that much more weight...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Obviously, I'm absolutely struggling to move my legs...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(No, calm down...!
He just told you that going fast doesn't matter!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Think about your entire body. Think about what muscles you need to use in order to move forward. Then, go!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Wait, if I lower my center of gravity too much, then I'm going to end up in a funny stance...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Mr. Kijima isn't actually leaning forward all that much... Is he making it so he can keep his legs vertical despite all this weight? I'll try copying him...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Oh, this makes things much easier...
I feel like I can sort of run now. Alright, I'll keep going and...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That's one lap!)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Oh, you're really getting the hang of this.
Alright, Tenma, give me two more laps! Don't give up!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay! I can keep going...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nice work, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That was amazing!
You actually finished!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, well...
This is nothing for a future star such as myself... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I finished, but now I can't get up...)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
That was good.
I admire your guts.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: However, I need to take this opportunity to say something that an actor such as yourself needs to hear...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I know that you want to keep growing no matter what, but training harder and doing more reps or sets isn't always the answer.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: You're a hardworking person, which means you need to know what your body's limits are!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, you're absolutely right...
Getting hurt is the opposite of what I want...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Exactly. But having the guts to really go for it is also important. Your passion is the fuel you need to keep growing.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: So, let's keep growing together and find ways to cleverly use those guts!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, let's!!!
Lunch break
Kamiyama High School - Class 3-C

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What...? “Subscribe to the Jidaigeki Channel. Free first month!”...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, this is an incredible deal...!
It has over a thousand different episodes available!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hm? Tsukasa?
You seem awfully happy about something.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Rui.
I just saw this offer for the Jidaigeki Channel and was wondering if I should subscribe.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A channel for historical dramas...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! A few Mikazukigumi members gave me some recommendations.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Since we'll be working with them for a while, I thought I should learn what I can in my spare time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see.
So, what has your impression been?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When I took some time to watch, I found them quite interesting.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In particular, the director's cut version of Komiya's Chushingura! The villainous portrayal of Kira Kozukenosuke left me stunned...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Also, “The Phantom Assassin” series.
I remember being so enthralled by the way the protagonist defeated all those enemies at once! Especially the battle in the fog during the last episode!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that one's very famous.
Throughout its ten-year run, they made it so each season had a unique style to it. But the overall theme of the hero working in the shadows to defeat evil never changed...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Rui, you're familiar with it?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. A little.
I went through a phase of watching historical dramas to see how they were made.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actually, Tsukasa, I'm guessing you enjoyed the fourth season quite a lot since it has such a satisfying arc.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The hero's life as a ringleader of thieves came to a screeching halt as he became mixed up in a series of incidents. Ultimately, he starts fighting the evildoers behind them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, despite being a thief, he's a leader who cares about his comrades and has the charisma to match. A hero who has the respect of both his allies and enemies.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Am I right in saying that you've thought about what it'd be like to play him?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's right! How did you know?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It seemed natural.
An honest thief who can't lie. A lovable criminal. That seemed right up your alley, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, those very qualities are why I found this character so appealing! How can it not be fun to play him?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, I have to ask...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The battle in the fog at the end... If you were the director, Rui, I'm guessing you would've wanted to use a snow machine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: On top of the fog greatly reducing visibility, the hero would have to deal with the cold while fighting off countless enemies. That's the kind of scene I feel you'd make it...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that's not a bad idea.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah, I knew it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That being said, the Rui Kamishiro I know would easily come up with something more spectacular than what I just said!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You always come up with ideas that I never expect, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I appreciate the compliment.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But you're also always exceeding my expectations with your performances, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Actually, not just you.
Emu and Nene as well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I agree.
I believe Emu gave us a particularly big surprise as Ushiwakamaru this time around.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of her, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I feel that she'd be the perfect person to play the enemy who appears during the middle of the fourth season of “The Phantom Assassin”!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The happy-go-lucky sword master who was working as a mercenary?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, given Emu's innocent nature, she'd probably do a good job of capturing that character's enigmatic personality.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: See what I mean?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means Nene would play the protagonist's assistant, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree!
She's clumsy in an endearing way, which I think makes her a good character.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And she undergoes a nice transformation. She starts out quiet, but slowly starts to help him after he saves her.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She's athletic and is the perfect partner when a big fight breaks out.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We've become much more agile after we started training with Mikazukigumi, so I'm sure she'd do well when she and the protagonist fight alongside each other.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we've all become much better at performing fight scenes thanks to them...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, we could conceivably put on our own little historical drama someday!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, we could...
We should invite KAITO and the others when we do.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, doing it in SEKAI's an excellent idea!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But things may become a bit chaotic...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of chaotic, that one series is also very good! “The Swift-footed Shinsengumi.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, you've seen that as well?
It's quite an obscure series...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was made by the same director as “The Phantom Assassin”, so I felt that I needed to watch it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I'm somewhat doubtful that it helped in terms of learning more about the genre. I mean, most of the early episodes are full of jokes and comedy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: True... I definitely wasn't expecting them to travel through time and find themselves in a school setting. I mean, they really tested the viewer's limits...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But it grew on me as I watched.
Actually, I thought it was very good overall.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, did you see that one movie where the heroes from the Phantom Assassin series join together in a grand battle...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that was incredible.
They did an excellent job including the best aspects of each season. Not only that...
Mikazukigumi Practice Area

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm starting to get nervous...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I think that's only natural.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How we do during these auditions today and tomorrow determines which roles we get to play for “Ginnosuke's on the Case!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's all do our best!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Director
rows.Line: Alright, leader, you're up next.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
This tension in the air...
It's really starting to feel like an audition.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, and Mr. Kijima seems a little different from his usual self.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, since whether or not he gets the lead depends on this. Even he can't let his guard down...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I also need to stay acutely focused...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Because I want to play the protagonist!
I want to be Ginnosuke!)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: “Come, Heihachi!”

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: “Now is our chance to show off our skills!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Mr. Kijima's sword fighting skills really are something else.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Be it when he parries attacks or goes to strike his opponent, he moves with so much precision. But there's also a degree of artistry.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Ginnosuke's the most famous constable in all of ancient Tokyo, which means the person playing him needs to give off that sort of aura and have the skills to match...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Mr. Kijima's playing a character who's cool, collected and fearless. He honestly seems like the best person for this role...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Will my portrayal of Ginnosuke be better than Mr. Kijima's...?)

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Director
rows.Line: Next, Tenma!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ready!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(No, don't think!
Just play your character as best you can!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(My goal is to become a star...!
I will put on a better performance than Mr. Kijima!!!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa seems very motivated...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Break a leg, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “You had Chusuke steal your pot in order to have your upstanding superior framed. And for quite some time now, you've been using these methods to get rid of anyone you see as a nuisance...!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Bring it on!
I feel like I can beat anyone right now!”

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Director
rows.Line: Okay, as for who will be playing Ginnosuke...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I did my absolute best.
I gave this audition everything I had.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (So, all I can do now is hope for some good news...!)

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Director
rows.Line: Ginnosuke will be played by...

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Director
rows.Line: Daigo Kijima!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Yes, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I lost...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I gave it my absolute best. It just wasn't enough...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Mr. Kijima's portrayal of Ginnosuke was beyond incredible.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Especially during those sword fights. Even when he was taking up a stance, his presence was overwhelming. I was nowhere near that level...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He really is something else.)

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Director
rows.Line: Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Y-Yes?!
How can I help?!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Sorry if we caught you by surprise. See, the two of us had a little chat after seeing your performance...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: If you'd like, why don't you try auditioning for the role of Heihachi tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: H-Heihachi...?!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Director
rows.Line: Yes. Heihachi is Ginnosuke's right-hand man... The way he fervently strives to become Ginnosuke makes him a wonderful character.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Director
rows.Line: That determination also drives him to see cases through until the very end. He's quite a strong fellow...

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Director
rows.Line: After seeing your acting and dynamic sword fighting, I thought you'd make the perfect Heihachi.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Yeah, I felt the same way.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
I want to see you play him.
Would you be willing to give it a try?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Me playing Heihachi...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Heihachi's another important role...
This is bound to be just as tough a challenge as auditioning for the lead.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But if they're both willing to ask me to try...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Then I have no choice but to accept!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay...!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I, Tsukasa Tenma, promise to do my absolute best during tomorrow's audition!!!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Great!
We'll be looking forward to it!!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, Tsukasa, I'll help you with your training.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It'll be good practice for us too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's do our best together, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, much appreciated!
No matter what...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm going to land the role of Heihachi!!!
Morning
Kamiyama High School - Class 3-C

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Phew...
Five minutes before classes start. I made it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, Tsukasa, good morning.
It's not like you to cut it so close.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, it's because I forgot to set my alarm. I ended up waking up thirty minutes late as a result.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
However!
I was able to make it in time by sprinting over at full speed!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All thanks to the training I did with Mr. Kijima to play Heihachi properly! Hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm impressed.
You're still as agile as when you caught Chusuke.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. I could climb up the wall and come in through that window if it came down to it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure a hall monitor should be doing something like that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
N-No, I was just giving an example!
A hall monitor would never do anything like that!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Hey, everyone, we're assembling in the gym!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, it's time for us to hear another one of the principal's extended speeches following a long holiday.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's go!
Ten minutes later
Gym

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: To conclude, I hope that you'll all be mindful of your health.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Hmm...
This speech was shorter than normal.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(But this seems like a good length.
The longer his speech, the more likely it is that some students will start fooling around and have to be warned to stop.)

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: Next, I'd like to take this time to present a few commendations.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Hm? Commendations? That's rare...
Did one of the clubs achieve good results or something?)

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: Please come join me on stage after I call your name and class.

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: Class 3-C, Rui Kamishiro and Tsukasa Tenma. Class 2-A, Nene Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: The school received a letter of thanks from the Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park naming the three of you. Please come to the stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The park sent a letter...?
Oh, I see. Now I understand!

rows.Line: Our feelings...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, you're right!
A few hours later - Before the show
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's almost our cue.

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Right! Time for the brightest star of the night to shine and make this the best performance ever!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I will— with a strong, kindhearted hero by my side!

rows.Speaker: Chiaki
rows.Line: Haha, you're right. After all, the same wish burns red-hot in both our hearts!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, let's go bring smiles to our audience, with the power of our radiance!
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Run, Tsukasa, run♪ Run like the wind☆>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Miku...!
Thank you for cheering for me again! I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. You put in a huge effort the other day!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So, I thought I should come back and pep you up as a member of the Wonderlands×Showtime cheer squad♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah.
That's all the encouragement I need!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But your timing couldn't have been better.
There's something I need to tell you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, you wanna tell me something?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I recently made a new friend.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've been seeing him each time I come here for my morning run, and we're becoming fast friends.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Wow, that's great!
What kind of person is he?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You already know who he is, Miku!
We're nearing our usual meeting spot.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, found him. He's over there!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Over where?>

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh! Hi, Nyantaro☆>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good morning, Nyantaro! Thank you for waiting for me again today!

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You were talking about Nyantaro just now!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, remember when he got stuck on that stepping stone? Since then, I've been getting to see him at this park each time I come for a run.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Really?! Then, that must mean he's coming to greet you each morning☆>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That would make me very happy!
Especially since overcoming a trial such as that is an excellent way to start a friendship.

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, he's right at your feet!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<You seem really happy, Nyantaro!
Are you glad to see Tsukasa?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
I'm also glad to see you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Still, I didn't realize he'd be this friendly.
Most strays are incredibly wary of people...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. Nyantaro must've realized that you're a really kind person, Tsukasa☆>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
I certainly have no complaints regarding that!

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: *Sniff* *Sniff*

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Huh? He's sniffing you for some reason.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, he must've noticed.
He is a cat, after all.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I brought you a little treat today, Nyantaro.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <A treat?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I brought...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Some dried sardines with a silver sheen!

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, his eyes are twinkling now!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is a gesture of friendship from me to you. We may've only met just recently, but...

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The moment you took that leap of faith from that stone, I knew we'd forged a special bond. As such, I have a good feeling about our friendship moving forwar—

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow! Meow!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which is why I'm bringing you these sardines. It isn't much, but I hope you enjoy them to the—

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meoooow!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Argh! Alright, alright!
You don't have to jump up and down like that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Honestly, right when someone's giving a serious speech... I didn't realize you'd like these this much. Here, have some.

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, he looks so happy eating them☆>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, he does...
I'm glad he likes them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, now that I've given him his treat, it's time to do some strength exercises.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: While watching our furry friend here feast on his sardines!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yeah☆ Let's go, Tsukasa♪>

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro
rows.Line: Meow!
Meow Park

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nobody to our right. And nobody to our left. Okay, we're all alone.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, the coast seems clear.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Miku, are you there?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hi, you two☆ What's up?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We wanted to thank you for helping out with our show. So, we'd like to take you on any rides and attractions that catch your fancy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's okay for you to come out since Momoi and the others are taking a break right now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wait, really?! Yay!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, what would you like to go on first?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Let's see... I wanna go on...>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gwah?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Th-Their giant trampoline launches you this far?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whoa, hey! Take it easy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry!
Miku asked me to jump as high as I could, and I—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoaaa!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wow, we're so high up☆ Higher, Tsukasa, higher!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wow, this is amazing! This maze has so many cats in it!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It is a unique maze.
They have all these cat plushies hidden everywhere.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I feel this urge to find them all!
It could be fun to look for them instead of the exit!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I wanna find as many as I can too☆>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, isn't that one over in the corner there?!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! Where?!
Ferris Wheel

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wow, you can see the whole carnival from up here☆>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So, your final request was the Ferris wheel...
I'm glad you're enjoying it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. I've been wondering what the view is like from up here!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, look over there!
They're the ones you did that show with, right?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, you have a sharp eye!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. They're playing with Nyantaro.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I can also see everyone riding the roller coaster and the merry-go-round☆>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We get a view of all these happy faces. This must be the Ferris wheel of smiles♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This may in fact be the best place to see just how fun-filled this carnival is.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
I'm just a little sad that no one will get to see this view anymore.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But when you look back upon your memories of this carnival, rather than feeling sad about it being gone...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I think everyone who made this carnival a reality would prefer that you remember the view from up here instead.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Mr. Inuyama even said that making everyone smile was his primary goal. So, why don't we end the day smiling?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I believe that's the best way to give this carnival the finale it deserves.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Tsukasa...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yeah! You're right...☆>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Then, let's keep looking for smiling faces and other fun things☆>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm not about to let you hog all the glory!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, look over there!
The maze we were in just now looks like a cat from up above!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <What?! No way!>
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, what a beautiful day!
The sun is shining bright, which means it's a perfect day to have lunch on the rooftop!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, a brighter mood does have this way of making everything taste a little better.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I need to be careful not to bend my back when I go to sit down... Alright, why don't we all sit here?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When I open the lid, I need to focus on what my fingertips are doing. Anyway, what's for lunch today...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, ginger fried pork!
That's my favorite! I couldn't have asked for a better surprise!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? What's the matter?
Is there something you don't like included in your lunch?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What have you been muttering to yourself...?
You've been moving around really carefully...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! You noticed?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There'd be something wrong with me if I didn't.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I still can't get the Kikyogumi show we saw the other day out of my head.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The acting, script and directing were all excellent, but their poise is what impressed me the most.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Their elegance was staggering, was it not?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: True, it was.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: After seeing that performance, I feel like learning how to do the same now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, I've gone ahead and started practicing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, that explains why you were moving all funny just now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Funny? What do you mean?
My goal is to first do normal things in an elegant manner.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's not possible to achieve that level of sophistication overnight, so I'll need to do this constantly.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Constantly? Wait, has he been doing this all day...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As far as I've seen, yes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
My classmates even marveled at my grace!
That means my training is already paying off!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
About that.
I was asked a few questions regarding this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What kinds of questions?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was asked, “Why's Tenma erasing the chalkboard so weirdly?” And, “Why was he swaying around while reading that passage during Japanese class?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You definitely had their attention.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: W-Wait! That's not what I was expecting them to say!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was more under the impression that they'd become speechless over my sheer elegance!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, why didn't you tell me sooner if you knew that they thought I was acting strange?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course, I was going to warn you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I quickly realized that it was the perfect opportunity for me to gather references for how people react in the face of the strange and unusual.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So, I forced myself to stand back and watch.
It genuinely pained me to be unable to help you during your time of need, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, all you did was put your own interests first!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Still, to think I was being viewed that way...!
I thought I'd achieved a nice level of grace.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You were that sure...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Grr... Just you watch.
I will find a way to move with elegance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Alright, we get it.
Can we start eating already?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right...
Having my favorite food should lift my spirits.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Are you all free after school today?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I don't have any plans. Why do you ask...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was wondering if we could all visit SEKAI together. Everyone's been asking about what we're currently doing at Morinomiya.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that sounds like a good idea.
We should also ask Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Tsukasa, can you...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, why are you frozen in place like a statue holding a pair of chopsticks now...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I was just thinking about the most elegant way to eat this ginger fried pork...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I want to scarf down all of this right now, but I won't look very elegant if I do that. But nibbling away at it also seems like the wrong answer.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Lunch is going to end really fast if you keep doing this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seriously, you've been influenced way too much...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It just goes to show how spectacular the performance we saw was.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... What should I do...?
Morinomiya Music Academy

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: “If you are an ogre, then I have every reason to cut you down. I shall destroy all ogres who do harm to people...!”

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line: “Oh? Someone's hunting ogres? That's interesting. He must not value his life very much...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everybody everywhere is practicing lines by themselves...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, this is what things must be like whenever Morinomiya is holding auditions for a show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, that person's practicing for a sword fight!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Look at the way he's moving...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: His strength and agility must be off the charts. I can't help but be impressed...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You certainly seem to be enjoying yourself, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, getting to experience this atmosphere firsthand is quite enjoyable indeed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Especially since the boys weren't scheduled to audition for anything during our time here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nene told us that Morinomiya's auditions are very intense, but I wasn't expecting this...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They may be more motivated than usual, since this isn't one of their regular auditions.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, I wasn't expecting them to hold auditions for students to perform in Kikyogumi's show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Me neither.
And I couldn't be more jealous of them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is understandable, since one stands to grow quite a lot by performing as part of Kikyogumi.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They are our fellow students, so we should give them as much support as we can.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I wish them all the best of luck.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I was startled by the play they chose for this audition.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, they went with “Ouka Kenshiden: The Sakura Swordsman”...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The very play we saw Kikyogumi perform.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to hear the title again this soon after being so moved by that performance.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It seems like the perfect choice in terms of testing an actor's skills and moxie.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not only do your acting skills need to be up to snuff, you also need to be very good with a sword.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it sounds like a fun challenge.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ever since we saw it that day, I've actually been thinking about how I'd play each character.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The namesake swordsman and his nemesis, the ogre, seem particularly challenging since they both require you to be fierce but delicate.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You have no idea how much trouble I had figuring out how to play them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I assume that means you were able to find a satisfactory solution.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course. I managed to come up with a plan for both of them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I won't have a chance to actually present them...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, since we visiting students aren't allowed to audition.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That being said, I would've liked to see what Morinomiya thinks of your renditions.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I feel the same way...
But there's also no need to feel sad.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I may not be allowed to audition, but I can still practice for it like I am!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I already went to all that trouble. And now, I have a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to polish my acting plans in this intense atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let us make the most of every second we have here at Morinomiya!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now I see.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
In that case, I'll help.
Having a rival should make it feel more like a real audition, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that's what I like to hear!
Then, which scene should we do first? I was thinking...
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, I've finished warming up!
I'm ready to begin practicing for our show anytime!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow! You sound so fired up, Tsukasa☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, your excitement has this wonderful infectiousness to it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's because it's been so long since we put together a show ourselves! I had trouble sleeping last night due to the excitement!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The plushies have also been saying just how much they're looking forward to seeing Wonderlands×Showtime perform! So, we plan to put on the best show imaginable!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah☆ We also need to thank you and the others for giving us such a huge hand, KAITO♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you for inviting us to help.
Let's keep doing our best for our plushie friends, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll be performing in the harbor's plaza, yes? Coming up with ideas for that location should be a worthwhile exercise.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It sounded like a lot of them plan on coming to see our show, so we need to make sure they all get to have fun.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They should, since we've included a number of action scenes! It'll be a chance to make full use of our Mikazukigumi training!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We decided to put those in because of your suggestion, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, since you all worked so hard during your time with Mikazukigumi. I feel that those scenes will enhance the story nicely.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've outlined the general flow of all the action scenes, but I'll be asking you and Tsukasa for your opinions when we put things into practice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, let's do our best to create some really breathtaking scenes for the plushies.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Emu
rows.Line:
Yes!
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Tsukasa and Emu's action scene is coming up...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This show is a comedic musical that takes place in a city...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Overall, it's a fun and hectic show, but this is probably the most exciting part.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Emu plays a phantom thief, while I'll be chasing her around as a police officer.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If we can pull off our stunts and work in sync, we should be able to make our audience go wild.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, ready? Begin!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Stop right there! I have you now!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I will catch you today! So, stay still and let me restrain you!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Heh heh! If you're so sure you can catch me, then come and get me!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Grr! Not about to give up, are you?!
But I'm going to wipe that smile off of your face!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm supposed to try to catch her as she deftly slips away every time.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Hup! Hm?! Grr!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Haha! I'm over here!”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa, check it out☆ They're working in perfect sync♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Yes! Next, I catch up to Emu and grab at her arm! The way she evades effortlessly, almost tauntingly, is meant to leave a strong impression...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I know...!
I shouldn't just grab at her arm! I could try...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Yes, that would help make Emu look more dynamic! We didn't actually practice this, but...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Argh! You slippery fiend!
Come heeeeere!!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Is he supposed to run like that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, but...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Try all you like, but the result will always be the same! Haha!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'll make it look like I've lost my balance, and do a series of spins!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Gaaaaahhhh!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That's it, Emu!
You dodged him really beautifully there!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Haha! Tsukasa's spinning round and round!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “No, my eyes are spinning...! Where are you, thief...?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Pokey poke!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “What?! When did you get behind me?!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Hmm... If this keeps up, then it's going to be a hundred years before you catch me.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Grr...! I am just getting started! Prepare yourself!”
se_run_women_002_1
se_run_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, that ended up becoming a wonderfully exciting scene, did it not?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! What did you guys think?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You two were so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I really loved the part when Tsukasa dashed full speed to tackle Emu, but she dodged it easily!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu looked all the more agile because he threw himself at her with such momentum.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, it was really enjoyable to watch!
When did you two practice that?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't think they did. That was improvised, right? All you did was make eye contact with Emu before you made your move.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, you could tell?!
Yes, that was all us improvising!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:

rows.Line: Thank you for being so concerned about us!
